messages.family.FIRE.name: Fire Brigade
messages.family.FIRE.description: Urgent technical rescue: fires, road crashes, collapses, hazardous materials and rescues of every kind.
messages.family.EMS.name: Emergency Medical Service
messages.family.EMS.description: Pre-hospital care: assessing, treating and transporting patients to the most suitable hospital.
messages.family.POLICE.name: Police
messages.family.POLICE.description: Scene security, public order, traffic management and investigations: keeps other responders and the public safe.
messages.family.WILDFIRE.name: Wildfire Service
messages.family.WILDFIRE.description: Fights forest and vegetation fires with ground crews, forest tankers and aircraft.
messages.family.ALPINE.name: Alpine Rescue
messages.family.ALPINE.description: Search and rescue in the mountains and in rough terrain, where ordinary vehicles cannot go.
messages.family.UNG.name: Unmanaged Units
messages.family.UNG.description: External support units called in by the system and not purchasable: tow trucks, utility crews, road operators and Civil Protection.
messages.capability.FIRE_SUPPRESSION.name: Fire suppression
messages.capability.FIRE_SUPPRESSION.description: Attacks and extinguishes fires in buildings, vehicles and materials. The core capability for any incident involving flames.
messages.capability.WATER_SUPPLY.name: Water supply
messages.capability.WATER_SUPPLY.description: Brings water to the scene and feeds the crews where hydrants are missing or the fire demands high flow rates.
messages.capability.HEIGHT_ACCESS.name: Height access and rescue
messages.capability.HEIGHT_ACCESS.description: Reaches upper floors, roofs and facades to rescue people or attack the fire from above.
messages.capability.EXTRICATION.name: Extrication
messages.capability.EXTRICATION.description: Frees people trapped in vehicles using hydraulic cutting and spreading tools.
messages.capability.TECHNICAL_RESCUE.name: Technical rescue
messages.capability.TECHNICAL_RESCUE.description: Rope and swift-water techniques to recover people from wells, embankments, rivers and hard-to-reach places.
messages.capability.HEAVY_RESCUE.name: Heavy rescue
messages.capability.HEAVY_RESCUE.description: Heavy lifting, shoring and search under rubble for collapses and crashes involving large vehicles.
messages.capability.HAZMAT.name: Hazardous materials
messages.capability.HAZMAT.description: Detection, containment and decontamination where chemicals, gases or CBRN risks are present.
messages.capability.WATER_RESCUE.name: Water rescue
messages.capability.WATER_RESCUE.description: Rescues people in rivers, lakes, the sea and flooded areas, on the surface and underwater.
messages.capability.MEDICAL_BASIC.name: Basic medical care
messages.capability.MEDICAL_BASIC.description: First aid, basic life support and immobilisation provided by trained responders.
messages.capability.MEDICAL_ADVANCED.name: Advanced medical care
messages.capability.MEDICAL_ADVANCED.description: Advanced treatment on scene by a nurse or physician: medication, airway management and stabilisation of critical patients.
messages.capability.PATIENT_TRANSPORT.name: Patient transport
messages.capability.PATIENT_TRANSPORT.description: Carries the patient on a stretcher to hospital. Without this capability the patient stays on scene.
messages.capability.MASS_CASUALTY.name: Major incident
messages.capability.MASS_CASUALTY.description: Handles many casualties at once: triage, field medical post and organised evacuation.
messages.capability.SCENE_SECURITY.name: Scene security
messages.capability.SCENE_SECURITY.description: Secures the area, keeps bystanders away and maintains public order while crews are working.
messages.capability.TRAFFIC_CONTROL.name: Traffic control
messages.capability.TRAFFIC_CONTROL.description: Directs traffic, closes roads and opens corridors for emergency vehicles.
messages.capability.INVESTIGATION.name: Investigation
messages.capability.INVESTIGATION.description: Scene surveys, witness statements and forensic work to establish what happened.
messages.capability.K9_SEARCH.name: K9 search
messages.capability.K9_SEARCH.description: Dog teams searching for missing people, under rubble or avalanche debris, and sweeping areas.
messages.capability.EOD.name: Bomb disposal
messages.capability.EOD.description: Checks and makes safe suspicious items and explosive devices, then clears the affected area.
messages.capability.WILDLAND_FIRE.name: Vegetation fire
messages.capability.WILDLAND_FIRE.description: Attacks forest, brush and crop fires with techniques and equipment designed for open terrain.
messages.capability.OFFROAD_ACCESS.name: Off-road access
messages.capability.OFFROAD_ACCESS.description: Reaches places served only by dirt tracks and rough ground, where road vehicles have to stop.
messages.capability.MOUNTAIN_RESCUE.name: Rough-terrain rescue
messages.capability.MOUNTAIN_RESCUE.description: Recovers people from rock faces, trails, gorges or snow using mountaineering techniques and stretcher carries.
messages.capability.AIR_SUPPORT.name: Air support
messages.capability.AIR_SUPPORT.description: Help from above: reconnaissance, fast crew transport, winch recovery or water drops.
messages.capability.COMMAND.name: Command and coordination
messages.capability.COMMAND.description: Coordinates several crews and agencies on scene at complex incidents, making the work faster and more orderly.
messages.capability.LOGISTICS.name: Logistics
messages.capability.LOGISTICS.description: Equipment, lighting, refreshments and spares to sustain long-running incidents.
messages.vehicle.FIRE_APS.name: Fire Engine
messages.vehicle.FIRE_APS.description: The Fire Brigade's workhorse: fire suppression, road crash rescue and technical rescue. First out the door for almost any call.
messages.vehicle.FIRE_ABP.name: Water Tender
messages.vehicle.FIRE_ABP.description: A large water reserve on wheels. Resupplies engines at big fires or far from hydrants.
messages.vehicle.FIRE_AS.name: Aerial Ladder
messages.vehicle.FIRE_AS.description: Turntable ladder for upper floors: rescues from windows and balconies, attack from above and checks on roofs and facades.
messages.vehicle.FIRE_AG.name: Crane Truck
messages.vehicle.FIRE_AG.description: Fire Brigade crane for lifting heavy vehicles, loads and structures. Essential at lorry crashes and collapses.
messages.vehicle.FIRE_4X4.name: Off-Road Fire Unit
messages.vehicle.FIRE_4X4.description: Off-road pickup with a small fire skid. Gets where the engine cannot and is handy on brush fires and narrow lanes.
messages.vehicle.FIRE_SAF.name: Rope and River Rescue Team
messages.vehicle.FIRE_SAF.description: Team specialised in rope work and river environments: recoveries from wells, embankments, gorges and watercourses.
messages.vehicle.FIRE_NBCR.name: Hazmat Unit
messages.vehicle.FIRE_NBCR.description: Hazardous materials unit: detection, leak containment and decontamination of people and vehicles.
messages.vehicle.FIRE_USAR.name: Urban Search and Rescue Unit
messages.vehicle.FIRE_USAR.description: Urban search and rescue team: locates and frees people under rubble after collapses and explosions.
messages.vehicle.FIRE_DIVERS.name: Dive Team
messages.vehicle.FIRE_DIVERS.description: Fire Brigade divers for underwater search and rescue in rivers, lakes, the sea and canals.
messages.vehicle.FIRE_BOAT.name: Rescue Boat
messages.vehicle.FIRE_BOAT.description: Inflatable boat on a trailer for surface rescue: floods, people in the water, evacuations from flooded areas.
messages.vehicle.FIRE_FOAM.name: Foam Tender
messages.vehicle.FIRE_FOAM.description: Carries foam concentrate in bulk for fuel, storage depot and industrial plant fires.
messages.vehicle.FIRE_AIR.name: Breathing Air Unit
messages.vehicle.FIRE_AIR.description: Refills breathing apparatus cylinders on scene, letting crews keep working longer at demanding fires.
messages.vehicle.FIRE_UCL.name: Mobile Command Unit
messages.vehicle.FIRE_UCL.description: Mobile command post for coordinating complex incidents with several crews and agencies on scene.
messages.vehicle.FIRE_HELI.name: Fire Brigade Helicopter
messages.vehicle.FIRE_HELI.description: Fire Brigade helicopter for reconnaissance, flying in specialist teams and winch recoveries.
messages.vehicle.EMS_MSB.name: Basic Life Support Ambulance
messages.vehicle.EMS_MSB.description: Basic ambulance crewed by trained responders: first aid and hospital transport for non-critical patients.
messages.vehicle.EMS_MSI.name: Nurse-Led Ambulance
messages.vehicle.EMS_MSI.description: Intermediate ambulance with a nurse on board: protocol-based advanced treatment and patient transport.
messages.vehicle.EMS_MSA.name: Advanced Ambulance with Physician
messages.vehicle.EMS_MSA.description: Advanced ambulance with a physician and nurse: handles the most critical patients and takes them to hospital.
messages.vehicle.EMS_AUTOMEDICA.name: Rapid Response Car
messages.vehicle.EMS_AUTOMEDICA.description: Fast car with a physician and nurse. Brings advanced care to the scene but cannot transport: pair it with an ambulance.
messages.vehicle.EMS_PEDIATRIC.name: Neonatal and Paediatric Unit
messages.vehicle.EMS_PEDIATRIC.description: Ambulance equipped for newborns and children, with a team and kit dedicated to the youngest patients.
messages.vehicle.EMS_MAXI.name: Major Incident Unit
messages.vehicle.EMS_MAXI.description: Logistics vehicle carrying supplies for many patients: stretchers, medical kit and triage equipment for major events.
messages.vehicle.EMS_PMA.name: Field Medical Post
messages.vehicle.EMS_PMA.description: Field facility where casualties are assessed and stabilised before evacuation. The medical heart of a major incident.
messages.vehicle.EMS_HELI.name: Air Ambulance
messages.vehicle.EMS_HELI.description: Medical helicopter with an advanced team: covers long distances quickly and flies the patient to specialist centres.
messages.vehicle.POL_PATROL.name: Patrol Car
messages.vehicle.POL_PATROL.description: Response patrol: first on scene for calls, scene security and initial enquiries.
messages.vehicle.POL_MOTO.name: Motorcycle Patrol
messages.vehicle.POL_MOTO.description: A pair of motorcycle officers, quick through city traffic: arrives early, directs traffic and escorts emergency vehicles.
messages.vehicle.POL_TRAFFIC.name: Traffic Patrol
messages.vehicle.POL_TRAFFIC.description: Specialises in traffic management and collision surveys: closures, diversions and reconstruction of events.
messages.vehicle.POL_VAN.name: Public Order Van
messages.vehicle.POL_VAN.description: A larger team for public order: cordons, holding wide areas and managing big crowds.
messages.vehicle.POL_K9.name: K9 Unit
messages.vehicle.POL_K9.description: Handler and trained dog for searching for people and sweeping areas and buildings.
messages.vehicle.POL_EOD.name: Bomb Disposal Unit
messages.vehicle.POL_EOD.description: Specialists who check suspicious items and make safe explosive devices and old ordnance.
messages.vehicle.POL_FORENSIC.name: Forensic Unit
messages.vehicle.POL_FORENSIC.description: Scene examination team: documents the scene and collects the evidence needed for the investigation.
messages.vehicle.POL_TACTICAL.name: Tactical Unit
messages.vehicle.POL_TACTICAL.description: Specialist officers for high-risk situations, such as barricaded persons or armed suspects.
messages.vehicle.POL_HELI.name: Police Helicopter
messages.vehicle.POL_HELI.description: Eyes in the sky for searches, pursuits and monitoring large areas, in contact with patrols on the ground.
messages.vehicle.AIB_PICKUP.name: Wildfire Pickup
messages.vehicle.AIB_PICKUP.description: Light off-road pickup with a wildfire skid. Quick on forest tracks, ideal for initial attack and mop-up.
messages.vehicle.AIB_TANKER.name: Forest Tanker
messages.vehicle.AIB_TANKER.description: Off-road tanker with a large water load for sustained attack on forest fires and for refilling the pickups.
messages.vehicle.AIB_COMMAND.name: Wildfire Command Post
messages.vehicle.AIB_COMMAND.description: Vehicle of the firefighting operations director: coordinates ground crews and guides the aircraft drops.
messages.vehicle.AIB_HELI.name: Firefighting Helicopter with Bucket
messages.vehicle.AIB_HELI.description: Helicopter with a slung bucket: scoops water from lakes and tanks and drops it precisely on the fire front.
messages.vehicle.AIB_PLANE.name: Amphibious Firefighting Aircraft
messages.vehicle.AIB_PLANE.description: Amphibious aircraft that scoops water while skimming and delivers high-volume drops. Requires an air base.
messages.vehicle.ALP_4X4.name: Alpine Rescue 4x4
messages.vehicle.ALP_4X4.description: Off-roader that takes the team and kit to the end of the forest roads, as close to the casualty as possible.
messages.vehicle.ALP_TEAM.name: Ground Team
messages.vehicle.ALP_TEAM.description: Alpine rescue technicians with a carry stretcher: they reach the casualty on foot and bring them down to the valley.
messages.vehicle.ALP_SNOW.name: Snowmobile / Quad
messages.vehicle.ALP_SNOW.description: Light vehicle for snow and rough ground: cuts approach times on pistes, trails and snowy slopes.
messages.vehicle.ALP_K9.name: Avalanche and Search Dog Unit
messages.vehicle.ALP_K9.description: Handler and dog trained to find people buried by avalanches or missing in the mountains.
messages.vehicle.ALP_HELI.name: Rescue Helicopter with Winch
messages.vehicle.ALP_HELI.description: Helicopter with a winch and a rescue technician: recovers the casualty straight from a rock face or rough terrain.
messages.ung.UNG_TOW.name: Tow Truck
messages.ung.UNG_TOW.description: Removes crashed or broken-down cars and light vehicles to clear the carriageway.
messages.ung.UNG_HEAVY_TOW.name: Heavy Tow Truck
messages.ung.UNG_HEAVY_TOW.description: Roadside recovery for lorries, buses and heavy vehicles: towing and recovery of large vehicles.
messages.ung.UNG_CRANE.name: Civilian Crane
messages.ung.UNG_CRANE.description: Crane from a private contractor to lift and remove loads, overturned vehicles and large trees.
messages.ung.UNG_GAS.name: Gas Emergency Crew
messages.ung.UNG_GAS.description: Gas network technicians: they isolate the leak, shut the valves and make the installation safe.
messages.ung.UNG_POWER.name: Electricity Emergency Crew
messages.ung.UNG_POWER.description: Power network technicians: they de-energise lines and substations and restore the supply.
messages.ung.UNG_WATER.name: Water Emergency Crew
messages.ung.UNG_WATER.description: Water company technicians: they shut off burst mains and restore the water and sewer network.
messages.ung.UNG_ROAD.name: Road Operator Patrol
messages.ung.UNG_ROAD.description: Road operator patrol: marks the obstruction, sets out signs and assists with lane closures.
messages.ung.UNG_ROAD_REPAIR.name: Road Maintenance
messages.ung.UNG_ROAD_REPAIR.description: Crew that repairs damaged road surfaces, barriers and signage.
messages.ung.UNG_SNOW.name: Snowplough
messages.ung.UNG_SNOW.description: Snow-clearing vehicle that reopens snowed-in roads and clears the way for emergency vehicles.
messages.ung.UNG_SALT.name: Gritter
messages.ung.UNG_SALT.description: Vehicle that treats the carriageway with salt against ice and frost.
messages.ung.UNG_MUNICIPAL.name: Municipal Debris Clearance Crew
messages.ung.UNG_MUNICIPAL.description: Council workers who clear branches, debris and mud from roads and public spaces after bad weather and incidents.
messages.ung.UNG_PC.name: Civil Protection Support
messages.ung.UNG_PC.description: Civil Protection volunteers for logistics and assistance to the population: refreshments, tents, lighting towers.
messages.rank.TRAINEE_DIRECTOR.name: Trainee Director
messages.rank.TRAINEE_DIRECTOR.description: Every control room starts here: show you can handle your first callouts.
messages.rank.LOCAL_COORDINATOR.name: Local Coordinator
messages.rank.LOCAL_COORDINATOR.description: Your municipality relies on you: coordinate crews and vehicles with a steady hand.
messages.rank.STATION_DIRECTOR.name: Station Director
messages.rank.STATION_DIRECTOR.description: Your station is a local landmark: help it grow and keep it ready at all times.
messages.rank.DISTRICT_DIRECTOR.name: District Director
messages.rank.DISTRICT_DIRECTOR.description: More municipalities, more responsibility: extend your coverage across the whole district.
messages.rank.OPERATIONS_MANAGER.name: Operations Manager
messages.rank.OPERATIONS_MANAGER.description: Several services now work together under your lead: make sure the right unit always turns out.
messages.rank.PROVINCIAL_DIRECTOR.name: Provincial Director
messages.rank.PROVINCIAL_DIRECTOR.description: The whole province looks to your control room: keep your reputation high.
messages.rank.SENIOR_DIRECTOR.name: Senior Director
messages.rank.SENIOR_DIRECTOR.description: Experience shows when things get hard: lead your control room through the most complex scenarios.
messages.rank.REGIONAL_COORDINATOR.name: Regional Coordinator
messages.rank.REGIONAL_COORDINATOR.description: Your view now spans a region: coordinate distant stations as one team.
messages.rank.REGIONAL_DIRECTOR.name: Regional Director
messages.rank.REGIONAL_DIRECTOR.description: From the coast to the mountains, the region is in good hands: yours.
messages.rank.INTERREGIONAL_DIRECTOR.name: Interregional Director
messages.rank.INTERREGIONAL_DIRECTOR.description: Regional borders no longer hold you back: bring help wherever it is needed.
messages.rank.NATIONAL_COORDINATOR.name: National Coordinator
messages.rank.NATIONAL_COORDINATOR.description: A nationwide rescue network is taking shape under your coordination.
messages.rank.NATIONAL_DIRECTOR.name: National Director
messages.rank.NATIONAL_DIRECTOR.description: Few make it this far: the whole country relies on your control room.
messages.rank.EMERITUS_DIRECTOR.name: Director Emeritus
messages.rank.EMERITUS_DIRECTOR.description: The highest rank: your career is an example for every control room.

messages.facility.FIRE_LOCAL_STATION.name: Local fire station
messages.facility.FIRE_LOCAL_STATION.description: A small Fire Brigade station with few vehicles and a limited crew. Covers basic rescue within the municipality.
messages.facility.FIRE_DETACHMENT.name: Fire detachment
messages.facility.FIRE_DETACHMENT.description: An operational Fire Brigade station with several crews and vehicles. Covers an area spanning multiple municipalities.
messages.facility.FIRE_COMMAND.name: Fire Brigade headquarters
messages.facility.FIRE_COMMAND.description: Provincial Fire Brigade headquarters with a large garage, workshop and special vehicles. Supports the most complex incidents.
messages.facility.FIRE_SPECIAL_HUB.name: Fire special operations hub
messages.facility.FIRE_SPECIAL_HUB.description: Home of the Fire Brigade specialist teams: rope rescue, CBRN, USAR, divers and the helicopter unit.
messages.facility.EMS_POST.name: Ambulance standby post
messages.facility.EMS_POST.description: A standby point for one basic ambulance. Cuts response times for medical calls in the area.
messages.facility.EMS_STATION.name: Ambulance station
messages.facility.EMS_STATION.description: An EMS station with several ambulances and crews. Handles routine medical calls across a wide area.
messages.facility.EMS_ADVANCED_STATION.name: Advanced ambulance station

messages.incident.ALP_INJURED_HIKER.title: Injured hiker
messages.incident.ALP_INJURED_HIKER.summary: Hiker with a lower-limb injury on a trail, unable to continue.
messages.incident.ALP_INJURED_HIKER.radio: Control to Alpine Rescue: injured hiker on a trail near {address}, {municipality}. Unable to walk, ground team with carrying stretcher requested.
incident.ALP_INJURED_HIKER.report.intros: Injured hiker reported on a trail near {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
Alpine Rescue requested for a person with a leg injury close to {address}.
Call from a hiking companion: person has fallen on the trail above {address}, {municipality}.
Request for help received for a hiker who can no longer walk in the {address} area.
A passing group reports a person on the ground with an ankle injury on the trail near {address}, {municipality}.
incident.ALP_INJURED_HIKER.report.detail: The casualty reports a sprained ankle after slipping on an uneven stretch.
The person complains of severe pain in one leg and cannot put weight on it.
The casualty is conscious and cooperative but unable to continue on foot.
The fall happened on a steep section of trail with wet ground.
incident.ALP_INJURED_HIKER.report.condit: The location cannot be reached by vehicle: approach on foot over rough terrain.
The area is wooded and a winch recovery could prove difficult.
The temperature is dropping and the person has been stationary for some time.
incident.ALP_INJURED_HIKER.report.closin: The caller is staying with the casualty and keeping the phone on for location tracking.
Ground team with carrying stretcher requested for transport down to the valley.
Caller advised to keep the person covered and sheltered until rescuers arrive.
messages.incident.ALP_INJURED_HIKER.outcome.succe: Casualty reached, immobilised and carried down to the valley by stretcher without complications.
messages.incident.ALP_INJURED_HIKER.outcome.parti: Casualty recovered, but the long carry-out delayed the handover to the medical crew.
messages.incident.ALP_INJURED_HIKER.outcome.failu: The team arrived late: the person's condition worsened in the cold and the recovery was handed over to other teams.
messages.incident.ALP_MISSING_HIKER.title: Missing hiker
messages.incident.ALP_MISSING_HIKER.summary: Hiker overdue or disoriented: search with ground teams and dog units.
messages.incident.ALP_MISSING_HIKER.radio: Control to Alpine Rescue: hiker overdue after setting out from {address}, {municipality}. Deploy ground teams and search dog units.
incident.ALP_MISSING_HIKER.report.intros: Hiker reported overdue after setting out from {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
Relatives request Alpine Rescue: person has not returned from a hike in the {address} area.
Call received from a hiker who has lost the trail above {address}, {municipality}.
The manager of a lodging reports a guest who has not returned from a walk towards {address}.
Search requested for a person missing in the woods above {address}, {municipality}.
incident.ALP_MISSING_HIKER.report.detail: The last phone contact was several hours ago; since then the phone has been unreachable.
The person's car has been found at the trailhead car park.
The person said they lost their bearings after leaving the marked trail.
The planned route is not known for certain: there is more than one possible direction.
incident.ALP_MISSING_HIKER.report.condit: The search area is large, wooded and includes stretches of rough terrain.
Visibility is decreasing and mobile coverage is patchy.
The person is equipped for a short hike only, with no gear for a night out.
incident.ALP_MISSING_HIKER.report.closin: Ground teams and dog units requested to sweep the trails in the area.
Relatives remain available at the starting point to provide a description and the person's habits.
Helicopter support for an aerial search to be considered.
messages.incident.ALP_MISSING_HIKER.outcome.succe: Person found in good condition by the ground teams and escorted back down to the valley.
messages.incident.ALP_MISSING_HIKER.outcome.parti: Person found after a lengthy search, cold and exhausted, and handed to the medical crew for checks.
messages.incident.ALP_MISSING_HIKER.outcome.failu: The search produced no result in the useful time frame: operations were handed over to other teams and continue over a wider area.
messages.incident.ALP_AVALANCHE.title: Avalanche, people possibly caught
messages.incident.ALP_AVALANCHE.summary: Avalanche release with people possibly caught: avalanche dog units and helicopter.
messages.incident.ALP_AVALANCHE.radio: Control to all Alpine Rescue units: avalanche near {address}, {municipality}, people possibly caught. Priority to avalanche dog units and helicopter.
incident.ALP_AVALANCHE.report.intros: Avalanche release reported near {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
A witness reports an avalanche on the slope above {address}, with people possibly caught.
Urgent Alpine Rescue response requested for an avalanche close to {address}, {municipality}.
Call from a ski tourer: snow slide along the route climbing from {address}.
Report received of a slide that swept a popular slope near {address}, {municipality}.
incident.ALP_AVALANCHE.report.details: The caller saw some tracks entering the release zone and none coming out.
Some people on scene have already started searching with their transceivers.
The debris field is wide and it is unclear whether everyone present has been accounted for.
One partially buried person has been freed by companions and is conscious.
incident.ALP_AVALANCHE.report.conditions: Further releases cannot be ruled out: assessment needed before anyone enters the debris.
The area can only be reached quickly by helicopter; the approach on foot is long.
Wind at altitude and changing visibility may affect winch operations.
incident.ALP_AVALANCHE.report.closings: Avalanche dog units and ground teams with probes and shovels requested to search the debris.
The caller is staying in a safe spot and is available to point out the last-seen point.
Coordination with the Emergency Medical Service requested for the handover of anyone recovered.
messages.incident.ALP_AVALANCHE.outcome.success: Debris searched quickly: those caught were located, freed and handed over to the medical crews.
messages.incident.ALP_AVALANCHE.outcome.partial: Those caught were recovered, but the prolonged time under the snow made hospital admission necessary.
messages.incident.ALP_AVALANCHE.outcome.failure: The response started late and worsening weather grounded the helicopter: the search was handed over to other teams and took far longer.
messages.incident.ALP_WALL_RECOVERY.title: Rock face recovery
messages.incident.ALP_WALL_RECOVERY.summary: Climber stuck on a rock face or via ferrata, unable to continue: technical recovery.
messages.incident.ALP_WALL_RECOVERY.radio: Control to Alpine Rescue: climber stuck on a rock face near {address}, {municipality}. Technical recovery requested, assess winch operation.
incident.ALP_WALL_RECOVERY.report.intros: Climber reported stuck on a rock face near {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
Alpine Rescue requested for a person cragfast on a via ferrata above {address}.
Call from a roped party in difficulty on the face overlooking {address}, {municipality}.
Request for help from a hiker who can neither go on nor turn back on the via ferrata at {address}.
People in the valley report shouts and light signals coming from the face above {address}, {municipality}.
incident.ALP_WALL_RECOVERY.report.detail: The person is secured but exhausted and unable to move unaided.
The party has gone off route and is stopped on a ledge with no way to abseil.
One member reports a limb injury after a short fall held by the rope.
The person has frozen with panic on an exposed section.
incident.ALP_WALL_RECOVERY.report.condit: The location is mid-face, in rough terrain, far from any equipped anchors.
The weather is deteriorating and the rock is getting wet.
Daylight is fading and the section is very exposed.
incident.ALP_WALL_RECOVERY.report.closin: Technical rescue team requested for recovery by assisted lowers or by winch.
The person is advised to stay clipped in and still until rescuers arrive.
The caller is staying on the phone and marking the position with a light.
messages.incident.ALP_WALL_RECOVERY.outcome.succe: Climber reached by the technicians, secured and winched off with no ill effects.
messages.incident.ALP_WALL_RECOVERY.outcome.parti: Recovery completed after a long operation on the face: the person was handed to the medical crew with early signs of hypothermia.
messages.incident.ALP_WALL_RECOVERY.outcome.failu: The team could not complete the recovery before dark: the person spent hours on the face and the operation was handed over to other teams.
messages.incident.ALP_STRANDED_GROUP.title: Group stranded at altitude
messages.incident.ALP_STRANDED_GROUP.summary: Group of hikers stranded by bad weather, darkness or snow, to be reached and escorted down.
messages.incident.ALP_STRANDED_GROUP.radio: Control to Alpine Rescue: group of hikers stranded at altitude near {address}, {municipality}. No injuries reported, escort down to the valley requested.
incident.ALP_STRANDED_GROUP.report.intro: Group of hikers reported stranded at altitude near {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
Alpine Rescue requested for several people caught by bad weather close to {address}.
Call from a group unable to continue because of snow on the trail above {address}, {municipality}.
Request for help from hikers caught by darkness on the ridge climbing from {address}.
A hut warden reports an expected group that has come to a halt along the route near {address}, {municipality}.
incident.ALP_STRANDED_GROUP.report.detai: The group lost the line of the trail in fog and decided to stay put.
Some members are tired and cold, but no one is reported injured.
Fresh snow has covered the waymarks and the group lacks suitable equipment.
The people have no head torches and do not feel safe descending alone.
incident.ALP_STRANDED_GROUP.report.condi: The section is exposed to the wind and offers no natural shelter.
Weather conditions currently rule out helicopter flight.
The descent trail has slippery passages over rough terrain.
incident.ALP_STRANDED_GROUP.report.closi: Ground team requested to reach the group and escort it down to the valley or the nearest hut.
The group is advised to stay together, stay put and keep covered, without attempting the descent.
The caller is sending coordinates from the phone and saving battery for further contact.
messages.incident.ALP_STRANDED_GROUP.outcome.succ: Group reached by the ground team and escorted safely down to the valley, everyone in good condition.
messages.incident.ALP_STRANDED_GROUP.outcome.part: Group escorted to the hut, but some chilled members needed a medical assessment.
messages.incident.ALP_STRANDED_GROUP.outcome.fail: The team arrived late: the group spent hours in the cold, some members' condition worsened and the descent was handed over to other teams.
messages.incident.MED_MINOR_ILLNESS.title: Minor illness
messages.incident.MED_MINOR_ILLNESS.summary: Person feeling mildly unwell, basic ambulance requested for assessment.
messages.incident.MED_MINOR_ILLNESS.radio: Control to all units: minor illness at {address}, {municipality}. Patient conscious and cooperative, basic ambulance requested.
incident.MED_MINOR_ILLNESS.report.intros: Medical assistance requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a person feeling unwell.
Call from {address}: person generally unwell, conscious.
Ambulance requested in {municipality}, {address}, for a minor illness.
A caller at {address} reports a person taken mildly ill.
incident.MED_MINOR_ILLNESS.report.detail: The patient reports dizziness and a feeling of weakness.
The person complains of nausea and a general malaise that came on recently.
A brief faint spell is reported; the person is now seated and answering questions.
The patient reports marked tiredness and light-headedness.
incident.MED_MINOR_ILLNESS.report.condit: The person is conscious, breathing normally and being looked after by the caller.
Easy access to the scene, no environmental hazards reported.
The patient is in a sheltered place and resting while waiting for the crew.
incident.MED_MINOR_ILLNESS.report.closin: The caller is staying with the patient and waiting for the crew.
Assessment on scene requested, with possible transport to the emergency department.
The call-taker gave waiting instructions: keep the person resting and call back if anything gets worse.
messages.incident.MED_MINOR_ILLNESS.outcome.succe: Patient assessed on scene and taken to the emergency department in stable condition.
messages.incident.MED_MINOR_ILLNESS.outcome.parti: Patient taken into care, but the long wait meant transport for further checks was needed.
messages.incident.MED_MINOR_ILLNESS.outcome.failu: The ambulance arrived late: the condition worsened and the patient was handed over to another crew.
messages.incident.MED_SEVERE_ILLNESS.title: Serious illness
messages.incident.MED_SEVERE_ILLNESS.summary: Person with chest pain or breathing difficulty, advanced care unit recommended.
messages.incident.MED_SEVERE_ILLNESS.radio: Control to all units: serious illness at {address}, {municipality}. Patient conscious but in distress, advanced care unit recommended.
incident.MED_SEVERE_ILLNESS.report.intro: Call from {address}: person suddenly taken ill with significant symptoms.
Urgent ambulance requested in {municipality}, {address}, for a person in considerable distress.
A family member at {address} reports a serious medical problem.
incident.MED_SEVERE_ILLNESS.report.detai: The patient reports chest pain that came on suddenly.
The person is struggling to breathe and finds it hard to speak.
Strong tightness in the chest and heavy sweating are reported.
The patient is very pale and exhausted, and the symptoms are said to be getting worse quickly.
incident.MED_SEVERE_ILLNESS.report.condi: The person is conscious but very weak, with bystanders helping.
The patient is sitting up and those present are following the call-taker's instructions.
Access is through the main entrance, where someone is waiting outside for the crew.
incident.MED_SEVERE_ILLNESS.report.closi: An advanced care unit with clinical staff is recommended.
The call-taker is staying on the line with the caller until the crew arrives.
The caller was asked not to let the patient move and to report any change at once.
messages.incident.MED_SEVERE_ILLNESS.outcome.succ: Patient stabilised on scene and taken to hospital for specialist care.
messages.incident.MED_SEVERE_ILLNESS.outcome.part: Patient taken to hospital, but without advanced support stabilisation took longer.
messages.incident.MED_SEVERE_ILLNESS.outcome.fail: Help arrived late: the patient's condition worsened and care was handed over to another advanced crew.
messages.incident.MED_UNCONSCIOUS.title: Unconscious person
messages.incident.MED_UNCONSCIOUS.summary: Person found unconscious at home or in the street, urgent assessment needed.
messages.incident.MED_UNCONSCIOUS.radio: Control to all units: unconscious person at {address}, {municipality}. Bystanders on scene, urgent response requested.
incident.MED_UNCONSCIOUS.report.intros: Urgent response requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a person who is not responding.
Call from {address}: person found on the ground, unconscious.
Ambulance requested in {municipality}, {address}, for a person who does not react when spoken to or touched.
A caller at {address} reports a collapsed person who is not responding.
incident.MED_UNCONSCIOUS.report.details: The person does not respond to voice but, according to the caller, is breathing.
The patient was found on the ground; it is not clear for how long.
A sudden loss of consciousness is reported, with no obvious cause.
The person partly comes round for brief moments but cannot answer.
incident.MED_UNCONSCIOUS.report.conditio: Bystanders have placed the person in the recovery position as instructed by the call-taker.
The caller does not know the patient's medical history.
The location is easy to reach and someone is waiting to show the crew the exact spot.
incident.MED_UNCONSCIOUS.report.closings: The call-taker is staying on the line to monitor breathing until help arrives.
An advanced care unit is recommended for assessment on scene.
Bystanders were asked not to leave the person alone and to report any change.
messages.incident.MED_UNCONSCIOUS.outcome.success: Patient reached quickly, regained consciousness and was taken to hospital for checks.
messages.incident.MED_UNCONSCIOUS.outcome.partial: Patient taken to hospital still to be assessed: the response took longer than expected.
messages.incident.MED_UNCONSCIOUS.outcome.failure: Help arrived late: the condition worsened and the patient was taken over by another crew.
messages.incident.MED_CARDIAC_ARREST.title: Suspected cardiac arrest
messages.incident.MED_CARDIAC_ARREST.summary: Person not responding and not breathing normally, phone-guided CPR, advanced life support needed.
messages.incident.MED_CARDIAC_ARREST.radio: Control to all units: suspected cardiac arrest at {address}, {municipality}. Bystander CPR in progress, advanced life support required immediately.
incident.MED_CARDIAC_ARREST.report.intro: Immediate response requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a person who is not responding and not breathing normally.
Call from {address}: person suddenly collapsed and is not reacting.
Highest priority in {municipality}, {address}: suspected cardiac arrest, witnessed.
A caller at {address} reports an unconscious person who is not breathing normally.
incident.MED_CARDIAC_ARREST.report.detai: Bystanders have started chest compressions, guided by the call-taker.
The call-taker is counting the compression rhythm over the phone.
The collapse happened in front of witnesses, who called straight away.
Bystanders were asked to check whether a defibrillator is available nearby.
incident.MED_CARDIAC_ARREST.report.condi: Several people on scene are taking turns with the compressions.
Someone is waiting outside to lead the crew in.
The person is lying on a firm surface and the space around has been cleared.
incident.MED_CARDIAC_ARREST.report.closi: An advanced life support unit is needed; the call-taker stays on the line until arrival.
The nearest available unit is requested in support of the advanced crew.
Compressions continue without interruption until the crew takes over.
messages.incident.MED_CARDIAC_ARREST.outcome.succ: Timely advanced life support: the patient was stabilised and taken to hospital.
messages.incident.MED_CARDIAC_ARREST.outcome.part: Patient taken to hospital in critical condition: advanced support only arrived later.
messages.incident.MED_CARDIAC_ARREST.outcome.fail: Help arrived too late to be effective: the patient was handed over in critical condition to another advanced crew.
messages.incident.MED_FALL.title: Fall
messages.incident.MED_FALL.summary: Person fallen at home or in the street, possible limb injury.
messages.incident.MED_FALL.radio: Control to all units: person fallen at {address}, {municipality}. Patient conscious, possible limb injury.
incident.MED_FALL.report.intros: Medical assistance requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a person who has fallen.
Call from {address}: elderly person has fallen and cannot get up.
Ambulance requested in {municipality}, {address}, for an accidental fall.
A caller at {address} reports a person who slipped and is still on the ground.
incident.MED_FALL.report.details: The patient complains of pain in one leg and cannot put weight on it.
The person reports pain in one arm after trying to break the fall.
The fall was caused by a slip; the patient has hip pain.
The person tripped and has pain in a wrist and a knee.
incident.MED_FALL.report.conditions: The patient is conscious and alert, and is staying on the ground until help arrives.
Bystanders have covered the person and have not moved them.
Easy access, with a family member waiting for the crew at the entrance.
incident.MED_FALL.report.closings: The caller was asked not to move the person until the ambulance arrives.
Assessment on scene and transport to the emergency department for checks are requested.
The caller is staying with the patient and will call back if anything changes.
messages.incident.MED_FALL.outcome.success: Patient carefully immobilised and taken to the emergency department for checks.
messages.incident.MED_FALL.outcome.partial: Patient taken to hospital, but the long wait on the ground added to the discomfort.
messages.incident.MED_FALL.outcome.failure: The ambulance arrived late: the condition worsened and the patient was handed over to another crew.
messages.incident.MED_MAJOR_TRAUMA.title: Major trauma
messages.incident.MED_MAJOR_TRAUMA.summary: Serious injury from a work accident or a fall from height, advanced team and trauma centre needed.
messages.incident.MED_MAJOR_TRAUMA.radio: Control to all units: major trauma at {address}, {municipality}. Advanced team requested, destination trauma centre.
incident.MED_MAJOR_TRAUMA.report.intros: Urgent response requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a serious accident.
Call from {address}: person seriously injured following an accident.
Highest priority in {municipality}, {address}: casualty with significant trauma.
A caller at {address} reports a serious accident with a person on the ground.
incident.MED_MAJOR_TRAUMA.report.details: A fall from height during work activity is reported.
The accident happened while machinery was in use; it has now been stopped.
The casualty is conscious but in a lot of pain and unable to move.
High-energy incident: the casualty is struggling to answer questions.
incident.MED_MAJOR_TRAUMA.report.conditi: Colleagues on scene have not moved the casualty and have made the area safe.
Work area with limited space: someone is waiting at the entrance to guide the crews.
Bystanders are keeping the casualty still and covered, as instructed by the call-taker.
incident.MED_MAJOR_TRAUMA.report.closing: An advanced team is needed, with transport to a trauma centre planned.
The caller was asked not to move the casualty and to keep access clear for vehicles.
The call-taker is staying on the line with the caller until the crew arrives.
messages.incident.MED_MAJOR_TRAUMA.outcome.succes: Casualty stabilised by the advanced team and taken to the trauma centre.
messages.incident.MED_MAJOR_TRAUMA.outcome.partia: Casualty taken to hospital, but without an advanced team the transfer to the trauma centre was delayed.
messages.incident.MED_MAJOR_TRAUMA.outcome.failur: Help arrived late: the condition deteriorated and the casualty was handed over to another advanced crew.
messages.incident.MED_MULTI_PATIENT.title: Multiple patients unwell
messages.incident.MED_MULTI_PATIENT.summary: Several people unwell at the same location, multiple ambulances and coordination needed.
messages.incident.MED_MULTI_PATIENT.radio: Control to all units: several people unwell at {address}, {municipality}. Multiple ambulances and on-scene coordination requested.
incident.MED_MULTI_PATIENT.report.intros: Medical assistance requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a number of people with the same symptoms.
Call from {address}: some people were taken ill at almost the same time.
Multiple ambulances requested in {municipality}, {address}, for a group of people feeling unwell.
A caller at {address} reports several people with nausea and dizziness.
incident.MED_MULTI_PATIENT.report.detail: Similar symptoms in several people: headache, nausea and drowsiness, carbon monoxide suspected.
The symptoms appeared after a shared meal during an event.
Some people complain of dizziness and weakness, others only feel slightly unwell.
The cause is not yet clear; symptoms appeared within a short time in several of those present.
incident.MED_MULTI_PATIENT.report.condit: Those present have been moved outdoors and gathered in one place.
The number of people involved is still being established.
Some people are agitated; a person in charge of the venue is assisting the call-taker.
incident.MED_MULTI_PATIENT.report.closin: Multiple ambulances and an advanced unit for on-scene triage are requested.
The caller was asked to ventilate the premises and keep everyone out until checks are complete.
The caller is staying on the line to update the number of people with symptoms.
messages.incident.MED_MULTI_PATIENT.outcome.succe: All patients assessed and taken to local hospitals in stable condition.
messages.incident.MED_MULTI_PATIENT.outcome.parti: Patients taken into care in stages: with few units available, transport took a long time.
messages.incident.MED_MULTI_PATIENT.outcome.failu: Too few resources and late arrivals: some people got worse and were handed over to crews from other stations.
messages.incident.MED_PEDIATRIC.title: Paediatric emergency
messages.incident.MED_PEDIATRIC.summary: Child with high fever, breathing difficulty or seizure, unit with paediatric expertise recommended.
messages.incident.MED_PEDIATRIC.radio: Control to all units: paediatric emergency at {address}, {municipality}. Child being cared for by parents, unit with paediatric expertise recommended.
incident.MED_PEDIATRIC.report.intros: Medical assistance requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a child who is unwell.
Call from {address}: parent very worried about their child's condition.
Urgent ambulance requested in {municipality}, {address}, for a paediatric patient.
A parent at {address} reports a child suddenly taken ill.
incident.MED_PEDIATRIC.report.details: The child has a high fever that will not come down and is very listless.
The child is struggling to breathe and has a persistent cough.
A seizure during a fever is reported; it has now stopped.
According to the parents, the child is drowsy and not very responsive.
incident.MED_PEDIATRIC.report.conditions: The child is in a parent's arms, and the parent is following the call-taker's instructions.
The parents are very anxious and the call-taker is reassuring them over the phone.
Easy access to the home, with a family member waiting for the crew at the entrance.
incident.MED_PEDIATRIC.report.closings: A unit with paediatric expertise is recommended.
The call-taker is staying on the line with the parent until the crew arrives.
The parents were asked to keep the child calm and to report any change at once.
messages.incident.MED_PEDIATRIC.outcome.success: Child stabilised and taken to the paediatric ward together with a parent.
messages.incident.MED_PEDIATRIC.outcome.partial: Child taken to hospital, but without a dedicated unit paediatric care started more slowly.
messages.incident.MED_PEDIATRIC.outcome.failure: Help arrived late: the condition worsened and the child was handed over to another crew.
messages.incident.FIRE_TRASH_BIN.title: Rubbish bin fire
messages.incident.FIRE_TRASH_BIN.summary: Flames from a street rubbish container.
messages.incident.FIRE_TRASH_BIN.radio: Control to all units: rubbish bin on fire at {address}, {municipality}. No persons involved.
incident.FIRE_TRASH_BIN.report.intros: Rubbish bin reported on fire at {address}.
A passer-by reports flames from a waste container at {address}, {municipality}.
Attendance requested for a bin alight at {address}.
Several callers report smoke and flames from a street bin at {address}.
A resident of {municipality} reports a small fire starting in the waste containers at {address}.
incident.FIRE_TRASH_BIN.report.details: The fire involves a recycling container.
Thick smoke and an acrid smell of burning plastic are coming from the bin.
The fire is currently confined to a single container.
The bin lid is already warped by the heat and flames can be seen from the road.
incident.FIRE_TRASH_BIN.report.condition: Cars are parked a few metres from the fire.
The bin stands right next to a hedge and the wall of a building.
The road is passable and no persons are reported involved.
incident.FIRE_TRASH_BIN.report.closings: The caller is staying on scene to point out the exact location.
A Fire Brigade crew is requested to extinguish the fire.
The caller has been advised to keep clear and not to attempt to put the fire out.
messages.incident.FIRE_TRASH_BIN.outcome.success: Fire quickly extinguished, no damage to nearby cars.
messages.incident.FIRE_TRASH_BIN.outcome.partial: Fire extinguished, but the flames damaged the adjacent containers.
messages.incident.FIRE_TRASH_BIN.outcome.failure: Crews arrived too late: the fire spread to the parked vehicles.
messages.incident.FIRE_VEHICLE.title: Car fire
messages.incident.FIRE_VEHICLE.summary: Car on fire on a street or in a car park.
messages.incident.FIRE_VEHICLE.radio: Control to all units: car fire at {address}, {municipality}. Check for persons and nearby vehicles.
incident.FIRE_VEHICLE.report.intros: A motorist reports a vehicle alight at {address}, {municipality}.
Attendance requested for a burning car at {address}.
Several callers report black smoke from a stationary car at {address}.
A resident of {municipality} reports that a parked vehicle has caught fire at {address}.
incident.FIRE_VEHICLE.report.details: The fire started in the engine bay and is spreading to the passenger compartment.
The vehicle is fully alight and some bangs can be heard, probably the tyres.
Thick smoke is coming from the bonnet; the driver got out unaided.
The vehicle's fuel type is unknown; an LPG system or traction battery cannot be ruled out.
incident.FIRE_VEHICLE.report.conditions: Other vehicles are parked in the immediate vicinity.
Smoke is drifting across the carriageway and reducing visibility for passing traffic.
Some bystanders have stopped to watch and need to be moved back.
incident.FIRE_VEHICLE.report.closings: The caller has been advised to move away from the vehicle and keep bystanders back.
A Fire Brigade crew is requested, with Police support for traffic control.
The caller confirms nobody is inside and is waiting for crews at a safe distance.
messages.incident.FIRE_VEHICLE.outcome.success: Fire extinguished, vehicle made safe and no damage to the surroundings.
messages.incident.FIRE_VEHICLE.outcome.partial: Fire extinguished, but the vehicle was destroyed and a nearby car suffered heat damage.
messages.incident.FIRE_VEHICLE.outcome.failure: Late response: the fire spread to other parked vehicles and the road stayed closed for a long time.
messages.incident.FIRE_DWELLING.title: Dwelling fire
messages.incident.FIRE_DWELLING.summary: Fire in a home with smoke in the stairwell and residents making their way out.
messages.incident.FIRE_DWELLING.radio: Control to all units: dwelling fire at {address}, {municipality}. Smoke in the stairwell, residents evacuating.
incident.FIRE_DWELLING.report.intros: A resident of the building reports smoke and flames from a flat at {address}, {municipality}.
Urgent attendance requested for a fire in a home at {address}.
Several callers in {municipality} report smoke coming from the windows of a dwelling at {address}.
A neighbour reports a strong smell of burning and smoke from a home at {address}.
incident.FIRE_DWELLING.report.details: The fire is believed to have started in the kitchen and is spreading to adjoining rooms.
Flames are visible at a window and black smoke is coming from the dwelling.
The furnishings of one room are alight; smoke inside is very thick.
The caller reports a fire that started from a household appliance, with smoke filling the home.
incident.FIRE_DWELLING.report.conditions: The stairwell is smoke-logged and some residents are making their way out to the street.
It is not certain that all occupants have left the dwelling.
Some people have breathed in smoke and are waiting outside the building.
incident.FIRE_DWELLING.report.closings: Residents have been advised to close doors, not to use the lift and to go outside.
Fire Brigade crews are requested, with an ambulance as a precaution.
The caller is waiting for crews at the entrance to point out the dwelling involved.
messages.incident.FIRE_DWELLING.outcome.success: Fire confined to the room of origin, residents safe and building ventilated.
messages.incident.FIRE_DWELLING.outcome.partial: Fire extinguished, but the home is uninhabitable and some people were handed to the ambulance crew for smoke inhalation.
messages.incident.FIRE_DWELLING.outcome.failure: Late response: the fire spread to neighbouring homes and the building was evacuated and declared unsafe.
messages.incident.FIRE_APARTMENT_BLOCK.title: Apartment block fire
messages.incident.FIRE_APARTMENT_BLOCK.summary: Developing fire in a multi-storey residential building, smoke on several floors.
messages.incident.FIRE_APARTMENT_BLOCK.radio: Control to all units: fire in a multi-storey residential building at {address}, {municipality}. Smoke on several floors, aerial ladder required.
incident.FIRE_APARTMENT_BLOCK.report.int: Fire reported in a multi-storey residential building at {address}.
Numerous callers in {municipality} report flames and smoke from a block of flats at {address}.
Urgent attendance requested for a fire in an apartment block at {address}, {municipality}.
A resident reports a rapidly developing fire in their block of flats at {address}.
A passing patrol reports thick smoke from the upper floors of a building at {address}.
incident.FIRE_APARTMENT_BLOCK.report.det: Flames are coming from the windows of a flat and reaching up towards the floor above.
Smoke has filled the stairwell and is spreading to several floors.
The fire involves a flat on the upper floors and is spreading along the facade.
The fire is developing and a column of smoke from the building can be seen from a distance.
incident.FIRE_APARTMENT_BLOCK.report.con: Some people are at balconies on the upper floors calling for help.
The stairwell is impassable because of smoke and several residents have remained in their flats.
Many residents have gathered in the street, among them elderly people and children.
incident.FIRE_APARTMENT_BLOCK.report.clo: Multiple Fire Brigade crews with an aerial ladder and ambulances are requested on scene.
Those trapped at home have been advised to close doors, seal the gaps and make themselves seen at a window.
Police support requested to close the road and keep access clear for emergency vehicles.
messages.incident.FIRE_APARTMENT_BLOCK.outcome.su: Residents brought to safety with the aerial ladder, fire contained to the flat of origin.
messages.incident.FIRE_APARTMENT_BLOCK.outcome.pa: Fire brought under control, but several flats are uninhabitable and some people were handed to ambulance crews.
messages.incident.FIRE_APARTMENT_BLOCK.outcome.fa: Without suitable appliances the fire spread to several floors: building evacuated and operations handed to reinforcing crews.
messages.incident.FIRE_WAREHOUSE.title: Warehouse fire
messages.incident.FIRE_WAREHOUSE.summary: Fire in an industrial warehouse with a tall smoke column; water supply needed.
messages.incident.FIRE_WAREHOUSE.radio: Control to all units: industrial warehouse fire at {address}, {municipality}. Smoke column visible from a distance, water tankers requested.
incident.FIRE_WAREHOUSE.report.intros: Fire reported in an industrial warehouse at {address}.
Numerous callers report a dense column of smoke from a warehouse at {address}, {municipality}.
Urgent attendance requested for a fire in a storage depot at {address}.
Security staff report flames inside a warehouse at {address}, {municipality}.
Callers in {municipality} report a large fire on an industrial estate, at {address}.
incident.FIRE_WAREHOUSE.report.details: The fire involves the goods stored inside and has reached the roof.
A column of black smoke is rising from the building and can be seen for kilometres.
The fire is spreading rapidly and part of the roof is at risk of collapse.
The stored material is unknown; plastics or flammable substances cannot be ruled out.
incident.FIRE_WAREHOUSE.report.condition: Staff on site are believed to have got out, but the roll call is still under way.
Neighbouring units are only a few metres away and exposed to the heat.
The local water mains have low flow and a tanker shuttle will be needed.
incident.FIRE_WAREHOUSE.report.closings: Multiple Fire Brigade crews, water tankers for supply and an aerial ladder are requested.
People in the area have been advised to keep windows closed and stay away.
A company representative is waiting for crews at the gate with site plans and information on the materials.
messages.incident.FIRE_WAREHOUSE.outcome.success: Fire confined to one part of the warehouse, neighbouring buildings protected and no persons involved.
messages.incident.FIRE_WAREHOUSE.outcome.partial: Fire under control after many hours: warehouse badly damaged, neighbouring buildings saved.
messages.incident.FIRE_WAREHOUSE.outcome.failure: Not enough resources or water: the warehouse was destroyed and the fire reached neighbouring buildings.
messages.incident.TECH_ELEVATOR.title: Persons trapped in lift
messages.incident.TECH_ELEVATOR.summary: Lift stopped between floors with people inside.
messages.incident.TECH_ELEVATOR.radio: Control to all units: persons trapped in a lift at {address}, {municipality}. No injuries reported.
incident.TECH_ELEVATOR.report.intros: Persons reported trapped in a lift at {address}.
Attendance requested for a stopped lift with people inside at {address}, {municipality}.
A resident reports that the lift in the building at {address} has stopped with some people inside.
Call from inside a lift car stuck between two floors at {address}.
The caretaker of a building in {municipality} reports a lift stuck with people inside, at {address}.
incident.TECH_ELEVATOR.report.details: The car has stopped between two floors and the doors will not open.
The lift stopped after a power cut.
The alarm button has been pressed, but the maintenance engineer cannot be reached.
The people inside are talking to those on the landing through the doors.
incident.TECH_ELEVATOR.report.conditions: Those inside are well, but one of them is rather distressed.
It is hot inside the car and the people have been stuck for some time.
Among the occupants is an elderly person who is struggling to stay standing.
incident.TECH_ELEVATOR.report.closings: A Fire Brigade crew is requested to open the lift car.
The occupants have been advised to stay calm and not to force the doors.
The caller is waiting for crews at the entrance with the keys to the machine room.
messages.incident.TECH_ELEVATOR.outcome.success: Car brought level with the floor and people released within minutes, all in good condition.
messages.incident.TECH_ELEVATOR.outcome.partial: People released after a long wait; one was handed to the ambulance crew after feeling slightly unwell.
messages.incident.TECH_ELEVATOR.outcome.failure: Response came too late: the occupants were released by the lift engineer after considerable distress.
messages.incident.TECH_FALLEN_TREE.title: Fallen tree
messages.incident.TECH_FALLEN_TREE.summary: Tree or large branch down on the roadway, to be cut up, cleared and made safe.
messages.incident.TECH_FALLEN_TREE.radio: Control to all units: tree down across the road at {address}, {municipality}. Cutting and removal required, no persons involved at this time.
incident.TECH_FALLEN_TREE.report.intros: Report of a tree down on the roadway at {address}.
Assistance requested for a large branch that has come down at {address}, {municipality}.
Multiple calls report a tree brought down by the wind at {address}.
A passer-by reports a fallen tree blocking the road at {address}, {municipality}.
Local Police request the Fire Brigade for a fallen tree at {address}.
incident.TECH_FALLEN_TREE.report.details: The trunk is lying across the carriageway and vehicles cannot get past.
A large branch has broken off and landed on some parked cars.
The tree has been uprooted and is resting partly on a property fence.
Broken branches are still hanging in the crown and could come down as well.
incident.TECH_FALLEN_TREE.report.conditi: Traffic is slow and vehicles are being forced to turn around.
Strong winds still blowing in the area, other trees appear unstable.
Overhead cables nearby, to be checked before any cutting.
incident.TECH_FALLEN_TREE.report.closing: The caller is staying on scene and keeping passers-by away.
Chainsaw work and clearance of the roadway requested.
The area should be cordoned off until operations are complete.
messages.incident.TECH_FALLEN_TREE.outcome.succes: Tree cut up and removed, road quickly reopened to traffic.
messages.incident.TECH_FALLEN_TREE.outcome.partia: Carriageway cleared, but the road remains single-lane until the trunk is fully removed.
messages.incident.TECH_FALLEN_TREE.outcome.failur: The response came too late: more branches came down and the road stays closed for a long time, with damage to parked vehicles.
messages.incident.TECH_FLOODING.title: Flooding
messages.incident.TECH_FLOODING.summary: Premises or underpass flooded after heavy rain or a burst pipe, to be pumped out.
messages.incident.TECH_FLOODING.radio: Control to all units: flooding at {address}, {municipality}. Pumping out required, check whether anyone is inside the premises.
incident.TECH_FLOODING.report.intros: Assistance requested for premises taking in water at {address}, {municipality}.
A resident reports rapidly rising water at {address}.
Multiple calls for flooding in progress at {address}, {municipality}.
Following the heavy storm, pumping out is requested at {address}.
incident.TECH_FLOODING.report.details: Water has entered the basement level, cellars and garages are under water.
The road underpass is flooded and no longer passable.
A burst pipe has flooded the ground-floor premises.
The drains are overwhelmed and water from the street is running into premises at pavement level.
incident.TECH_FLOODING.report.conditions: The water level is rising slowly but steadily.
Electrical panels and meters are located in the affected rooms, power needs to be isolated.
Some residents are trying to move their belongings to safety.
incident.TECH_FLOODING.report.closings: Motor pumps and electric submersible pumps requested for pumping out.
The caller will meet the crews at the building entrance.
Nobody should enter the flooded rooms until the crews arrive.
messages.incident.TECH_FLOODING.outcome.success: Premises pumped out and made safe, damage kept to a minimum.
messages.incident.TECH_FLOODING.outcome.partial: Water pumped out, but part of the premises remains unusable and stored belongings are damaged.
messages.incident.TECH_FLOODING.outcome.failure: The response came too late: the water reached the building services and the area stays unusable for days.
messages.incident.TECH_UNSAFE_ROOF.title: Unsafe roof
messages.incident.TECH_UNSAFE_ROOF.summary: Loose tiles, cornice or sheet metal at risk of falling onto the street, aerial ladder needed.
messages.incident.TECH_UNSAFE_ROOF.radio: Control to all units: unstable elements on the roof of a building at {address}, {municipality}. Aerial ladder requested, close off the pavement below.
incident.TECH_UNSAFE_ROOF.report.intros: Report of unstable elements on the roof of a building at {address}.
Assistance requested for parts of a roof at risk of falling at {address}, {municipality}.
A passer-by reports pieces of masonry falling onto the pavement at {address}.
A building manager requests an urgent roof inspection at {address}, {municipality}.
Multiple calls report material hanging precariously above the street at {address}.
incident.TECH_UNSAFE_ROOF.report.details: Several tiles have slipped and are overhanging the gutter above the pavement.
A section of cornice shows obvious cracks and has already shed some fragments.
A roofing sheet has lifted and is flapping in the wind.
A length of guttering has come away and is hanging from the facade.
incident.TECH_UNSAFE_ROOF.report.conditi: Busy street with a constant flow of pedestrians below the building.
Gusting wind is making the material even less stable.
Limited room to position the aerial ladder, parked cars in the way.
incident.TECH_UNSAFE_ROOF.report.closing: Aerial ladder requested to remove the unstable parts.
The caller has moved passers-by away and is waiting for the crews on scene.
The area below should be cordoned off until the inspection is complete.
messages.incident.TECH_UNSAFE_ROOF.outcome.succes: Unstable parts removed using the aerial ladder, area made safe and reopened to pedestrians.
messages.incident.TECH_UNSAFE_ROOF.outcome.partia: Loose material removed, but the pavement remains cordoned off pending repair work.
messages.incident.TECH_UNSAFE_ROOF.outcome.failur: The response came too late: some of the material fell into the street and damaged parked vehicles, area closed off.
messages.incident.TECH_ANIMAL_RESCUE.title: Animal rescue
messages.incident.TECH_ANIMAL_RESCUE.summary: Animal stuck or in difficulty, to be recovered safely.
messages.incident.TECH_ANIMAL_RESCUE.radio: Control to all units: recovery of an animal in difficulty requested at {address}, {municipality}. No persons involved, non-urgent response.
incident.TECH_ANIMAL_RESCUE.report.intro: Report of an animal in difficulty at {address}.
Assistance requested to recover a trapped animal at {address}, {municipality}.
A member of the public asks for help with an animal unable to free itself at {address}.
An owner reports that their animal has become stuck at {address}, {municipality}.
Passers-by report an animal in danger at {address}.
incident.TECH_ANIMAL_RESCUE.report.detai: A cat has climbed a tall tree and cannot get back down.
A dog has slipped into a steep-sided ditch and cannot climb out.
A horse has ended up in an irrigation channel and is standing still in shallow water.
An animal is caught in a fence and cannot work itself free.
incident.TECH_ANIMAL_RESCUE.report.condi: The animal appears frightened but alert.
The spot is hard to reach without proper equipment.
A few people have gathered and are trying to approach the animal.
incident.TECH_ANIMAL_RESCUE.report.closi: The caller is staying on scene to point out the exact location.
Bystanders are advised not to attempt the rescue themselves.
Veterinary service support may be required.
messages.incident.TECH_ANIMAL_RESCUE.outcome.succ: Animal recovered in good condition and returned to its owner.
messages.incident.TECH_ANIMAL_RESCUE.outcome.part: Animal recovered after a lengthy operation and handed to the vet for a check-up.
messages.incident.TECH_ANIMAL_RESCUE.outcome.fail: The response came too late: the frightened animal moved off and the recovery is handed over to the veterinary service.
messages.incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_MINOR.title: Road traffic collision
messages.incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_MINOR.summary: Collision with nobody trapped: vehicles to be made safe and the carriageway cleaned up.
messages.incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_MINOR.radio: Control to all units: road traffic collision at {address}, {municipality}. Nobody trapped, vehicles and roadway to be made safe.
incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_MINOR.report.intr: Report of a road traffic collision at {address}.
Assistance requested for a collision between vehicles at {address}, {municipality}.
A driver reports a collision with vehicles stopped in the carriageway at {address}.
Police request the Fire Brigade for a collision at {address}, {municipality}.
Multiple calls report a collision that has just happened at {address}.
incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_MINOR.report.deta: The occupants got out of the vehicles unaided, nobody is trapped.
One vehicle is leaking fluids onto the road surface, carriageway slippery.
A car has struck the crash barrier and is partly blocking the lane.
Light smoke is coming from the engine bay of one vehicle, battery to be disconnected.
incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_MINOR.report.cond: Heavy traffic with queues building in both directions.
Debris and fragments scattered across the roadway.
Those involved are waiting at the roadside in a protected position.
incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_MINOR.report.clos: Vehicles to be made safe, a recovery truck will follow.
Absorbent material requested to clean up the road surface.
Approaching traffic should be warned of the collision.
messages.incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_MINOR.outcome.suc: Vehicles made safe and carriageway cleaned up, traffic flowing again in a short time.
messages.incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_MINOR.outcome.par: Vehicles made safe, but cleaning the road surface took time and traffic stayed slow for a long while.
messages.incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_MINOR.outcome.fai: The response came too late: fluids on the road caused a second rear-end collision and the road remains closed.
messages.incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_TRAPPED.title: Collision with person trapped
messages.incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_TRAPPED.summary: Road traffic collision with a person trapped in the vehicle: extrication alongside the Emergency Medical Service.
messages.incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_TRAPPED.radio: Control to all units: road traffic collision with a person trapped at {address}, {municipality}. Urgent extrication required, Emergency Medical Service en route.
incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_TRAPPED.report.in: Report of a serious road traffic collision with a person trapped at {address}.
Urgent assistance requested for a casualty stuck inside a vehicle at {address}, {municipality}.
The Emergency Medical Service requests the Fire Brigade for an extrication at {address}.
Multiple calls report a heavy collision with a person unable to get out of the vehicle at {address}, {municipality}.
A witness reports a badly damaged vehicle with a person inside at {address}.
incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_TRAPPED.report.de: The doors are deformed and will not open, the person is conscious and responding.
The vehicle left the road and came to rest on its side.
The impact with a heavy goods vehicle has deformed the front of the passenger compartment.
The vehicle struck a fixed obstacle and the dashboard is pinning the driver's legs.
incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_TRAPPED.report.co: Fuel leaking onto the road surface, fire risk to be kept under control.
Traffic at a standstill, difficult access for emergency vehicles.
Some drivers have stopped and are staying with the casualty until help arrives.
incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_TRAPPED.report.cl: Hydraulic spreader and cutters requested for the extrication.
Medical personnel are on their way and ask for rapid access to the patient.
The person should not be moved until the crews arrive.
messages.incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_TRAPPED.outcome.s: Person extricated quickly and handed over to medical personnel, vehicle made safe.
messages.incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_TRAPPED.outcome.p: Extrication successful but prolonged: the patient was handed over to the Emergency Medical Service after a long wait.
messages.incident.ROAD_ACCIDENT_TRAPPED.outcome.f: The response came too late: the extrication was completed by other crews and the patient's condition worsened during the wait.
messages.incident.MULTI_ROAD_ACCIDENT.title: Multi-vehicle road accident
messages.incident.MULTI_ROAD_ACCIDENT.summary: Serious multi-vehicle collision on a main road: people trapped, several injured, road blocked.
messages.incident.MULTI_ROAD_ACCIDENT.radio: Control to all units: multi-vehicle road accident at {address}, {municipality}. People trapped and several injured, joint response required from Fire Brigade, Emergency Medical Service and Police.
incident.MULTI_ROAD_ACCIDENT.report.intr: Serious road accident involving several vehicles reported at {address}, {municipality}.
Multiple callers report a collision between several vehicles at {address}.
Urgent response requested for a multi-vehicle accident at {address}, {municipality}.
A passing driver reports a chain collision at {address}.
A patrol passing by reports an accident involving several vehicles at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_ROAD_ACCIDENT.report.deta: Some people are trapped inside their vehicles and cannot get out on their own.
Several injured people are at the roadside, being looked after by other drivers until help arrives.
One of the vehicles has overturned and fluids are leaking onto the carriageway.
The vehicles involved block the whole carriageway and the wreckage makes it hard to reach the occupants.
incident.MULTI_ROAD_ACCIDENT.report.cond: The road is completely blocked and long queues are building in both directions.
Heavy traffic is making it difficult for emergency vehicles to get close; a clear lane is needed.
Debris is scattered across the road and vehicles are stopped in dangerous positions; the scene must be made safe.
incident.MULTI_ROAD_ACCIDENT.report.clos: Fire Brigade requested for extrication, several ambulance crews, and Police for traffic control and the accident survey.
The caller stays on the line and says more ambulances and a road closure are needed.
Coordination between services on scene, traffic management and an accident survey are required.
messages.incident.MULTI_ROAD_ACCIDENT.outcome.suc: Trapped people released and the injured handed to medical care; survey completed and road reopened in good time.
messages.incident.MULTI_ROAD_ACCIDENT.outcome.par: The injured were treated and transported, but missing services stretched the operation and the road stayed closed for a long time.
messages.incident.MULTI_ROAD_ACCIDENT.outcome.fai: Coordination broke down: care for the injured was delayed, traffic was gridlocked and the incident was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_FIRE_WITH_CASUALTIES.summ: Building fire with people affected by smoke: rescue, medical care and a cordon are needed.
messages.incident.MULTI_FIRE_WITH_CASUALTIES.radi: Control to all units: building fire at {address}, {municipality}, with people affected by smoke. Joint response required from Fire Brigade, Emergency Medical Service and Police.
incident.MULTI_FIRE_WITH_CASUALTIES.repo: Building fire reported at {address}, {municipality}, with people affected by smoke.
Multiple callers report flames and thick smoke coming from a building at {address}.
Urgent response requested for a building fire with people inside at {address}, {municipality}.
A resident reports a fire in their block at {address}, with neighbours struggling because of the smoke.
A passer-by reports black smoke from a building at {address}, {municipality}, with people at the windows.
Smoke has filled the stairwell and some people cannot reach the exit.
Some occupants are already in the street, coughing and short of breath.
The fire involves a unit on the upper floors and smoke is spreading to neighbouring flats.
Some people are calling for help from their balconies, waiting for rescuers to reach them.
Many residents and onlookers have gathered at the entrance and need to be moved away.
The street is narrow with parked cars, making access difficult for heavy appliances.
Elderly people and people with reduced mobility also live in the building.
Fire Brigade requested for firefighting and rescue, several ambulance crews, and Police to cordon off the area.
The caller has been told to stay outside and not to go back into the building.
An assembly point for evacuees and closure of the street to traffic are needed.
messages.incident.MULTI_FIRE_WITH_CASUALTIES.outc: Fire extinguished, occupants brought to safety and smoke casualties treated by medics; the area was managed safely.
Fire under control and people evacuated, but without all services the care of casualties and control of the area were slow.
Incomplete, late response: the fire spread to other flats and the rescue of occupants was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_GAS_LEAK.title: Gas leak
messages.incident.MULTI_GAS_LEAK.summary: Gas leak in a building or street: precautionary evacuation, cordon and gas company engineers requested.
messages.incident.MULTI_GAS_LEAK.radio: Control to all units: gas leak at {address}, {municipality}. Precautionary evacuation and cordon required; the gas company's emergency team has also been requested.
incident.MULTI_GAS_LEAK.report.intros: Several residents report a strong smell of gas at {address}.
Response requested for a suspected gas leak at {address}, {municipality}.
A worker reports a gas pipe damaged during roadworks at {address}.
A building manager reports a smell of gas throughout the block at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_GAS_LEAK.report.details: The smell is strong in the communal areas and along the street.
A continuous hissing sound can be heard from the meter area.
Some people are complaining of headaches and nausea and have gone outside.
The leak appears to come from an underground main close to the building.
incident.MULTI_GAS_LEAK.report.condition: There are homes and businesses open to the public in the area.
Several residents are still indoors and need to be moved away in an orderly manner.
Vehicles and pedestrians are still using the street; possible ignition sources must be removed.
incident.MULTI_GAS_LEAK.report.closings: Fire Brigade requested for gas readings, Police to cordon off the area, and medics on standby.
The caller has been advised not to operate any switches and to go outside.
The gas company's emergency team has been called out to isolate the main.
messages.incident.MULTI_GAS_LEAK.outcome.success: Leak isolated, area evacuated and checked without consequences; residents returned after the all-clear.
messages.incident.MULTI_GAS_LEAK.outcome.partial: Leak stopped, but the incomplete evacuation and cordon prolonged the disruption for residents.
messages.incident.MULTI_GAS_LEAK.outcome.failure: Late, uncoordinated response: the area remained at risk for a long time and the incident was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_SEVERE_WEATHER.title: Severe storm: multiple incidents
messages.incident.MULTI_SEVERE_WEATHER.summary: Severe storm cell: fallen trees, flooded underpasses, stranded motorists and many calls from the same area.
messages.incident.MULTI_SEVERE_WEATHER.radio: Control to all units: severe weather in the area of {address}, {municipality}. Fallen trees, flooding and stranded motorists, numerous calls queued.
incident.MULTI_SEVERE_WEATHER.report.int: Widespread damage reported after a violent storm in the area of {address}, {municipality}.
Numerous calls within minutes about severe weather around {address}.
Several responses requested for torrential rain and strong gusts at {address}, {municipality}.
A driver reports being stranded by floodwater near {address}.
A patrol in the area reports fallen trees and flooded roads around {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_SEVERE_WEATHER.report.det: Some trees have fallen onto the carriageway and onto parked vehicles.
An underpass is flooded and some cars are stuck in the water with people on board.
Branches and materials torn loose by the wind are blocking the road and pavements.
Water has entered basements and ground-floor premises at several points in the area.
incident.MULTI_SEVERE_WEATHER.report.con: Heavy rain and poor visibility; traffic is moving very slowly.
Several roads in the area are impassable and crews must use alternative routes.
Some cold and frightened people are waiting for help beside their vehicles.
incident.MULTI_SEVERE_WEATHER.report.clo: Fire Brigade requested for tree cutting and pumping, Police for road closures, and medics for the stranded people.
Calls are increasing; priorities must be set and the most critical points covered.
Callers have been advised not to cross flooded stretches and to stay under cover.
messages.incident.MULTI_SEVERE_WEATHER.outcome.su: Stranded people brought to safety, roads cleared and critical points covered until the storm passed.
messages.incident.MULTI_SEVERE_WEATHER.outcome.pa: The most urgent situations were resolved, but several requests were left waiting for a long time.
messages.incident.MULTI_SEVERE_WEATHER.outcome.fa: Too few resources arriving too late: many requests went unanswered and the area was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_PERSON_IN_WATER.title: Person in the water
messages.incident.MULTI_PERSON_IN_WATER.summary: Person in difficulty in the water close to shore: water rescue and medical care required.
