messages.incident.MULTI_PERSON_IN_WATER.radio: Control to all units: person in difficulty in the water near {address}, {municipality}. Water rescue, Emergency Medical Service and Police required on scene.
incident.MULTI_PERSON_IN_WATER.report.in: Person in difficulty in the water reported near {address}, {municipality}.
A passer-by reports a person calling for help in the water by {address}.
Urgent response requested for a person in the water close to shore at {address}, {municipality}.
Multiple callers report a person being carried by the current in the area of {address}.
A witness reports seeing a person fall into the water at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_PERSON_IN_WATER.report.de: The person is struggling to stay afloat and cannot reach the shore.
The person is holding on to a fixed object and waiting for help, but looks exhausted.
The current is slowly carrying the person away from where they were first seen.
Witnesses are keeping the person in sight from the bank and pointing out their position.
incident.MULTI_PERSON_IN_WATER.report.co: The water is cold and the bank at that point is steep and slippery.
Some bystanders want to go into the water to help and must be held back.
Vehicle access to the shore is limited; the last stretch has to be covered on foot.
incident.MULTI_PERSON_IN_WATER.report.cl: Fire Brigade water rescue team requested, plus an ambulance crew and Police to manage bystanders.
The caller has been advised not to enter the water and to keep the person in sight.
Immediate medical care is needed on recovery, with attention to cold exposure.
messages.incident.MULTI_PERSON_IN_WATER.outcome.s: Person recovered from the water and handed to the medics in good general condition.
messages.incident.MULTI_PERSON_IN_WATER.outcome.p: Person recovered, but the delay of some services meant longer medical care was needed.
messages.incident.MULTI_PERSON_IN_WATER.outcome.f: Help arrived late: the person was reached by other rescuers and the case was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_HAZMAT_SPILL.title: Hazardous substance spill
messages.incident.MULTI_HAZMAT_SPILL.summary: Hazardous substance leaking from a lorry or at a plant: CBRN team, exclusion zone and decontamination.
messages.incident.MULTI_HAZMAT_SPILL.radio: Control to all units: hazardous substance leak at {address}, {municipality}. CBRN team, exclusion zone and medical cover required; approach from upwind.
incident.MULTI_HAZMAT_SPILL.report.intro: Hazardous substance leaking from a heavy goods vehicle reported at {address}, {municipality}.
A driver reports a spill from his tanker at {address}.
Urgent response requested for a chemical release at {address}, {municipality}.
Staff at a company report a leak from a container of hazardous substances at {address}.
A patrol on scene confirms liquid leaking from a road tanker at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_HAZMAT_SPILL.report.detai: The liquid is spreading across the yard and towards the drains.
A cloud of pungent vapour is visible near the point of the leak.
The vehicle carries orange hazard plates; the product still has to be positively identified.
Some people who were nearby are complaining of eye and throat irritation.
incident.MULTI_HAZMAT_SPILL.report.condi: There are homes and businesses nearby; moving people away must be considered.
The wind is pushing the vapours towards the road; the approach must be made from upwind.
Traffic is still flowing a short distance away and must be stopped as soon as possible.
incident.MULTI_HAZMAT_SPILL.report.closi: Fire Brigade CBRN team requested, Police for the exclusion zone, and medics for exposed people.
The caller has been advised to move away, stay upwind and not touch the product.
A decontamination area must be set up and the substance identified.
messages.incident.MULTI_HAZMAT_SPILL.outcome.succ: Leak stopped, substance contained and recovered; exposed people decontaminated and treated, area reopened safely.
messages.incident.MULTI_HAZMAT_SPILL.outcome.part: Leak contained, but the incomplete exclusion zone and decontamination prolonged the operation and the closure of the area.
messages.incident.MULTI_HAZMAT_SPILL.outcome.fail: Late response without the services needed: the substance spread over a wider area and the clean-up was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_BUILDING_COLLAPSE.title: Partial building collapse
messages.incident.MULTI_BUILDING_COLLAPSE.summary: Partial collapse of a building with people possibly missing: USAR search with dog units and an advanced medical post.
messages.incident.MULTI_BUILDING_COLLAPSE.radio: Control to all units: partial building collapse at {address}, {municipality}. People possibly missing; USAR teams, search dogs, advanced medical post and a cordon required.
Partial collapse of a building reported at {address}, {municipality}.
Multiple callers report a loud bang followed by part of a building giving way at {address}.
Urgent response requested for a building collapse with people possibly involved at {address}, {municipality}.
A resident reports that part of their block has collapsed at {address}.
A patrol on scene confirms that a section of a building has given way at {address}, {municipality}.
Part of the structure has collapsed and rubble is covering the street.
Some residents are unaccounted for and may be under the rubble.
There is a smell of gas; the collapse may have been caused by an explosion.
Some people got out of the building on their own and are in the street, shaken and in need of assistance.
The part still standing looks unstable, with a risk of further collapse.
Many residents and onlookers are approaching the rubble and must be moved back.
Thick dust in the air and utilities still live; quiet and order are needed for the search.
Fire Brigade USAR teams and dog units requested, plus an advanced medical post and Police for the cordon.
The caller has been advised to move away from the building and to report anyone unaccounted for.
A headcount, isolation of utilities and coordination of all services on scene are required.
messages.incident.MULTI_BUILDING_COLLAPSE.outcome: Everyone located and cared for, area made safe and the search concluded successfully.
People were located and rescued, but without all the resources the search went on for a long time.
Too few resources arriving too late: the search was slowed down and command of the operation was handed to other units.
messages.incident.POL_BRAWL.title: Street brawl
messages.incident.POL_BRAWL.summary: Fight between several people outside a licensed venue.
messages.incident.POL_BRAWL.radio: Control to all units: brawl reported at {address}, {municipality}. Several people involved, attendance required to restore order.
incident.POL_BRAWL.report.intros: Brawl involving several people reported at {address}.
Attendance requested at {address}, {municipality}, for an argument that has escalated outside a venue.
Multiple callers report a fight in progress at {address}.
The manager of a venue at {address} reports a heated dispute between some customers.
Residents of {address}, {municipality}, report shouting and a group of people squaring up in the street.
incident.POL_BRAWL.report.details: The dispute reportedly began inside the venue and has carried on onto the pavement.
Two groups are facing off with pushing and shoving, while bystanders try to separate them.
Those involved appear highly agitated and are ignoring the venue staff.
Some of those involved are walking away along the street.
incident.POL_BRAWL.report.conditions: Several onlookers have stopped to watch and are blocking the way.
The street is narrow, with parked cars and outdoor tables.
Poor lighting and a lot of people leaving the nearby venues.
incident.POL_BRAWL.report.closings: The caller is staying on the line and will point out the exact spot to the patrol.
A patrol is requested to separate the parties and identify those present.
Minor injuries cannot be ruled out: consider medical support.
messages.incident.POL_BRAWL.outcome.success: Order restored, those involved identified and no significant consequences.
messages.incident.POL_BRAWL.outcome.partial: Brawl broken up, but some of those involved left before they could be identified.
messages.incident.POL_BRAWL.outcome.failure: Patrols arrived late and the fight had spread: damage to the venue and several people handed over to medical crews.
messages.incident.POL_THEFT_IN_PROGRESS.title: Theft in progress
messages.incident.POL_THEFT_IN_PROGRESS.summary: Witness reports a theft in progress at a shop, a home or a vehicle.
messages.incident.POL_THEFT_IN_PROGRESS.radio: Control to all units: theft in progress reported at {address}, {municipality}. Witness on the line, approach with caution.
incident.POL_THEFT_IN_PROGRESS.report.in: A witness reports suspicious persons forcing an entrance at {address}, {municipality}.
Urgent attendance requested at {address} for a suspected theft in progress.
A resident of {address} reports sounds of a break-in coming from a neighbouring property.
Call from {address}, {municipality}: someone has reportedly entered a property without permission.
incident.POL_THEFT_IN_PROGRESS.report.de: The witness noticed a forced shutter and movement inside a shop.
Unknown persons have reportedly entered a flat whose owners are away.
A person is tampering with a parked car that has a broken window.
An accomplice appears to be waiting nearby in a vehicle with the engine running.
incident.POL_THEFT_IN_PROGRESS.report.co: The area is poorly lit and almost deserted at this hour.
There are several escape routes through inner courtyards and side streets.
The witness is watching from a distance and has not been noticed.
incident.POL_THEFT_IN_PROGRESS.report.cl: The caller is staying on the line to update on the suspects' movements.
Several patrols are requested to close off the escape routes.
A silent approach without sirens is recommended.
messages.incident.POL_THEFT_IN_PROGRESS.outcome.s: Suspects detained at the scene and all stolen property recovered.
messages.incident.POL_THEFT_IN_PROGRESS.outcome.p: Theft interrupted, but the suspects fled with part of the stolen goods.
messages.incident.POL_THEFT_IN_PROGRESS.outcome.f: The suspects were long gone when patrols arrived: theft completed, investigation opened.
messages.incident.POL_ALARM_ACTIVATION.title: Burglar alarm activated
messages.incident.POL_ALARM_ACTIVATION.summary: Intruder alarm triggered at night at a shop or business: check required.
messages.incident.POL_ALARM_ACTIVATION.radio: Control to all units: burglar alarm activated at {address}, {municipality}. On-site check requested.
incident.POL_ALARM_ACTIVATION.report.int: A security company reports an intruder alarm activation at {address}, {municipality}.
Residents of {address} report an alarm siren that has been sounding for several minutes.
Check requested at {address}, {municipality}, for an alarm triggered at closed premises.
Report received of an active alarm at a warehouse at {address}.
incident.POL_ALARM_ACTIVATION.report.det: The system detected a rear entrance of the building being opened.
The external siren is sounding and the beacon is flashing.
At present there are no obvious signs of forced entry visible from the street.
This is the second alarm of the evening from the same system.
incident.POL_ALARM_ACTIVATION.report.con: The premises are closed and no staff are believed to be inside.
The building has several entrances, including a rear yard not visible from the street.
Light industrial area with very little activity at night.
incident.POL_ALARM_ACTIVATION.report.clo: The owner has been informed and is on the way with the keys.
A perimeter check of entrances and shop windows is requested.
The caller has seen no one, but asks for a patrol to check.
messages.incident.POL_ALARM_ACTIVATION.outcome.su: Check completed: false alarm caused by a technical fault, premises secure.
messages.incident.POL_ALARM_ACTIVATION.outcome.pa: Signs of forcing found at one entrance but no one on site: premises handed back to the owner.
messages.incident.POL_ALARM_ACTIVATION.outcome.fa: Late check: the premises had been entered and part of the stock removed.
messages.incident.POL_ACCIDENT_SURVEY.title: Road accident survey
messages.incident.POL_ACCIDENT_SURVEY.summary: Road accident requiring a police survey and traffic management.
messages.incident.POL_ACCIDENT_SURVEY.radio: Control to all units: road traffic accident at {address}, {municipality}. Accident survey and traffic management requested.
incident.POL_ACCIDENT_SURVEY.report.intr: Attendance requested for an accident survey at {address}, {municipality}, following a collision between vehicles.
Several motorists report a collision with vehicles stopped in the carriageway at {address}.
A driver involved is calling from {address}, {municipality}, and requests police attendance for the survey.
Medical crews report an accident at {address} where traffic control is needed.
incident.POL_ACCIDENT_SURVEY.report.deta: The vehicles involved are stopped in the middle of the carriageway and cannot be moved.
Debris and spilled fluids on the road surface are making it slippery.
The drivers are giving conflicting accounts of what happened.
One of the vehicles ended up against the roadside signage.
incident.POL_ACCIDENT_SURVEY.report.cond: Traffic is very slow and queues are building in both directions.
The accident is just after a bend, with reduced visibility for approaching traffic.
Some of those involved have left their vehicles and are standing at the roadside.
incident.POL_ACCIDENT_SURVEY.report.clos: A patrol is requested for the survey, traffic diversion and securing the scene.
Medical crews have been alerted to assess those involved.
A recovery truck will be needed to remove the vehicles once the survey is complete.
messages.incident.POL_ACCIDENT_SURVEY.outcome.suc: Survey completed and traffic flowing again quickly, with no further incidents.
messages.incident.POL_ACCIDENT_SURVEY.outcome.par: Survey carried out, but the road remained blocked for a long time with heavy disruption.
messages.incident.POL_ACCIDENT_SURVEY.outcome.fai: Scene not secured in time: a second rear-end collision in the queue and a much more complex survey.
messages.incident.POL_MISSING_PERSON.title: Missing person
messages.incident.POL_MISSING_PERSON.summary: Elderly or confused person has wandered off in an urban area: dog units recommended.
messages.incident.POL_MISSING_PERSON.radio: Control to all units: missing person, last seen at {address}, {municipality}. Begin the search, dog units recommended.
incident.POL_MISSING_PERSON.report.intro: Person reported missing, last seen at {address}.
Family members report that a relative has wandered off from {address}, {municipality}.
A care home at {address} reports that one of its residents cannot be found.
Search requested around {address}, {municipality}, for a person who has not returned home.
Missing person report received: last sighting near {address}.
incident.POL_MISSING_PERSON.report.detai: The person is elderly and suffers from memory problems.
The person left on foot without a phone or identification.
According to the family, the person may have headed for familiar places such as a park or a bus stop.
The person appears disoriented and may not be able to give a home address.
incident.POL_MISSING_PERSON.report.condi: Green spaces, embankments and fields nearby make the search area large.
Temperatures are dropping and the person is lightly dressed.
Daylight is fading and visual searching will soon become difficult.
incident.POL_MISSING_PERSON.report.closi: Family members are on scene with a recent photograph and an item of clothing for the dog units.
Patrols are requested to sweep the area and dog units to follow the scent.
A description of the person has been circulated to all units in the area.
messages.incident.POL_MISSING_PERSON.outcome.succ: Person found safe and well and returned to the family.
messages.incident.POL_MISSING_PERSON.outcome.part: Person found after a long search, cold and handed over to medical crews for checks.
messages.incident.POL_MISSING_PERSON.outcome.fail: No result in the first hours: search widened and handed over to provincial coordination.
messages.incident.POL_SUSPICIOUS_PACKAGE.title: Suspicious package
messages.incident.POL_SUSPICIOUS_PACKAGE.summary: Unattended bag or package in a public place: area to be cordoned, bomb disposal required.
messages.incident.POL_SUSPICIOUS_PACKAGE.radio: Control to all units: unattended suspicious item at {address}, {municipality}. Cordon the area and keep your distance, bomb disposal requested.
incident.POL_SUSPICIOUS_PACKAGE.report.i: Security staff report a suspicious package left at {address}, {municipality}.
A passer-by reports a bag left without an owner for some time at {address}.
Attendance requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a suspicious item in an area open to the public.
Several reports concern an abandoned parcel near {address}.
incident.POL_SUSPICIOUS_PACKAGE.report.d: The item is a closed suitcase, left beside a bench for an unknown length of time.
No one present claims ownership and no labels are visible.
The package is close to a very busy entrance.
The person who spotted it says no one has touched or moved it.
incident.POL_SUSPICIOUS_PACKAGE.report.c: The area is crowded and must be cleared in an orderly way to avoid panic.
Public transport stops and open shops are nearby.
Staff on site have already moved the nearest people away.
A cordon is requested, along with the bomb disposal team to check the item.
Do not approach the item and limit radio use in its immediate vicinity.
The caller is waiting for the patrols at a safe distance to point out the location.
Area cordoned and bomb disposal check completed: item harmless, area reopened to the public.
Item found to be harmless, but the area stayed closed for a long time with heavy traffic disruption.
Late and disorderly cordon: moments of panic among those present and command passed to a higher level.
messages.incident.POL_PUBLIC_EVENT.title: Public order at an event
messages.incident.POL_PUBLIC_EVENT.summary: Public-order duty at a public event with tension in the crowd.
messages.incident.POL_PUBLIC_EVENT.radio: Control to all units: crowd tension during an event at {address}, {municipality}. Reinforcements requested for the public-order detail.
incident.POL_PUBLIC_EVENT.report.intros: Tension reported among people attending an event at {address}.
The officer in charge at {address}, {municipality}, requests reinforcements for crowd management.
The organisers of an event at {address} report a situation that is becoming hard to contain.
Public-order support requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a very well-attended event.
Several callers report crushing and frayed tempers among the crowd at {address}.
incident.POL_PUBLIC_EVENT.report.details: Attendance is higher than expected and the entry gates are congested.
Two opposing groups are exchanging chants and taunts at close range.
Part of the crowd is pressing against the barriers to reach the entrance.
With the event over, the crowd is dispersing slowly and frustration is growing.
incident.POL_PUBLIC_EVENT.report.conditi: The crowd includes families and people with reduced mobility.
The exit routes are narrow and partly taken up by vehicles and temporary structures.
The organisers' stewards are too few in number.
incident.POL_PUBLIC_EVENT.report.closing: Reinforcement units are requested to separate the groups and manage the flows.
Medical crews should be put on standby in support of the detail.
The organisers remain in contact with the control room for updates.
messages.incident.POL_PUBLIC_EVENT.outcome.succes: Crowd flows managed and tension eased: the event ended without incident.
messages.incident.POL_PUBLIC_EVENT.outcome.partia: Situation contained, but with a few minor injuries and limited damage to the barriers.
messages.incident.POL_PUBLIC_EVENT.outcome.failur: Insufficient reinforcements: event suspended, disorder in the area and several people handed over to medical crews.
messages.incident.POL_TRAFFIC_DISRUPTION.title: Traffic disruption
messages.incident.POL_TRAFFIC_DISRUPTION.summary: Failed traffic lights, broken-down lorry or obstacle in the road: traffic control needed.
messages.incident.POL_TRAFFIC_DISRUPTION.radio: Control to all units: traffic disruption at {address}, {municipality}. Patrol requested for traffic control.
incident.POL_TRAFFIC_DISRUPTION.report.i: Several motorists report gridlocked traffic at {address}, {municipality}.
Patrol requested at {address} to direct traffic at a junction.
A driver calling from {address}, {municipality}, reports an obstacle in the carriageway.
The road operator reports a traffic problem at {address}.
incident.POL_TRAFFIC_DISRUPTION.report.d: The traffic lights at the junction are out and drivers are not giving way.
A broken-down lorry is blocking one lane and cannot restart.
Material fallen from a vehicle is obstructing part of the carriageway.
Cars are attempting U-turns, adding to the confusion.
incident.POL_TRAFFIC_DISRUPTION.report.c: It is rush hour and the queues are growing quickly.
Scheduled buses and emergency vehicles also use this stretch.
There is a pedestrian crossing and a school nearby.
A patrol is requested to direct traffic manually until normal conditions are restored.
The road operator has been informed and will send a technical team.
Setting up an alternative route for approaching vehicles is advised.
Traffic directed from the outset and circulation back to normal in a short time.
Traffic restored, but only after long queues and delays to public transport.
Junction left unattended for a long time: traffic at a standstill and a minor rear-end collision in the queue.
messages.incident.WF_BRUSH.title: Brush fire
messages.incident.WF_BRUSH.summary: Flames in brush and dry grass on a roadside or on uncultivated land.
messages.incident.WF_BRUSH.radio: Control to all Wildfire Service units: brush fire at {address}, {municipality}. Limited flame front, one ground crew requested.
incident.WF_BRUSH.report.intros: Assistance requested for flames in dry grass along {address}.
Several callers report smoke and flames from uncultivated land at {address}, {municipality}.
A passing motorist reports a small fire starting on the roadside at {address}.
Column of smoke reported from an embankment at {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
incident.WF_BRUSH.report.details: Brush and dry grass are burning; the flame front is low but moving along the embankment.
The flames involve stubble and brambles at the edge of a field.
The fire is running low through dry grass, with light-coloured smoke clearly visible.
A strip of overgrown vegetation is involved, with small scattered hot spots.
incident.WF_BRUSH.report.conditions: Smoke is drifting across the carriageway at times, reducing visibility for passing traffic.
The ground is easily accessible to vehicles, with a light breeze over the area.
A hedge and a few isolated trees stand a short distance away.
incident.WF_BRUSH.report.closings: The caller is waiting in a safe spot to point the crews to the exact location.
A wildfire crew with a slip-on firefighting unit is requested for extinguishing and mop-up.
Drivers are advised to take care; no people are reported to be involved.
messages.incident.WF_BRUSH.outcome.success: Flame front stopped quickly, mop-up completed and traffic flowing normally.
messages.incident.WF_BRUSH.outcome.partial: Fire out, but the flames ran along a long stretch of embankment before the crews arrived.
messages.incident.WF_BRUSH.outcome.failure: The response came too late: the fire reached the nearby trees and further crews had to be sent.
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_SMALL.title: Small forest fire
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_SMALL.summary: Contained forest fire, under one hectare, manageable with ground crews.
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_SMALL.radio: Control to all Wildfire Service units: forest fire in the area of {address}, {municipality}. Limited area, ground crews requested for direct attack.
incident.WF_FOREST_SMALL.report.intros: Assistance requested for smoke and flames in the woods above {address}.
A hiker reports a fire in the undergrowth in the area of {address}, municipality of {municipality}.
The fire lookout reports a column of smoke from the woods in the direction of {address}, {municipality}.
Several residents report a smell of burning and smoke from the wooded slope near {address}.
incident.WF_FOREST_SMALL.report.details: The fire involves undergrowth and leaf litter, with low flames and a contained front.
A small patch of coppice woodland is burning, estimated at under one hectare.
The flame front is advancing slowly through shrubs and dry leaves.
A few active hot spots are present along the edge of the woods, with dense but localised smoke.
incident.WF_FOREST_SMALL.report.conditio: The area can be reached by a forest track, with the last stretch to be covered on foot.
Light wind and a moderate slope.
No houses are reported in the immediate vicinity; a popular footpath runs nearby.
incident.WF_FOREST_SMALL.report.closings: Wildfire ground crews with hand tools and a slip-on firefighting unit are requested.
The caller is waiting at the start of the forest track to guide the crews.
The duty wildfire incident commander has been informed to assess the event.
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_SMALL.outcome.success: Fire contained and extinguished by the ground crews, perimeter mop-up completed.
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_SMALL.outcome.partial: Fire under control, but the burned area is larger than estimated and mop-up is taking longer.
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_SMALL.outcome.failure: The crews were unable to hold the front: the fire spread and air support was requested.
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_MEDIUM.title: Medium forest fire
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_MEDIUM.summary: Wind-driven forest fire over several hectares; helicopter support is useful.
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_MEDIUM.radio: Control to all Wildfire Service units: spreading forest fire in the area of {address}, {municipality}. Wind-driven front, several crews requested and air support under assessment.
incident.WF_FOREST_MEDIUM.report.intros: Spreading forest fire reported in the area of {address}, {municipality}.
Numerous calls about a wide front of smoke on the slope above {address}.
The fire lookout confirms an active forest fire in the direction of {address}, municipality of {municipality}.
Urgent assistance requested for tall flames in the woods near {address}.
A passing patrol reports a forest fire clearly visible from {address}, {municipality}.
incident.WF_FOREST_MEDIUM.report.details: The wind-driven flame front is climbing the slope and has already burned several hectares of woodland.
The flames are reaching the tree crowns in places, with spot fires ahead of the main front.
Mixed woodland with thick undergrowth is burning, and the smoke column is visible from a great distance.
The head of the fire is very active, while the rear appears quieter.
incident.WF_FOREST_MEDIUM.report.conditi: Strong, gusty wind and steep terrain that is demanding for the ground crews.
Access is possible only along narrow forest tracks; a water supply point is available down in the valley.
A few isolated farmhouses lie some distance from the front and are being kept under observation.
incident.WF_FOREST_MEDIUM.report.closing: The wildfire incident commander is requested on scene to coordinate the crews and the water drops.
A helicopter is requested for water drops on the head of the fire, in support of the ground crews.
Maximum attention to crew safety and escape routes is advised.
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_MEDIUM.outcome.succes: Front stopped thanks to the coordinated action of ground crews and helicopter; mop-up started along the whole perimeter.
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_MEDIUM.outcome.partia: Fire under control after many hours, but a large area of woodland has burned.
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_MEDIUM.outcome.failur: The resources deployed were not enough: the front crossed the containment lines and the event was escalated to a higher level.
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_LARGE.title: Large forest fire
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_LARGE.summary: Major forest fire with multiple fronts: aircraft and a command post are required.
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_LARGE.radio: Control to all Wildfire Service units: large forest fire in the area of {address}, {municipality}. Multiple active fronts, aircraft, incident commander and forward command post requested.
incident.WF_FOREST_LARGE.report.intros: Major forest fire reported in the area of {address}, {municipality}.
Dozens of calls about an extensive fire front visible from {address} and nearby villages.
The incident commander on reconnaissance confirms a large forest fire with multiple fronts in the area of {address}, {municipality}.
Large-scale response requested for a forest fire out of control above {address}.
Neighbouring control rooms report a vast forest fire in the direction of {address}, municipality of {municipality}.
incident.WF_FOREST_LARGE.report.details: The fire has several active flame fronts and is advancing rapidly on both slopes.
Extensive crown fire, with numerous spot fires igniting new outbreaks at a distance.
The burned area is very large and still growing, and smoke is darkening the whole valley.
The fronts are moving in different directions, making the development of the event hard to predict.
incident.WF_FOREST_LARGE.report.conditio: Strong, shifting wind, high temperatures and very dry vegetation.
Forest tracks are partly impassable, and some roads in the area are being closed as a precaution.
Power lines, scattered hamlets and tourist accommodation in the area need to be kept under watch.
incident.WF_FOREST_LARGE.report.closings: Activation of the forward command post is requested, along with aircraft for continuous water drops.
Several wildfire crews, water tenders for resupply and coordination with the other services in the area are requested.
Crew safety is the priority: operate only from safe zones with defined escape routes.
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_LARGE.outcome.success: Fronts stopped thanks to the aircraft drops and the work of the crews; the fire is under control and mop-up continues.
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_LARGE.outcome.partial: Fire contained after a prolonged operation, with a vast area of woodland burned.
messages.incident.WF_FOREST_LARGE.outcome.failure: The deployment was not enough: the fire kept spreading and management passed to higher-level coordination, with reinforcements from other regions.
messages.incident.WF_INTERFACE.title: Wildland-urban interface fire
messages.incident.WF_INTERFACE.summary: Vegetation fire threatening houses: structure protection and precautionary evacuation.
messages.incident.WF_INTERFACE.radio: Control to all units: interface fire at {address}, {municipality}. Flames approaching houses, structure protection and precautionary evacuation requested.
incident.WF_INTERFACE.report.intros: Vegetation fire reported right next to houses at {address}, {municipality}.
Several residents of {address} report flames approaching the houses from the woods behind.
Urgent assistance requested for an interface fire at {address}, municipality of {municipality}.
The wildfire incident commander reports that the flame front is heading towards the built-up area around {address}.
The Local Police report thick smoke and flames close to the houses at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.WF_INTERFACE.report.details: The flame front is coming down the wooded slope towards the gardens and outbuildings of the houses.
Scrub and pine woodland are burning a short distance from the first houses, with embers carried by the wind.
The flames have reached hedges and overgrown plots between the houses, and smoke is filling the local streets.
The fire is advancing along the belt of vegetation surrounding the built-up area.
incident.WF_INTERFACE.report.conditions: Some residents are still in their homes, including elderly people who need help to leave.
Narrow streets and parked cars are making it difficult for emergency vehicles to get through.
Gas cylinders and stacks of firewood are present around the houses.
incident.WF_INTERFACE.report.closings: Wildfire crews and the Fire Brigade are requested for structure protection, supported by water drops on the front.
Precautionary evacuation of the most exposed houses and closure of the access roads are requested.
Police support is requested to move residents away, along with an ambulance on standby.
messages.incident.WF_INTERFACE.outcome.success: Houses protected and front stopped before the built-up area; the evacuated residents were able to return.
messages.incident.WF_INTERFACE.outcome.partial: The houses are safe, but the fire damaged gardens, fences and some outbuildings; the residents' return was delayed.
messages.incident.WF_INTERFACE.outcome.failure: Structure protection came too late: some houses were damaged and the evacuated residents were given temporary accommodation.
messages.incident.FIRE_CHIMNEY.title: Chimney fire
messages.incident.FIRE_CHIMNEY.summary: Soot alight inside a house chimney, sparks falling on the roof.
messages.incident.FIRE_CHIMNEY.radio: Control to all units: chimney fire at {address}, {municipality}. Sparks from the chimney pot, no persons involved.
incident.FIRE_CHIMNEY.report.intros: A neighbour reports sparks and thick smoke from the chimney of a house at {address}, {municipality}.
Attendance requested for soot alight in a house chimney at {address}.
Several callers report sparks falling on the roof of a house at {address}.
A resident of {municipality} reports a loud bang from the wood stove and thick smoke from the chimney at {address}.
incident.FIRE_CHIMNEY.report.details: Soot deposits in the flue have caught fire and are burning up the whole length of the chimney.
Long flames and a shower of sparks are coming out of the chimney pot.
The owners have shut the stove down, but the flue is still burning and the wall is heating up.
The chimney has not been swept for years and the flue runs through a timber loft space.
incident.FIRE_CHIMNEY.report.conditions: Sparks are falling on the roof covering and on neighbouring roofs.
A stiff wind is carrying the sparks towards the houses next door.
The roof is covered in snow and the way up to the chimney pot is slippery.
incident.FIRE_CHIMNEY.report.closings: The residents have been advised not to feed the stove any further and to keep the firebox door shut.
A Fire Brigade crew is requested to put the fire out and check the loft space.
The caller is waiting for crews in the yard and can point out the way up to the roof.
messages.incident.FIRE_CHIMNEY.outcome.success: Chimney fire put out and the flue swept clean, no spread into the loft space.
messages.incident.FIRE_CHIMNEY.outcome.partial: Fire extinguished, but the flue is cracked and the installation has been declared unusable.
messages.incident.FIRE_CHIMNEY.outcome.failure: Late response: the flames reached the timber roof structure and the house is uninhabitable.
messages.incident.FIRE_KITCHEN.title: Kitchen fire
messages.incident.FIRE_KITCHEN.summary: Pan or kitchen alight in a flat, the home filled with smoke.
messages.incident.FIRE_KITCHEN.radio: Control to all units: kitchen fire at {address}, {municipality}. Smoke inside the flat, possible smoke inhalation.
incident.FIRE_KITCHEN.report.intros: A resident of the building reports smoke coming out of a flat at {address}, {municipality}.
Attendance requested for a pan that has caught fire in a home at {address}.
Several callers report a strong smell of burning and smoke alarms sounding at {address}.
A resident of {municipality} reports flames on the hob of a flat at {address}.
incident.FIRE_KITCHEN.report.details: A pan of oil left on the hob has caught fire and the flames have reached the extractor hood.
The wall units above the hob are alight and smoke has filled the whole flat.
The occupant tried to put the fire out unaided and has a burn to one hand.
The hob runs on bottled gas and the cylinder is in the same room.
incident.FIRE_KITCHEN.report.conditions: Smoke is coming out of the front door and rising into the stairwell.
There is an elderly person in the flat who has breathed in smoke.
The flat is on an upper floor and the staircase is the only way out.
incident.FIRE_KITCHEN.report.closings: The occupant has been advised not to throw water on the oil and to get out, closing the door behind them.
A Fire Brigade crew is requested, with an ambulance for anyone who has breathed in smoke.
The caller is waiting for crews at the entrance and has already opened the stairwell windows.
messages.incident.FIRE_KITCHEN.outcome.success: Flames knocked down at once, the flat ventilated and nobody needed treatment.
messages.incident.FIRE_KITCHEN.outcome.partial: Fire extinguished, but the kitchen is destroyed and one person was handed to the ambulance crew for smoke inhalation.
messages.incident.FIRE_KITCHEN.outcome.failure: Late response: the fire spread through the flat and the occupants had to be brought out by crews.
messages.incident.TECH_PERSON_LOCKED_IN.title: Forced door entry
messages.incident.TECH_PERSON_LOCKED_IN.summary: Door to be forced: an elderly person not answering, or a child or pet locked inside.
messages.incident.TECH_PERSON_LOCKED_IN.radio: Control to all units: forced door entry at {address}, {municipality}. Person inside not answering, attendance cannot wait.
incident.TECH_PERSON_LOCKED_IN.report.in: Request to force the door of a home at {address}.
A neighbour reports an elderly person who has not answered for hours at {address}, {municipality}.
Attendance requested for a child locked alone inside a home at {address}.
Relatives are asking for the door of a flat to be opened at {address}.
A resident of {municipality} reports that the door of a flat at {address} has locked itself with a pet inside.
incident.TECH_PERSON_LOCKED_IN.report.de: The person who lives there is answering neither the telephone nor the doorbell.
The neighbours can hear the television on and someone moaning inside.
The door closed by itself and the keys are still inside.
The flat is on the ground floor and a window at the back may be openable.
incident.TECH_PERSON_LOCKED_IN.report.co: None of the relatives has a spare set of keys.
The person inside receives home care and takes daily medication.
No sound at all can be heard from inside.
incident.TECH_PERSON_LOCKED_IN.report.cl: A Fire Brigade crew is requested to open the door.
Those present have been advised not to force entry and to wait for the crews.
An ambulance is requested as a precaution.
messages.incident.TECH_PERSON_LOCKED_IN.outcome.s: Door opened with minimal damage, the person inside is well and has been left with the family.
messages.incident.TECH_PERSON_LOCKED_IN.outcome.p: Door opened and the person reached, but the ambulance crew had to treat them and the lock needs replacing.
messages.incident.TECH_PERSON_LOCKED_IN.outcome.f: Response came far too late: when the door was opened the person had been on the floor for many hours.
messages.incident.TECH_WATER_LEAK.title: Burst pipe in building
messages.incident.TECH_WATER_LEAK.summary: Burst pipe flooding a flat and the floors below.
messages.incident.TECH_WATER_LEAK.radio: Control to all units: flooding from a burst pipe at {address}, {municipality}. Water on the lower floors, water emergency crew requested.
incident.TECH_WATER_LEAK.report.intros: Flooding from a water leak reported at {address}.
A resident reports water running down from the floors above at {address}, {municipality}.
Attendance requested for a burst pipe in a flat at {address}.
Several callers report water flooding the stairwell of a building at {address}.
The managing agent of a building in {municipality} reports a major leak at {address}.
incident.TECH_WATER_LEAK.report.details: A hot water pipe has burst and the flat is completely flooded.
The water has already run down two floors and is dripping through the false ceilings.
The owner of the flat cannot be reached and the meter is not accessible.
The building's main stopcock is seized and cannot be closed.
incident.TECH_WATER_LEAK.report.conditio: The water is reaching the electrical distribution board on the landing.
The floors below are occupied and some families have already moved their furniture.
The water in the basement is over ten centimetres deep.
incident.TECH_WATER_LEAK.report.closings: A Fire Brigade crew is requested to pump the water out and isolate the system.
The water company's emergency crew is requested to shut off the main.
Residents have been advised to cut the power to the flooded rooms.
messages.incident.TECH_WATER_LEAK.outcome.success: Leak isolated and the rooms dried out, damage confined to a single flat.
messages.incident.TECH_WATER_LEAK.outcome.partial: Water shut off and pumped out, but the floors below suffered damage and the electrical system remains out of service.
messages.incident.TECH_WATER_LEAK.outcome.failure: Late response: the water flooded the whole building and the distribution board was destroyed.
messages.incident.TECH_INSECT_NEST.title: Wasp nest removal
messages.incident.TECH_INSECT_NEST.summary: Wasp or hornet nest to be removed from a building.
messages.incident.TECH_INSECT_NEST.radio: Control to all units: wasp nest at {address}, {municipality}. Removal requested, no injuries.
incident.TECH_INSECT_NEST.report.intros: A wasp nest to be removed reported at {address}.
A resident reports a large hornet nest under the eaves at {address}, {municipality}.
Removal of a wasp nest from a building requested at {address}.
School staff report a wasp nest close to the classroom windows at {address}.
A member of the public in {municipality} reports a swarm of wasps at the entrance of a public building at {address}.
incident.TECH_INSECT_NEST.report.details: The nest is under the cornice, some six metres above the ground.
It is a large hornet nest with insects coming and going constantly.
The insects are getting in through a crack in the wall and the nest is inside the roller shutter box.
The nest is right above the entrance and the insects turn aggressive whenever anyone walks past.
incident.TECH_INSECT_NEST.report.conditi: There are children in the building and one person allergic to stings.
The area below is very busy at peak times.
A hot day, and the insects are particularly active.
incident.TECH_INSECT_NEST.report.closing: A Fire Brigade crew equipped for the removal is requested.
Those present have been advised to keep the windows shut and not to go near the nest.
The caller has already closed off the area underneath.
messages.incident.TECH_INSECT_NEST.outcome.succes: Nest removed and the area safely back in use.
messages.incident.TECH_INSECT_NEST.outcome.partia: Nest removed, but some insects are still around and a second visit will be needed.
messages.incident.TECH_INSECT_NEST.outcome.failur: Response came far too late: several people were stung and the area stayed closed off for days.
messages.incident.FIRE_BALCONY.title: Balcony fire
messages.incident.FIRE_BALCONY.summary: Flames on a balcony or an awning on the outside of a block of flats.
messages.incident.FIRE_BALCONY.radio: Control to all units: balcony fire at {address}, {municipality}. Flames on the facade, check the floors above.
incident.FIRE_BALCONY.report.intros: A passer-by reports flames on a balcony of a block of flats at {address}, {municipality}.
Attendance requested for an awning alight at {address}.
Several callers report smoke and flames on the facade of a building at {address}.
A resident of {municipality} reports stored items burning on a balcony at {address}.
incident.FIRE_BALCONY.report.details: Furniture and items stored on the balcony are alight.
The flames have taken hold of the awning and are climbing towards the floor above.
The fire is believed to have started from a cigarette end dropped from above onto the covers.
There is a camping gas cylinder and several jerrycans on the balcony.
incident.FIRE_BALCONY.report.conditions: The flames are licking the window frames of the floor above.
Wind is pushing the fire against the facade and its insulation cladding.
The flat appears to be occupied and nobody is answering the entryphone.
incident.FIRE_BALCONY.report.closings: A Fire Brigade crew with an aerial appliance is requested for access from the outside.
Residents have been advised to close their windows and to stay inside their flats.
The caller is waiting for crews in the street and has had space cleared for the turntable ladder.
messages.incident.FIRE_BALCONY.outcome.success: Flames knocked down from the outside, no spread into the flats.
messages.incident.FIRE_BALCONY.outcome.partial: Fire extinguished, but the balcony and the window frames above are damaged and one person was handed to the ambulance crew.
messages.incident.FIRE_BALCONY.outcome.failure: Late response: the fire got into the flats and the building had to be evacuated.
messages.incident.TECH_GAS_SMELL.title: Smell of gas
messages.incident.TECH_GAS_SMELL.summary: Strong smell of gas reported inside a building or right next to it.
messages.incident.TECH_GAS_SMELL.radio: Control to all units: smell of gas reported at {address}, {municipality}. Gas network emergency crew requested.
incident.TECH_GAS_SMELL.report.intros: Strong smell of gas reported at {address}.
A resident reports a smell of gas in the stairwell of a building at {address}, {municipality}.
Attendance requested for a suspected gas leak at {address}.
Several callers report a smell of gas along the pavement at {address}.
A shopkeeper in {municipality} reports a smell of gas inside their premises at {address}.
incident.TECH_GAS_SMELL.report.details: The smell is noticeable from the entrance and gets stronger going up the stairs.
The leak appears to be coming from the meter of the ground-floor flat.
Roadworks have been digging close to the main and the smell appeared shortly afterwards.
The smell is strong in the courtyard but the source cannot be pinned down.
incident.TECH_GAS_SMELL.report.condition: Several families live in the building and some are already coming out into the street.
There is a restaurant on the ground floor with customers and naked flames in the kitchen.
The area is densely populated and must be kept clear of vehicles and people.
incident.TECH_GAS_SMELL.report.closings: Residents have been advised not to operate switches, doorbells or lifts.
A Fire Brigade crew is requested, together with the gas network technicians.
Police support is requested to close off the area.
messages.incident.TECH_GAS_SMELL.outcome.success: Leak found and isolated by the gas network crew, building ventilated and handed back to the residents.
messages.incident.TECH_GAS_SMELL.outcome.partial: Leak isolated, but the supply stays shut off and some flats cannot be reoccupied straight away.
messages.incident.TECH_GAS_SMELL.outcome.failure: Late response: the build-up of gas made it necessary to evacuate the whole block.
messages.incident.ROAD_MOTORCYCLE.title: Motorcycle collision
messages.incident.ROAD_MOTORCYCLE.summary: Motorcycle down with the rider on the carriageway.
messages.incident.ROAD_MOTORCYCLE.radio: Control to all units: motorcycle collision at {address}, {municipality}. One rider down, ambulance requested.
incident.ROAD_MOTORCYCLE.report.intros: A driver reports a motorcyclist down in the road at {address}, {municipality}.
Urgent attendance requested for a motorcycle that has come off at {address}.
Several callers report a collision between a car and a motorcycle at {address}.
A resident of {municipality} reports a motorcycle that has hit the crash barrier at {address}.
incident.ROAD_MOTORCYCLE.report.details: The rider is on the ground, conscious, complaining of severe pain in one leg.
The motorcyclist still has the helmet on and cannot move.
The machine slid for several metres and is leaking fuel onto the road surface.
The impact was with a turning car and the rider was thrown clear of the carriageway.
incident.ROAD_MOTORCYCLE.report.conditio: The casualty is lying in the middle of the carriageway, exposed to oncoming traffic.
Fuel and oil on the road surface, on a bend with poor visibility.
Heavy weekend traffic and a lot of onlookers on scene.
incident.ROAD_MOTORCYCLE.report.closings: An ambulance and a Fire Brigade crew are requested.
Those present have been advised not to remove the helmet and not to move the casualty.
Police support is requested to close the stretch of road, and a recovery truck for the motorcycle.
messages.incident.ROAD_MOTORCYCLE.outcome.success: Rider treated and taken to hospital, carriageway cleaned up and reopened.
messages.incident.ROAD_MOTORCYCLE.outcome.partial: Rider taken to hospital in a serious condition; cleaning the carriageway meant a long road closure.
messages.incident.ROAD_MOTORCYCLE.outcome.failure: Help came too late: the rider's condition deteriorated and the road stayed closed for hours.
messages.incident.FIRE_ELECTRICAL_PANEL.title: Electrical panel fire
messages.incident.FIRE_ELECTRICAL_PANEL.summary: Distribution board or meter room on fire, power to be cut off.
messages.incident.FIRE_ELECTRICAL_PANEL.radio: Control to all units: electrical panel fire at {address}, {municipality}. Electricity emergency crew requested to de-energise the installation.
incident.FIRE_ELECTRICAL_PANEL.report.in: An employee reports smoke from the meter room of a building at {address}, {municipality}.
Attendance requested for an electrical panel alight at {address}.
Several callers report bangs and an acrid smell of burning from a plant room at {address}.
The caretaker of a building in {municipality} reports flames from the main distribution board at {address}.
incident.FIRE_ELECTRICAL_PANEL.report.de: The main board is alight and the building has lost power.
Thick smoke is coming out of the meter room and electrical arcing can be heard.
The fire involves a transformer substation that is still live.
The cable trays are burning and the fire is spreading up the service shaft.
incident.FIRE_ELECTRICAL_PANEL.report.co: The installation is still live and water cannot be used on it.
Smoke from the cables has filled the corridors and is spreading through the floors.
The plant room adjoins the store room and the door is hot to the touch.
incident.FIRE_ELECTRICAL_PANEL.report.cl: The electricity network technicians are requested to de-energise the installation.
A Fire Brigade crew is requested with extinguishing media suitable for electrical installations.
Those present have been advised to evacuate the building and not to use the lifts.
messages.incident.FIRE_ELECTRICAL_PANEL.outcome.s: Installation de-energised and fire extinguished, building ventilated and safe to use.
messages.incident.FIRE_ELECTRICAL_PANEL.outcome.p: Fire extinguished, but the installation has to be rebuilt and the building stays without power.
messages.incident.FIRE_ELECTRICAL_PANEL.outcome.f: Late response: the fire climbed the service shaft and spread to the upper floors.
messages.incident.FIRE_SHOP.title: Shop fire
messages.incident.FIRE_SHOP.summary: Fire in a shop or small commercial unit, often with the shutters down.
messages.incident.FIRE_SHOP.radio: Control to all units: fire in a commercial unit at {address}, {municipality}. Premises closed, check for persons and the flats above.
incident.FIRE_SHOP.report.intros: A passer-by reports smoke coming through the shutters of a business at {address}, {municipality}.
Attendance requested for a fire in a commercial unit at {address}.
Several callers report flames behind the windows of a shop at {address}.
A resident of {municipality} reports thick smoke from a closed commercial unit at {address}.
incident.FIRE_SHOP.report.details: The premises are locked up and smoke is coming through the gaps in the shutters.
The shop windows have failed in the heat and flames are coming out onto the pavement.
Shelving and goods stacked in the back of the shop are alight.
The store room holds plastic goods and pressurised aerosol cans.
incident.FIRE_SHOP.report.conditions: There are occupied flats above the shop.
Smoke is filling the street and the neighbouring units need clearing.
Staff may be inside doing the night-time cleaning.
incident.FIRE_SHOP.report.closings: Several Fire Brigade crews are requested to attack the fire and protect the neighbouring buildings.
Police support is requested to close the street and move the onlookers back.
Residents on the upper floors have been advised to stay inside with their windows closed.
messages.incident.FIRE_SHOP.outcome.success: Fire confined to the unit, the flats above untouched and the street reopened.
messages.incident.FIRE_SHOP.outcome.partial: Fire extinguished, but the business is destroyed and some flats have been declared temporarily uninhabitable.
messages.incident.FIRE_SHOP.outcome.failure: Late response: the flames took hold of the whole building and the residents were evacuated.
messages.incident.ROAD_VEHICLE_OFF_ROAD.title: Vehicle off the road
messages.incident.ROAD_VEHICLE_OFF_ROAD.summary: Car off the carriageway, into a ditch or down an embankment.
messages.incident.ROAD_VEHICLE_OFF_ROAD.radio: Control to all units: vehicle off the road at {address}, {municipality}. Check the number of occupants, recovery of the vehicle expected.
incident.ROAD_VEHICLE_OFF_ROAD.report.in: A vehicle off the road reported at {address}.
A driver reports a car overturned in a ditch at {address}, {municipality}.
Attendance requested for a vehicle that has gone down an embankment at {address}.
Several callers report a car off the carriageway with its headlights still on at {address}.
A resident of {municipality} heard a loud bang and found a car in the field beside the road at {address}.
incident.ROAD_VEHICLE_OFF_ROAD.report.de: The vehicle is overturned in the ditch and the driver cannot get out unaided.
The car went several metres down the embankment and came to rest against the trees.
The occupants got out unaided and are waiting at the roadside, cold.
The vehicle is balanced on the edge and any movement risks sending it over.
incident.ROAD_VEHICLE_OFF_ROAD.report.co: Pitch dark and thick fog, the spot is hard to find.
Icy surface and a soft verge, getting to the vehicle is awkward.
An unlit stretch of road with traffic passing at speed.
incident.ROAD_VEHICLE_OFF_ROAD.report.cl: A Fire Brigade crew with cutting equipment is requested, and a recovery truck for the vehicle.
An ambulance is requested for the occupants, with Police support for traffic control.
The caller has been advised to mark the spot and not to climb down the embankment.
messages.incident.ROAD_VEHICLE_OFF_ROAD.outcome.s: Occupants released and handed to the ambulance crew, vehicle recovered and the road reopened.
messages.incident.ROAD_VEHICLE_OFF_ROAD.outcome.p: Occupants released after a long job; one of them was taken to hospital and recovering the vehicle took hours.
messages.incident.ROAD_VEHICLE_OFF_ROAD.outcome.f: Help came too late: the occupants stayed in the vehicle for a long time and their condition worsened.
messages.incident.FIRE_BASEMENT.title: Basement fire
messages.incident.FIRE_BASEMENT.summary: Fire in a cellar under a block of flats, with heavy smoke in the stairwell.
messages.incident.FIRE_BASEMENT.radio: Control to all units: fire in a basement room at {address}, {municipality}. Heavy smoke in the stairwell, check for residents on the upper floors.
incident.FIRE_BASEMENT.report.intros: Fire reported in a communal cellar at {address}.
Several callers in {municipality} report smoke from the basement of a block of flats at {address}.
Urgent attendance requested for a fire in an underground storage room at {address}, {municipality}.
A resident reports heavy smoke coming up the stairs of their block at {address}.
The caretaker of the building at {address} reports flames in a cellar.
incident.FIRE_BASEMENT.report.details: The fire involves goods piled up in a cellar and the heat is already intense.
Smoke has filled the stairwell and is rising towards the upper floors.
The fire started in a boiler room and has spread to the adjoining storage units.
The basement level is full of smoke and there is no visibility inside.
incident.FIRE_BASEMENT.report.conditions: Some residents have stayed in their flats because the stairs are impassable.
Gas meters and electrical panels are in the same basement room.
Access to the cellars is narrow and there are no ventilation openings.
incident.FIRE_BASEMENT.report.closings: Fire Brigade crews with breathing apparatus and a positive-pressure fan are requested for forced ventilation.
Residents have been advised to stay inside with their doors closed until crews arrive.
The caller is waiting for crews at the front door with the keys to the basement.
messages.incident.FIRE_BASEMENT.outcome.success: Fire put out in the room of origin, stairwell ventilated and residents back in their flats.
messages.incident.FIRE_BASEMENT.outcome.partial: Fire knocked down, but smoke filled the stairwell and some people were handed to ambulance crews.
messages.incident.FIRE_BASEMENT.outcome.failure: The response came too late: smoke reached every floor and the building was evacuated and declared unfit for use.
messages.incident.TECH_DANGLING_OBJECT.title: Object hanging loose
messages.incident.TECH_DANGLING_OBJECT.summary: A sign, gutter or cladding panel left hanging over the street after a gale.
messages.incident.TECH_DANGLING_OBJECT.radio: Control to all units: object hanging loose over the roadway at {address}, {municipality}. Removal required, keep the area below clear.
incident.TECH_DANGLING_OBJECT.report.int: An object is reported hanging loose over the street at {address}.
Attendance requested for a shop sign left hanging after the gusts at {address}, {municipality}.
A passer-by reports a detached gutter swinging above the pavement at {address}.
Several callers report cladding panels lifted by the wind at {address}, {municipality}.
The local police request the Fire Brigade for unsafe material at {address}.
incident.TECH_DANGLING_OBJECT.report.det: A shop sign has come away on one side and is hanging over the entrance.
An aerial has bent over on the roof and is projecting beyond the facade.
A length of guttering is dangling from the eaves and banging against the wall with every gust.
Some cladding panels have lifted and could fall into the street.
incident.TECH_DANGLING_OBJECT.report.con: Pedestrians are passing underneath and a cafe has tables out below.
The wind is still gusting and the material keeps moving.
Parked cars are taking up the space needed to set up the aerial ladder.
incident.TECH_DANGLING_OBJECT.report.clo: An aerial ladder is requested to remove the material and make the facade safe.
The caller has moved passers-by away and is waiting for crews on scene.
The pavement should be cordoned off until the work is finished.
messages.incident.TECH_DANGLING_OBJECT.outcome.su: Material removed and the area reopened to traffic within a short time.
messages.incident.TECH_DANGLING_OBJECT.outcome.pa: Object made safe, but the pavement stays cordoned off pending repair work.
messages.incident.TECH_DANGLING_OBJECT.outcome.fa: The response came too late: the material fell into the street, damaging parked vehicles, and the area remains closed.
messages.incident.FIRE_FARM_BUILDING.title: Farm building fire
messages.incident.FIRE_FARM_BUILDING.summary: Barn or farm outbuilding alight in the countryside; water has to be shuttled in by tanker.
messages.incident.FIRE_FARM_BUILDING.radio: Control to all units: farm building fire at {address}, {municipality}. No mains water in the area, tankers requested for the water shuttle.
incident.FIRE_FARM_BUILDING.report.intro: Fire reported in a hay barn at {address}.
The owner of a farm reports flames in the machinery shed at {address}, {municipality}.
Several callers report a glow and heavy smoke out in open country, at {address}.
Urgent attendance requested for a fire in a farm outbuilding at {address}.
Callers from {municipality} report a cattle shed on fire at {address}.
incident.FIRE_FARM_BUILDING.report.detai: The hay stored inside is burning and the fire has reached the roof.
The fire involves the machinery shed and the fuel stored in it.
The fire started in a round bale and has spread through the whole store.
The timber and sheet-metal structure is giving way and the fire front is wide.
incident.FIRE_FARM_BUILDING.report.condi: There are still animals in the adjoining shed that need to be moved to safety.
There are no hydrants in the area: the nearest water point is several kilometres away.
The wind is carrying sparks towards the fields and the bales stacked outside.
incident.FIRE_FARM_BUILDING.report.closi: Multiple Fire Brigade crews and water tankers for a shuttle run are requested.
The owner is waiting for crews at the farm entrance to open the gates.
Onlookers should be kept away and nobody should go back inside the buildings.
messages.incident.FIRE_FARM_BUILDING.outcome.succ: Fire confined to the building of origin, animals moved to safety and nearby structures protected.
messages.incident.FIRE_FARM_BUILDING.outcome.part: Fire knocked down after many hours of tanker shuttling: the store is lost, the rest of the farm is saved.
messages.incident.FIRE_FARM_BUILDING.outcome.fail: Not enough water or crews: the building was destroyed and the fire spread into the surrounding fields.
messages.incident.ROAD_FUEL_SPILL.title: Fuel spill on the road
messages.incident.ROAD_FUEL_SPILL.summary: Diesel across the carriageway: the surface is slippery and absorbent is needed.
messages.incident.ROAD_FUEL_SPILL.radio: Control to all units: fuel spilled across the carriageway at {address}, {municipality}. Road surface slippery, clean-up with absorbent requested.
incident.ROAD_FUEL_SPILL.report.intros: A trail of diesel is reported across the carriageway at {address}.
Several motorcyclists report a slippery road surface from spilled fuel at {address}, {municipality}.
The local police request the Fire Brigade for a road clean-up at {address}.
A driver reports a vehicle leaking fuel along the road at {address}, {municipality}.
Attendance requested for liquid spilled on the road surface at {address}.
incident.ROAD_FUEL_SPILL.report.details: The diesel trail runs for hundreds of metres along the lane.
The tank of a heavy goods vehicle has been holed and is still leaking.
The fuel has pooled on a bend and the surface there is completely slick.
The liquid is running towards the roadside gullies.
incident.ROAD_FUEL_SPILL.report.conditio: A motorcyclist has already gone down on the affected stretch, fortunately without injury.
Traffic is heavy and keeps spreading the liquid along the carriageway.
Light rain is falling and making the surface even more treacherous.
incident.ROAD_FUEL_SPILL.report.closings: Absorbent material is requested to clean up the road surface.
Police support is requested to manage traffic while the work is under way.
The highway operator will send a maintenance crew once the clean-up is finished.
messages.incident.ROAD_FUEL_SPILL.outcome.success: Carriageway cleaned up and reopened to traffic, with no further collisions.
messages.incident.ROAD_FUEL_SPILL.outcome.partial: Clean-up completed, but the work took a long time and traffic was diverted for hours.
messages.incident.ROAD_FUEL_SPILL.outcome.failure: The response came too late: there were more falls on the slippery stretch and the road remains closed.
messages.incident.TECH_INDUSTRIAL_MACHINE.title: Worker trapped in machinery
messages.incident.TECH_INDUSTRIAL_MACHINE.summary: Worker caught in an industrial machine: delicate extrication with the Emergency Medical Service on scene.
messages.incident.TECH_INDUSTRIAL_MACHINE.radio: Control to all units: worker trapped in machinery at {address}, {municipality}. Urgent extrication required, Emergency Medical Service alerted.
Workplace accident reported with a worker trapped in machinery at {address}.
The plant manager requests urgent attendance for a worker caught in a machine at {address}, {municipality}.
The Emergency Medical Service requests the Fire Brigade for an extrication at a factory at {address}.
Several callers report a serious accident inside an industrial unit at {address}, {municipality}.
A workmate reports a man with a limb caught in a machine at {address}.
An arm is caught between the rollers of a production line.
The worker is trapped in a press and the machine has been shut down by the maintenance fitter.
A hand is caught in the gears of a machine tool, now stopped.
The worker is conscious and cooperating, but cannot free himself.
The man is conscious but in a great deal of pain, and his workmates are doing what they can for him.
The machine is still live and must be isolated before anything is moved.
The line has been stopped and the other workers have been moved out of the area.
Cutting and spreading equipment is requested to free the trapped limb.
Medical personnel are on scene and ask for rapid access to the casualty.
The maintenance fitter is standing by with the machine drawings for the crews.
messages.incident.TECH_INDUSTRIAL_MACHINE.outcome: Worker freed quickly and handed over to medical personnel in a stable condition.
Extrication successful but long and delicate: the casualty was handed over with serious injuries.
The response came too late: the man stayed trapped for a long time and his condition deteriorated.
messages.incident.FIRE_BUS.title: Bus fire
messages.incident.FIRE_BUS.summary: Service bus on fire: passengers off the vehicle, the bus to be extinguished and made safe.
messages.incident.FIRE_BUS.radio: Control to all units: service bus on fire at {address}, {municipality}. Passengers evacuated onto the pavement, immediate attendance required.
incident.FIRE_BUS.report.intros: A service bus is reported on fire at {address}.
The driver reports smoke from the engine bay of his bus, stopped at {address}, {municipality}.
Several callers report a bus burning in the middle of the road at {address}.
The public transport operator reports one of its buses on fire at {address}, {municipality}.
A passer-by reports flames from a bus standing at the stop at {address}.
incident.FIRE_BUS.report.details: Flames are coming from the engine bay and have reached the roof of the vehicle.
The fire has spread into the saloon and the windows are failing in the heat.
The vehicle is now well alight and the whole interior trim is burning.
Thick smoke is coming from the engine bay and the driver's extinguisher had no effect.
incident.FIRE_BUS.report.conditions: All passengers are off the bus and waiting on the pavement, shaken but unhurt.
The bus is stopped among parked cars and the heat is threatening the buildings alongside.
The fuel tank is exposed to the flames and the road has already been closed.
incident.FIRE_BUS.report.closings: Immediate Fire Brigade attendance is requested to extinguish the fire and make the vehicle safe.
Police support requested to close the road and keep the passengers at a distance.
The driver has isolated the electrics; a heavy recovery vehicle will be needed to remove the bus.
messages.incident.FIRE_BUS.outcome.success: Fire put out quickly, all passengers unhurt and the vehicle made safe.
messages.incident.FIRE_BUS.outcome.partial: Fire knocked down, but the bus is largely destroyed and some passengers were handed to ambulance crews.
messages.incident.FIRE_BUS.outcome.failure: The response came too late: the bus was destroyed, the flames damaged the buildings alongside and the road remains closed.
messages.incident.TECH_PERSON_ON_LEDGE.title: Person on a ledge
messages.incident.TECH_PERSON_ON_LEDGE.summary: Person beyond the parapet threatening to jump: careful approach with Police and ambulance.
messages.incident.TECH_PERSON_ON_LEDGE.radio: Control to all units: person on a ledge at {address}, {municipality}. Threatening to jump, Police and ambulance en route, approach without sirens.
incident.TECH_PERSON_ON_LEDGE.report.int: A person is reported sitting on the ledge of a building at {address}.
Several callers in {municipality} report a person beyond the parapet of a roof at {address}.
The Police request the Fire Brigade for a person threatening to jump at {address}.
A relative reports that a family member has gone up onto the roof of the building at {address}, {municipality}.
A passer-by reports a person standing on the edge of a terrace at {address}.
incident.TECH_PERSON_ON_LEDGE.report.det: The person is on the outside of the railing, at the height of the top floors.
A man is sitting on the ledge with his legs over the edge and is not answering.
The person has climbed onto the roof and is moving along the edge.
The door onto the terrace has been blocked from the inside.
incident.TECH_PERSON_ON_LEDGE.report.con: The person is agitated and reacts badly when anyone comes closer.
A group of onlookers has gathered in the street below.
A police negotiator is already talking to the person.
incident.TECH_PERSON_ON_LEDGE.report.clo: An aerial ladder and a rescue sheet are requested, to be set up out of the person's line of sight.
Crews should approach without sirens and keep the street below quiet.
Medical personnel are standing by at a distance, ready to take over.
messages.incident.TECH_PERSON_ON_LEDGE.outcome.su: The person was talked back inside and handed over to medical personnel, nobody was hurt.
messages.incident.TECH_PERSON_ON_LEDGE.outcome.pa: The person was brought down after a long negotiation, with minor injuries, and handed to the ambulance crew.
messages.incident.TECH_PERSON_ON_LEDGE.outcome.fa: The response came too late: the person was brought down by other crews in a critical condition and handed to medical personnel.
messages.incident.TECH_CONFINED_SPACE.title: Confined space rescue
messages.incident.TECH_CONFINED_SPACE.summary: Worker collapsed in a tank or a well: breathing apparatus and gas monitoring required.
messages.incident.TECH_CONFINED_SPACE.radio: Control to all units: worker collapsed in a confined space at {address}, {municipality}. Atmosphere presumed unbreathable, nobody is to enter without breathing apparatus.
incident.TECH_CONFINED_SPACE.report.intr: A worker is reported collapsed at the bottom of a tank at {address}.
Urgent attendance requested for a man who has fallen into a well at {address}, {municipality}.
Workmates report a man who is not answering inside a silo at {address}.
The Emergency Medical Service requests the Fire Brigade for a recovery from a sewer chamber at {address}, {municipality}.
The site manager reports a man taken ill inside an underground chamber at {address}.
incident.TECH_CONFINED_SPACE.report.deta: The man went down for maintenance work and collapsed after a few minutes.
The worker is lying at the bottom, several metres down, and is not responding.
Gas or a lack of oxygen inside the space is suspected.
The access opening is narrow and only one rescuer can pass at a time.
incident.TECH_CONFINED_SPACE.report.cond: A workmate tried to climb down to help him and was overcome as well.
The atmosphere inside has not been tested and the space has not been ventilated.
There are no harnesses and no anchor points available on site.
incident.TECH_CONFINED_SPACE.report.clos: A crew with breathing apparatus, a multi-gas detector and equipment for a vertical recovery is requested.
Nobody is to enter the space under any circumstances until the crews arrive.
Medical personnel are on their way and will wait for the patient at the opening.
messages.incident.TECH_CONFINED_SPACE.outcome.suc: Worker recovered and handed over to medical personnel, the space ventilated and made safe.
messages.incident.TECH_CONFINED_SPACE.outcome.par: Recovery successful but slow: the patient was handed over in a serious condition.
messages.incident.TECH_CONFINED_SPACE.outcome.fai: The response came too late: the recovery was completed by other crews and the man's condition deteriorated.
messages.incident.ROAD_TRUCK_OVERTURNED.title: Articulated lorry overturned
messages.incident.ROAD_TRUCK_OVERTURNED.summary: Heavy goods vehicle overturned on a fast road: cab crushed and a long recovery ahead.
messages.incident.ROAD_TRUCK_OVERTURNED.radio: Control to all units: articulated lorry overturned across the carriageway at {address}, {municipality}. Driver still in the cab, extrication and a heavy recovery vehicle required.
incident.ROAD_TRUCK_OVERTURNED.report.in: An articulated lorry is reported overturned across the carriageway at {address}.
Several callers report a heavy goods vehicle lying across the road at {address}, {municipality}.
Urgent attendance requested for an overturned lorry with the driver still inside at {address}.
The traffic police request the Fire Brigade for a heavy goods vehicle off the road at {address}, {municipality}.
A driver reports an overturned trailer blocking both lanes at {address}.
incident.ROAD_TRUCK_OVERTURNED.report.de: The tractor unit is lying on its side and the cab is deformed on the driver's side.
The trailer has rolled over and the load has spilled across the road surface.
The vehicle went through the crash barrier and came to rest on the embankment.
The driver is conscious but cannot get out of the crushed cab.
incident.ROAD_TRUCK_OVERTURNED.report.co: Diesel from the side tanks is spreading across the carriageway.
The road is blocked in both directions and the queues are getting longer.
The load will have to be taken off before the vehicle can be righted.
incident.ROAD_TRUCK_OVERTURNED.report.cl: Cutting equipment for the extrication and a heavy recovery vehicle with a crane are requested.
Police support is requested to close the stretch and divert traffic.
Nobody should approach the vehicle and there is to be no smoking nearby.
messages.incident.ROAD_TRUCK_OVERTURNED.outcome.s: Driver extricated and handed to medical personnel, carriageway cleaned up and the vehicle removed.
messages.incident.ROAD_TRUCK_OVERTURNED.outcome.p: Driver freed, but recovering the vehicle and its load kept the road closed for hours.
messages.incident.ROAD_TRUCK_OVERTURNED.outcome.f: The response came too late: the spilled fuel made things worse and the stretch stays closed for a long time.
messages.incident.FIRE_PARKING_GARAGE.title: Underground car park fire
messages.incident.FIRE_PARKING_GARAGE.summary: Several vehicles alight in an underground car park: dense smoke and difficult ventilation.
messages.incident.FIRE_PARKING_GARAGE.radio: Control to all units: fire in an underground car park at {address}, {municipality}. Several vehicles involved, dense smoke, check for people on the lower levels.
incident.FIRE_PARKING_GARAGE.report.intr: Cars are reported on fire in an underground car park at {address}.
Several callers in {municipality} report dense smoke from the ramps of a car park at {address}.
Urgent attendance requested for a fire on the basement level of a car park at {address}, {municipality}.
The attendant reports flames among the parked vehicles at {address}.
Residents of the building at {address} report smoke rising from the communal car park.
incident.FIRE_PARKING_GARAGE.report.deta: A parked car caught fire and the flames have spread to the vehicles next to it.
Smoke has filled the entire level and there is no visibility at all.
The fire involves several vehicles and the heat has already burst their tyres.
Smoke is rising up the ramps and the stairwells towards the flats above.
incident.FIRE_PARKING_GARAGE.report.cond: It cannot be ruled out that someone is still on the lower levels.
The smoke extraction system appears not to be working.
The only access ramp is narrow and the appliances cannot get down it.
incident.FIRE_PARKING_GARAGE.report.clos: Crews with breathing apparatus and positive-pressure fans are requested to ventilate the basement levels.
Residents have been advised to stay in their flats with the windows closed.
Police support requested to close the area and keep the access ramps clear.
messages.incident.FIRE_PARKING_GARAGE.outcome.suc: Fire put out and the basement level ventilated, with nobody involved.
messages.incident.FIRE_PARKING_GARAGE.outcome.par: Flames knocked down after a long operation: several vehicles destroyed and the car park is unusable.
messages.incident.FIRE_PARKING_GARAGE.outcome.fai: The response came too late: the fire spread across most of the level and smoke filled the building above, which was evacuated.
messages.incident.FIRE_INDUSTRIAL_PLANT.title: Industrial plant fire
messages.incident.FIRE_INDUSTRIAL_PLANT.summary: Major fire at a plant holding hazardous materials: a huge smoke plume over built-up areas.
messages.incident.FIRE_INDUSTRIAL_PLANT.radio: Control to all units: major fire at an industrial plant at {address}, {municipality}. Hazardous materials present, smoke plume over housing, advise residents to stay indoors.
incident.FIRE_INDUSTRIAL_PLANT.report.in: A major fire is reported at an industrial plant at {address}.
Dozens of callers in {municipality} report a huge column of smoke over the industrial estate, at {address}.
A large-scale response is requested for a fire at a plant holding hazardous materials at {address}, {municipality}.
The safety manager of the plant at {address} reports a fire out of control in the production halls.
Neighbouring towns are also reporting the smoke from the industrial fire at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.FIRE_INDUSTRIAL_PLANT.report.de: The fire involves the production hall and is spreading towards the solvent store.
A column of black smoke is rising from the plant and drifting down over the housing.
Chemicals are stored inside in drums and tanks, some of them already involved.
Several roofs have collapsed and the fire is feeding on everything in the hall.
incident.FIRE_INDUSTRIAL_PLANT.report.co: The roll call of staff is still under way and some shift workers cannot be accounted for.
The wind is pushing the plume towards the nearest built-up area.
Fire water run-off is draining towards the nearby watercourse.
incident.FIRE_INDUSTRIAL_PLANT.report.cl: Multiple Fire Brigade crews, the hazmat unit, water tankers and a forward command post are requested.
Residents have been advised to stay indoors, close the windows and switch off ventilation systems.
Police support requested to close the access roads; the company is providing the safety data sheets.
messages.incident.FIRE_INDUSTRIAL_PLANT.outcome.s: Fire contained to the halls involved, the plume monitored and the hazardous materials made safe.
messages.incident.FIRE_INDUSTRIAL_PLANT.outcome.p: Fire brought under control after many hours: the plant is badly damaged and checks on the plume and the run-off continue.
messages.incident.FIRE_INDUSTRIAL_PLANT.outcome.f: Not enough resources: the fire reached the hazardous material stores and the nearest housing had to be evacuated.
messages.incident.MED_ALLERGIC_REACTION.title: Allergic reaction
messages.incident.MED_ALLERGIC_REACTION.summary: Person having an allergic reaction: swelling, hives and possible difficulty breathing.
messages.incident.MED_ALLERGIC_REACTION.radio: Control to all units: allergic reaction at {address}, {municipality}. Check breathing straight away, ambulance requested and advanced support if needed.
incident.MED_ALLERGIC_REACTION.report.in: Medical assistance requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a person having an allergic reaction.
Call from {address}: person with facial swelling that came on within minutes.
Ambulance requested in {municipality}, {address}, for a suspected allergic reaction.
