A caller at {address}, {municipality}, reports a person with widespread hives and severe itching.
incident.MED_ALLERGIC_REACTION.report.de: Symptoms started shortly after a meal eaten out.
The person reports being stung by an insect while outdoors.
The patient took a new medicine about half an hour before the symptoms appeared.
Swelling of the lips and tongue is reported, and the voice is starting to change.
incident.MED_ALLERGIC_REACTION.report.co: The patient is conscious and reports a tight feeling in the throat.
Bystanders have sat the person down somewhere cool and well ventilated.
A relative says there is a prescribed adrenaline auto-injector in the house.
incident.MED_ALLERGIC_REACTION.report.cl: Immediate assessment of the airway requested when the crew arrives.
The call-taker is staying on the line and will call back if breathing gets worse.
Transport to the emergency department requested for observation even if the person improves.
messages.incident.MED_ALLERGIC_REACTION.outcome.s: Reaction treated early: the patient improved on scene and was taken in for observation.
messages.incident.MED_ALLERGIC_REACTION.outcome.p: Patient stabilised, but the delay meant breathing support was needed during transport.
messages.incident.MED_ALLERGIC_REACTION.outcome.f: The crew arrived late: breathing deteriorated and the patient was handed over to an advanced crew.
messages.incident.MED_DIABETIC.title: Blood sugar emergency
messages.incident.MED_DIABETIC.summary: Diabetic patient with abnormal readings: confusion, sweating and possible loss of contact.
messages.incident.MED_DIABETIC.radio: Control to all units: blood sugar emergency at {address}, {municipality}. Known diabetic patient, ambulance requested for assessment and treatment.
incident.MED_DIABETIC.report.intros: Medical assistance requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a diabetic person feeling unwell.
Call from {address}: person confused and sweating, known diabetes.
Ambulance requested in {municipality}, {address}, for a diabetic patient with abnormal readings.
A relative reports from {address}, {municipality}, a person barely responding after going a long time without food.
incident.MED_DIABETIC.report.details: The home meter shows a very low reading and the person can hardly drink anything sugary.
The patient skipped a meal after taking the usual medication.
Relatives report confusion, trembling and cold sweating that started recently.
The person reports intense thirst and marked tiredness over the last few hours.
incident.MED_DIABETIC.report.conditions: The patient is awake but slow to respond and cannot get up unaided.
The relatives know the treatment plan and have the medical records ready.
The flat is on the ground floor and stretcher access is straightforward.
incident.MED_DIABETIC.report.closings: Assessment on scene requested, including a blood sugar reading.
The call-taker asked that nothing be given by mouth unless the person is fully alert.
The caller is staying with the patient and will meet the crew at the door.
messages.incident.MED_DIABETIC.outcome.success: Readings corrected on scene: the patient recovered and was taken in for checks.
messages.incident.MED_DIABETIC.outcome.partial: Patient treated, but the long wait meant transport to hospital was needed.
messages.incident.MED_DIABETIC.outcome.failure: The crew arrived late: the level of consciousness worsened and the patient was handed over to another crew.
messages.incident.MED_SEIZURE.title: Seizure
messages.incident.MED_SEIZURE.summary: Person having a seizure, or just after one, needing assessment while coming round.
messages.incident.MED_SEIZURE.radio: Control to all units: seizure at {address}, {municipality}. Ambulance requested, protect the patient until the crew arrives.
incident.MED_SEIZURE.report.intros: Medical assistance requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a person having convulsions.
Call from {address}: person on the floor with involuntary movements, seizure in progress.
Ambulance requested in {municipality}, {address}, for a seizure that has just ended.
A caller at {address}, {municipality}, reports a person rigid and unresponsive for several minutes.
incident.MED_SEIZURE.report.details: The seizure lasted about a minute and the person is now breathing noisily.
The patient has known epilepsy and has missed the medication for several days.
This is the second seizure within an hour, with no full recovery in between.
The person hit their head falling and there is a small scalp wound.
incident.MED_SEIZURE.report.conditions: Bystanders cleared the space around the person and did not try to restrain the movements.
The person is in a closed room and the bathroom door is locked from the inside.
The patient is now coming round, confused and not very cooperative.
incident.MED_SEIZURE.report.closings: Nothing to be put in the mouth, and the person is to be kept on their side.
Assessment on scene requested, with transport for neurological checks.
The caller is staying on the line and will report any further seizure.
messages.incident.MED_SEIZURE.outcome.success: Patient looked after while coming round and taken to the emergency department in stable condition.
messages.incident.MED_SEIZURE.outcome.partial: Patient taken into care, but a further seizure during the wait made transport harder.
messages.incident.MED_SEIZURE.outcome.failure: The ambulance arrived far too late: the seizures repeated and the patient was handed over to an advanced crew.
messages.incident.MED_ABDOMINAL_PAIN.title: Abdominal pain
messages.incident.MED_ABDOMINAL_PAIN.summary: Person with persistent abdominal pain, assessment and transport to the emergency department requested.
messages.incident.MED_ABDOMINAL_PAIN.radio: Control to all units: abdominal pain at {address}, {municipality}. Patient conscious, basic ambulance requested for assessment.
incident.MED_ABDOMINAL_PAIN.report.intro: Medical assistance requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a person with severe stomach pain.
Call from {address}: person with abdominal pain that has not eased for hours.
Ambulance requested in {municipality}, {address}, for abdominal pain of unclear origin.
A caller at {address}, {municipality}, reports a person doubled up in pain and feeling sick.
incident.MED_ABDOMINAL_PAIN.report.detai: The pain started after dinner and has gradually got worse.
The patient reports nausea and one episode of vomiting, with no fever.
The person points to the lower right side of the abdomen as the worst spot.
The patient has had similar episodes before, never this prolonged.
incident.MED_ABDOMINAL_PAIN.report.condi: The patient is conscious, pale and prefers to stay lying down.
The flat is on an upper floor and the lift is very small.
A relative has the documents and the list of medications ready.
incident.MED_ABDOMINAL_PAIN.report.closi: Assessment on scene requested, with transport to the emergency department for checks.
The call-taker asked that no medication or food be given before the examination.
The caller will wait for the crew at the street door to show them up.
messages.incident.MED_ABDOMINAL_PAIN.outcome.succ: Patient assessed and taken to the emergency department for checks in stable condition.
messages.incident.MED_ABDOMINAL_PAIN.outcome.part: Patient transported, but the long wait made the transfer harder than expected.
messages.incident.MED_ABDOMINAL_PAIN.outcome.fail: The ambulance arrived late: the pain got worse and the patient was handed over to another crew.
messages.incident.MED_ELDERLY_ASSIST.title: Assistance to an elderly person
messages.incident.MED_ELDERLY_ASSIST.summary: Elderly person on the floor with no obvious injury: help to lift them and a check-over are needed.
messages.incident.MED_ELDERLY_ASSIST.radio: Control to all units: elderly person on the floor at {address}, {municipality}. No obvious injury, ambulance requested for lifting assistance and assessment.
incident.MED_ELDERLY_ASSIST.report.intro: Elderly person on the floor reported at {address}.
Medical assistance requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a person who cannot get up.
Call from {address}: elderly person slipped at home, conscious and calm.
Ambulance requested in {municipality}, {address}, to assist a person who needs help at home.
A neighbour reports from {address}, {municipality}, an elderly person on the floor calling for help.
incident.MED_ELDERLY_ASSIST.report.detai: The person slipped out of bed and has not managed to get back up.
No injury is reported: the person moves arms and legs without pain.
The carer says this has been happening every few weeks recently.
The person has been on the floor for about an hour and has got cold.
incident.MED_ELDERLY_ASSIST.report.condi: The patient is conscious, oriented and answers questions correctly.
The flat is cramped and the hallway makes stretcher use difficult.
The front door is locked and relatives are on their way with the keys.
incident.MED_ELDERLY_ASSIST.report.closi: Help with lifting requested, plus a check-over before leaving the person at home.
The call-taker asked that the person be covered and not moved single-handed.
The caller is staying on scene until the crew arrives.
messages.incident.MED_ELDERLY_ASSIST.outcome.succ: Person lifted safely, checked over on scene and left at home in good condition.
messages.incident.MED_ELDERLY_ASSIST.outcome.part: Person helped, but the long time spent on the floor meant transport for checks was needed.
messages.incident.MED_ELDERLY_ASSIST.outcome.fail: The crew arrived very late: the person stayed on the floor for a long time and was handed over to another crew.
messages.incident.MED_INTOXICATION.title: Alcohol intoxication
messages.incident.MED_INTOXICATION.summary: Person heavily intoxicated in the street or outside a bar, police support may be needed.
messages.incident.MED_INTOXICATION.radio: Control to all units: clearly intoxicated person at {address}, {municipality}. Ambulance requested, consider police support.
incident.MED_INTOXICATION.report.intros: Medical assistance requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a person unable to stand.
Call from {address}: person on the ground near a bar, barely responding.
Ambulance requested in {municipality}, {address}, for a person who is clearly drunk.
A passer-by reports from {address}, {municipality}, a person sitting on the pavement in a confused state.
incident.MED_INTOXICATION.report.details: The person answers in single words and cannot give any personal details.
Bystanders describe heavy drinking through the course of the evening.
The person has vomited several times and cannot stay sitting up unaided.
It is unclear whether anything besides alcohol has been taken.
incident.MED_INTOXICATION.report.conditi: A group of bystanders has gathered round the person and the scene is noisy.
The person is lying outdoors on the ground and the temperature is low.
Some bystanders are uncooperative and are blocking access to the patient.
incident.MED_INTOXICATION.report.closing: Assessment on scene requested, along with support to manage the bystanders.
The call-taker asked that the person be put on their side and not left alone.
Transport to the emergency department requested for observation.
messages.incident.MED_INTOXICATION.outcome.succes: Patient assessed, made safe and taken to the emergency department without complications.
messages.incident.MED_INTOXICATION.outcome.partia: Patient taken into care, but dealing with the bystanders slowed the response down.
messages.incident.MED_INTOXICATION.outcome.failur: The crew arrived late: the person deteriorated and was handed over to another crew.
messages.incident.MED_WORKPLACE_INJURY.title: Workplace injury
messages.incident.MED_WORKPLACE_INJURY.summary: Worker injured at a plant or building site, releasing and making the scene safe may be needed.
messages.incident.MED_WORKPLACE_INJURY.radio: Control to all units: workplace injury at {address}, {municipality}. Ambulance requested, consider fire and rescue support to make the scene safe.
incident.MED_WORKPLACE_INJURY.report.int: Medical assistance requested at {address}, {municipality}, for an injured worker.
Call from {address}: worker injured while operating machinery.
Ambulance requested in {municipality}, {address}, for an injury on the shop floor.
The safety officer reports from {address}, {municipality}, a worker who fell during operations.
incident.MED_WORKPLACE_INJURY.report.det: The worker fell from a ladder and reports back and limb pain.
A limb was caught in a machine, which has now been stopped and made safe.
An arm injury is reported, already dressed by colleagues with the first-aid kit.
The worker suffered a contact burn during hot work.
incident.MED_WORKPLACE_INJURY.report.con: Colleagues have cordoned off the area and operations have been suspended.
The spot can only be reached along a narrow path between the machines.
The safety officer will meet the crew at the gate to show them in.
incident.MED_WORKPLACE_INJURY.report.clo: Assessment on scene requested, with transport to hospital for checks.
The machinery is not to be restarted until the operation is over.
The company will make the accident paperwork available.
messages.incident.MED_WORKPLACE_INJURY.outcome.su: Worker released and stabilised quickly, taken to hospital in stable condition.
messages.incident.MED_WORKPLACE_INJURY.outcome.pa: Worker treated, but the difficult access stretched out the time to transport.
messages.incident.MED_WORKPLACE_INJURY.outcome.fa: The crew arrived late: the condition worsened and the casualty was handed over to another crew.
messages.incident.MED_SPORTS_INJURY.title: Sports injury
messages.incident.MED_SPORTS_INJURY.summary: Athlete injured during sport, usually a limb injury.
messages.incident.MED_SPORTS_INJURY.radio: Control to all units: sports injury at {address}, {municipality}. Patient conscious, ambulance requested for assessment and transport.
incident.MED_SPORTS_INJURY.report.intros: Medical assistance requested at {address}, {municipality}, for an injured athlete.
Call from {address}: player down after a collision.
Ambulance requested in {municipality}, {address}, for an injury during training.
The organiser reports from {address}, {municipality}, a competitor injured during the event.
incident.MED_SPORTS_INJURY.report.detail: The athlete has severe knee pain and cannot put weight on the foot.
A shoulder injury is reported after a fall onto an outstretched arm.
The player took a blow to the head and was dazed for a few moments.
A suspected forearm fracture is reported, with obvious deformity.
incident.MED_SPORTS_INJURY.report.condit: The casualty is conscious and looked after by the staff, who stopped the session.
Vehicles can only reach the gate, after which a stretcher is needed.
There are a lot of spectators and the access route has to be cleared.
incident.MED_SPORTS_INJURY.report.closin: Immobilisation of the limb requested, with transport to the emergency department.
The staff are staying with the casualty and keeping the route clear for the ambulance.
The call-taker asked that the athlete not be moved before the crew arrives.
messages.incident.MED_SPORTS_INJURY.outcome.succe: Casualty carefully immobilised and taken to the emergency department for checks.
messages.incident.MED_SPORTS_INJURY.outcome.parti: Casualty transported, but the long wait on the pitch increased the pain and distress.
messages.incident.MED_SPORTS_INJURY.outcome.failu: The ambulance arrived far too late: the casualty was taken away by others and handed over to a different crew.
messages.incident.MED_HEAT_STROKE.title: Heat stroke
messages.incident.MED_HEAT_STROKE.summary: Person taken ill in severe heat, with possible impairment of consciousness.
messages.incident.MED_HEAT_STROKE.radio: Control to all units: suspected heat stroke at {address}, {municipality}. Ambulance requested, start cooling the patient immediately.
incident.MED_HEAT_STROKE.report.intros: Medical assistance requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a person taken ill in the heat.
Call from {address}: person collapsed in the sun, skin hot and flushed.
Ambulance requested in {municipality}, {address}, for an illness linked to the high temperatures.
A caller at {address}, {municipality}, reports a worker who fell ill out in the sun.
incident.MED_HEAT_STROKE.report.details: The person worked outdoors for hours without drinking enough.
The patient is confused, with hot dry skin, and struggles to answer.
Widespread cramps and a strong feeling of weakness are reported.
The person fell ill during an outdoor event in the hottest part of the day.
incident.MED_HEAT_STROKE.report.conditio: The temperature is very high and there is no shade in the area.
Bystanders have moved the person into the shade and wet their face.
Other people nearby also report feeling unwell in the heat.
incident.MED_HEAT_STROKE.report.closings: Cooling is to continue, and nothing is to be given to drink unless the person is alert.
Assessment on scene requested, with transport to hospital for checks.
The caller is staying on the line and will report on the level of consciousness.
messages.incident.MED_HEAT_STROKE.outcome.success: Patient cooled quickly and taken to hospital in stable condition.
messages.incident.MED_HEAT_STROKE.outcome.partial: Patient treated, but the long exposure to the heat called for more intensive care than expected.
messages.incident.MED_HEAT_STROKE.outcome.failure: The crew arrived late: the level of consciousness worsened and the patient was handed over to an advanced crew.
messages.incident.MED_RESPIRATORY_CRISIS.title: Breathing crisis
messages.incident.MED_RESPIRATORY_CRISIS.summary: Person in severe respiratory distress: oxygen therapy and advanced assessment needed.
messages.incident.MED_RESPIRATORY_CRISIS.radio: Control to all units: breathing crisis at {address}, {municipality}. Patient in respiratory distress, crew with oxygen requested.
incident.MED_RESPIRATORY_CRISIS.report.i: Medical assistance requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a person struggling to breathe.
Call from {address}: person sitting upright, breathing hard and speaking one word at a time.
Ambulance requested in {municipality}, {address}, for a worsening breathing crisis.
A relative reports from {address}, {municipality}, a patient with known lung disease in crisis.
incident.MED_RESPIRATORY_CRISIS.report.d: The patient has already used their own inhaler with no benefit.
The breathing is noisy and a wheeze can be heard from across the room.
The difficulty started in the night and has worsened over the last few hours.
The patient depends on oxygen and the home cylinder is nearly empty.
incident.MED_RESPIRATORY_CRISIS.report.c: The person is conscious but agitated and prefers to stay sitting up.
The flat can only be reached by a narrow staircase, with no lift.
The room is closed and stuffy; the relatives have opened the windows.
A crew with oxygen and an advanced assessment on scene are requested.
The call-taker asked that the person be kept sitting and not made to walk.
The caller will wait in the street to show the crew in.
Patient given oxygen and stabilised on scene, taken to hospital in improved condition.
Patient transported, but the late arrival of advanced support made the journey more critical.
The crew arrived far too late: breathing deteriorated and the patient was handed over to an advanced crew.
messages.incident.MED_OBSTETRIC.title: Obstetric emergency
messages.incident.MED_OBSTETRIC.summary: Advanced labour or a complication in pregnancy: transport to a maternity unit is needed.
messages.incident.MED_OBSTETRIC.radio: Control to all units: obstetric emergency at {address}, {municipality}. Ambulance requested for transport to the nearest maternity unit.
incident.MED_OBSTETRIC.report.intros: Medical assistance requested at {address}, {municipality}, for a woman in labour.
Call from {address}: contractions close together, travelling by car is not possible.
Ambulance requested in {municipality}, {address}, for a complication in pregnancy.
A relative reports from {address}, {municipality}, a pregnant woman with contractions close together and severe pain.
incident.MED_OBSTETRIC.report.details: Contractions are two minutes apart and the woman feels the urge to push.
The pregnancy is at thirty-six weeks and the birth was not expected yet.
The woman is unwell and the pregnancy is described as at term.
The woman reports reduced movements of the baby over the last few hours.
incident.MED_OBSTETRIC.report.conditions: The road to the nearest hospital is long and the transport time is significant.
The house is isolated and the address needs confirming once the crew is in the area.
The woman is being looked after by a relative and stays calm, lying on her side.
incident.MED_OBSTETRIC.report.closings: Transport to a maternity unit requested, with advance notice to the hospital.
The call-taker has given instructions in case the birth is imminent.

incident.POL_VEHICLE_PURSUIT.report.intr: A vehicle failed to stop and is making off from {address}.
A patrol reports a pursuit under way from {address}, {municipality}.
Immediate support requested at {address} for a vehicle making off at speed.
Stolen car sighted at {address}: the driver accelerated on seeing the patrol.
Report from {address}, {municipality}: vehicle driving the wrong way and causing panic.
incident.POL_VEHICLE_PURSUIT.report.deta: The vehicle is travelling fast and overtaking recklessly.
There are said to be at least two people on board.
Only part of the registration was read and is being checked.
The vehicle has already struck two parked cars without stopping.
incident.POL_VEHICLE_PURSUIT.report.cond: Traffic is heavy and the pursuit is crossing a residential area.
The route leads to the motorway junction: few useful points to close it off.
Wet surface and poor grip along the whole route.
incident.POL_VEHICLE_PURSUIT.report.clos: Units are requested for road blocks and traffic management.
Air support can keep visual contact and reduce the risk on the ground.
Break off the pursuit if the risk to the public becomes excessive.
messages.incident.POL_VEHICLE_PURSUIT.outcome.suc: Vehicle stopped safely and the occupants detained without incident.
messages.incident.POL_VEHICLE_PURSUIT.outcome.par: Pursuit called off for safety reasons: the vehicle was found abandoned shortly afterwards.
messages.incident.POL_VEHICLE_PURSUIT.outcome.fai: The chase ended in a collision: injuries on the road and the occupants gone.
messages.incident.POL_MISSING_CHILD.title: Missing child
messages.incident.POL_MISSING_CHILD.summary: Child who has wandered off from home or from a group: immediate area search.
messages.incident.POL_MISSING_CHILD.radio: Control to all units: missing child at {address}, {municipality}. Immediate search of the surrounding area.
incident.POL_MISSING_CHILD.report.intros: A child is reported missing at {address}.
Parents lost sight of their child near {address}, {municipality}.
Urgent search requested at {address} for a child who has wandered off from a group.
A school at {address} reports that a pupil did not return to class after the break.
Call from {address}, {municipality}: a little girl was seen walking off alone along the path.
incident.POL_MISSING_CHILD.report.detail: The child is eight years old and is wearing a red windbreaker.
The last sighting was less than thirty minutes ago.
The child barely knows the area and has no phone.
The family have already checked the house and the relatives' homes.
incident.POL_MISSING_CHILD.report.condit: The area takes in a park with several exits and a strip of open country.
The temperature is dropping fast as the evening comes on.
An unfenced irrigation channel runs nearby.
incident.POL_MISSING_CHILD.report.closin: Units are requested for a systematic search and to cover the sensitive points.
Dog units can start from the last confirmed sighting.
Bring in volunteers only once the search sectors have been set.
messages.incident.POL_MISSING_CHILD.outcome.succe: Child found in good condition and handed back to the family.
messages.incident.POL_MISSING_CHILD.outcome.parti: The child was found, but only after hours of searching and clearly hypothermic.
messages.incident.POL_MISSING_CHILD.outcome.failu: The search found nothing in the critical window: the case has moved to an extended search.
messages.incident.POL_DEMONSTRATION.title: Public demonstration
messages.incident.POL_DEMONSTRATION.summary: March with moments of tension: public order and traffic management.
messages.incident.POL_DEMONSTRATION.radio: Control to all units: public order operation for the demonstration at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.POL_DEMONSTRATION.report.intros: A public order operation has been set up for the demonstration at {address}.
A march is setting off from {address}, {municipality}, with a few thousand people expected.
Tension is reported among those taking part in the rally at {address}.
An unannounced group has joined the march at {address}.
Reinforcement of the deployment requested at {address}, {municipality}, as the march goes through.
incident.POL_DEMONSTRATION.report.detail: The route crosses the old town and passes several sensitive premises.
A group at the head of the march is refusing to follow the stewards' instructions.
The organisers are cooperating but are struggling to keep their own stewards in control.
A counter-rally has gathered a few hundred metres from the route.
incident.POL_DEMONSTRATION.report.condit: The side streets are narrow and would let the march scatter quickly.
The town centre has to be closed off progressively as the marchers pass.
Outdoor seating and roadworks along the route create friction points.
incident.POL_DEMONSTRATION.report.closin: Units are requested for containment and traffic management.
Keep a steady line of communication open with the organisers.
Arrange a medical post close to the route.
messages.incident.POL_DEMONSTRATION.outcome.succe: Demonstration ended without incident and the roads reopened on schedule.
messages.incident.POL_DEMONSTRATION.outcome.parti: The march was managed, but with moments of tension and some damage.
messages.incident.POL_DEMONSTRATION.outcome.failu: The deployment was too thin: clashes along the route, injuries and widespread damage.
messages.incident.POL_ARMED_ROBBERY.title: Armed robbery
messages.incident.POL_ARMED_ROBBERY.summary: Robbery in progress or just committed, with armed offenders making off.
messages.incident.POL_ARMED_ROBBERY.radio: Control to all units: armed robbery at {address}, {municipality}. Offenders armed, use extreme caution.
incident.POL_ARMED_ROBBERY.report.intros: The owner of a business at {address}, {municipality}, reports two armed men who have just left.
Urgent attendance requested at {address} for a robbery in progress.
The silent alarm of a branch at {address} has been triggered by staff.
Call from {address}, {municipality}: a customer reports a loud bang and people running out.
incident.POL_ARMED_ROBBERY.report.detail: Two offenders are reported, who left quickly on a scooter.
They made off on a scooter heading for the outskirts.
Customers and staff inside are in shock.
The haul is said to be the day's takings and some valuables.
incident.POL_ARMED_ROBBERY.report.condit: The street carries traffic both ways, with plenty of side roads to escape through.
The business is inside a shopping arcade with three separate exits.
Rush hour makes it hard to seal the scene without causing panic.
incident.POL_ARMED_ROBBERY.report.closin: Several units are requested for the scene and for the search.
Arrange medical support for those in shock.
Secure the indoor and outdoor camera recordings straight away.
messages.incident.POL_ARMED_ROBBERY.outcome.succe: Scene secured, witnesses cared for and the offenders intercepted.
messages.incident.POL_ARMED_ROBBERY.outcome.parti: The situation was stabilised, but the offenders managed to get away.
messages.incident.POL_ARMED_ROBBERY.outcome.failu: Late attendance: offenders long gone, people injured and the scene compromised.
messages.incident.POL_DRUG_OPERATION.title: Drugs operation
messages.incident.POL_DRUG_OPERATION.summary: Dawn search of premises used for dealing.
messages.incident.POL_DRUG_OPERATION.radio: Control: operation at {address}, {municipality}. Entry and search of the premises, keep radio silence.
incident.POL_DRUG_OPERATION.report.intro: A search operation has been ordered at {address}.
Entry is scheduled at dawn at premises at {address}, {municipality}.
Units requested for a drugs operation at {address}.
The investigation points to a store of substances in a warehouse at {address}.
Coordinated operation at {address}, {municipality}, on several flats in the same block.
incident.POL_DRUG_OPERATION.report.detai: The premises have two ways in and an external staircase at the back.
There may be several people inside, some of them already known.
Packaging materials and laboratory equipment are expected.
Dog units are essential to search the concealed spaces.
incident.POL_DRUG_OPERATION.report.condi: The neighbourhood wakes early: the window for entry is short.
The warehouse is cluttered and visibility inside is poor.
Volatile substances mean the premises must be ventilated with care.
incident.POL_DRUG_OPERATION.report.closi: Units are requested for the perimeter, the entry and the examination.
Arrange medical support in case of poisoning.
Seized material must be logged and moved under a chain of custody.
messages.incident.POL_DRUG_OPERATION.outcome.succ: Operation completed with everything seized and nobody hurt.
messages.incident.POL_DRUG_OPERATION.outcome.part: The search went ahead, but part of the material had already been moved.
messages.incident.POL_DRUG_OPERATION.outcome.fail: The operation was compromised: an incomplete perimeter let several people escape out the back.
messages.incident.POL_HOSTAGE_SITUATION.title: Hostage situation
messages.incident.POL_HOSTAGE_SITUATION.summary: People held against their will: security perimeter and negotiation.
messages.incident.POL_HOSTAGE_SITUATION.radio: Control to all units: people held at {address}, {municipality}. Set up the perimeter and open negotiations.
incident.POL_HOSTAGE_SITUATION.report.in: People are reported being held against their will at {address}.
A call from {address}, {municipality}, reports an armed man stopping anyone from leaving the premises.
Immediate attendance requested at {address}: possible hostage situation.
A robbery at {address} has turned into a stand-off with customers inside.
Report from {address}, {municipality}: person barricaded at home with a relative.
incident.POL_HOSTAGE_SITUATION.report.de: Three people are believed to be inside besides the man responsible.
He has asked to speak to a negotiator.
The windows have been blacked out and the inside cannot be seen.
One person managed to get out and is describing the layout of the premises.
incident.POL_HOSTAGE_SITUATION.report.co: The building stands on a central street with many businesses open.
The perimeter means closing two junctions and diverting the traffic.
Families live on the upper floors and must be evacuated quietly.
incident.POL_HOSTAGE_SITUATION.report.cl: Units are requested for the perimeter, the evacuation and the traffic.
Set up a forward medical point out of the line of sight.
No independent action: every move goes through the operation commander.
messages.incident.POL_HOSTAGE_SITUATION.outcome.s: Situation resolved with everyone released and the man responsible detained.
messages.incident.POL_HOSTAGE_SITUATION.outcome.p: The hostages were released, but only after many hours and not all of them unharmed.
messages.incident.POL_HOSTAGE_SITUATION.outcome.f: Perimeter too thin and negotiations failed: a heavy toll and a strong public reaction.
messages.incident.POL_STADIUM_DISORDER.title: Stadium disorder
messages.incident.POL_STADIUM_DISORDER.summary: Clashes between rival supporters inside and outside the ground.
messages.incident.POL_STADIUM_DISORDER.radio: Control to all units: disorder at the sports ground at {address}, {municipality}. Immediate reinforcements to the gates.
incident.POL_STADIUM_DISORDER.report.int: Disorder reported at the sports ground at {address}.
Clashes between rival supporters near the gates at {address}, {municipality}.
Immediate reinforcements requested at {address}: objects being thrown from the stands.
A group of supporters has forced the turnstiles of the ground at {address}.
Report from {address}, {municipality}: scuffles in the car park at the end of the match.
incident.POL_STADIUM_DISORDER.report.det: Some seats have been torn out and used as missiles.
Smoke flares have been lit and are cutting visibility in the away section.
Two groups are facing off along the approach avenue to the ground.
The crowd is already leaving and must be steered away from the clashes.
incident.POL_STADIUM_DISORDER.report.con: Thousands of people are heading for the car parks at the same time.
The gates are pedestrian only: vehicles have to stay on the avenue.
Outside lighting is patchy and the forecourt offers no cover.
incident.POL_STADIUM_DISORDER.report.clo: Units are requested to hold the gates and keep the two sets of supporters apart.
Set up a medical rally point clear of the crowd flow.
Work with the stewards to empty the sections in an orderly way.
messages.incident.POL_STADIUM_DISORDER.outcome.su: Supporters kept apart and the ground emptied with no further trouble.
messages.incident.POL_STADIUM_DISORDER.outcome.pa: The clashes were contained, but with injuries and damage to the ground.
messages.incident.POL_STADIUM_DISORDER.outcome.fa: The deployment was overwhelmed: clashes spread into the neighbourhood, many injured and serious damage.
messages.incident.POL_PUBLIC_ATTACK.title: Attack in a crowded place
messages.incident.POL_PUBLIC_ATTACK.summary: A deliberate explosion in a crowded place: many injured, an area to be made safe and a joint public-order and medical response.
messages.incident.POL_PUBLIC_ATTACK.radio: Control to all units: deliberate explosion at {address}, {municipality}. Wide perimeter, bomb-disposal team to clear the area and a forward medical point.
incident.POL_PUBLIC_ATTACK.report.intros: An explosion in a crowded place is reported at {address}, {municipality}.
Calls are coming in together: a loud blast and many people injured at {address}.
Immediate mobilisation requested for a deliberate act with numerous injured at {address}, {municipality}.
The patrol in the area confirms a blast and a crowd streaming away from {address}.
A shopkeeper reports an explosion at the entrance of the premises at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.POL_PUBLIC_ATTACK.report.detail: The injured are numerous and spread across the whole forecourt.
The cause is believed to be deliberate and the area cannot be treated as safe.
Part of the structure is unusable and some people are still inside.
Some witnesses describe a second bag left unattended a few metres away.
incident.POL_PUBLIC_ATTACK.report.condit: The area is crowded and the disorderly flow of people is holding up the arriving units.
Until the bomb-disposal team has cleared it, rescuers must stay beyond the perimeter.
The hospitals in the area need to be warned for a staggered intake.
incident.POL_PUBLIC_ATTACK.report.closin: Bomb-disposal, dog units, public-order units and a forward medical point are requested.
Set up two perimeters, one for safety and one for the casualties, with a single way in.
Triage and transport are coordinated by the medical commander, not by individual crews.
messages.incident.POL_PUBLIC_ATTACK.outcome.succe: Area cleared, the injured triaged and transported, perimeter held with no further harm.
messages.incident.POL_PUBLIC_ATTACK.outcome.parti: The injured were treated, but slowly and with a perimeter held only in part.
messages.incident.POL_PUBLIC_ATTACK.outcome.failu: Response too thin: help arrived late, the area was never cleared and command passed to other units.
messages.incident.WF_ROADSIDE_VERGE.title: Roadside verge fire
messages.incident.WF_ROADSIDE_VERGE.summary: Dry vegetation burning along the verge of a country road.
messages.incident.WF_ROADSIDE_VERGE.radio: Control to all units: vegetation fire on the verge at {address}, {municipality}. Smoke drifting across the carriageway, wildland crew requested.
incident.WF_ROADSIDE_VERGE.report.intros: Scrub fire reported along the verge at {address}.
A driver reports flames on the roadside at {address}, {municipality}.
Assistance requested for burning vegetation beside the road at {address}.
Several callers report smoke drifting across the carriageway at {address}.
A patrol passing through {municipality} reports a starting fire on the verge at {address}.
incident.WF_ROADSIDE_VERGE.report.detail: A strip of dry grass and brambles a few metres wide is burning along the edge.
The flames are running along the embankment, fanned by passing traffic.
The front is low but is moving towards the rough ground beyond the ditch.
The cause is almost certainly a cigarette thrown from a passing car.
incident.WF_ROADSIDE_VERGE.report.condit: Smoke is cutting visibility for drivers on the road.
Beyond the verge the ground opens into a field of dry scrub.
The road is narrow and there is no lay-by to park the vehicles safely.
incident.WF_ROADSIDE_VERGE.report.closin: A wildland crew with a firefighting module is requested.
Police support is requested to slow traffic while the crews work.
The caller was advised to drive on and not to stop on the verge.
messages.incident.WF_ROADSIDE_VERGE.outcome.succe: The front was knocked down quickly and the verge damped down, with no interruption to traffic.
messages.incident.WF_ROADSIDE_VERGE.outcome.parti: The fire was put out, but it had run along a long stretch of embankment before the crew arrived.
messages.incident.WF_ROADSIDE_VERGE.outcome.failu: The response came too late: the fire crossed the ditch and spread into the rough ground alongside.
messages.incident.WF_STUBBLE_FIELD.title: Stubble fire
messages.incident.WF_STUBBLE_FIELD.summary: Stubble burning in a field after the harvest, with a risk of spreading.
messages.incident.WF_STUBBLE_FIELD.radio: Control to all units: stubble fire at {address}, {municipality}. Front running in open field, wildland crew requested.
incident.WF_STUBBLE_FIELD.report.intros: Stubble fire reported in a field at {address}.
A farmer reports flames in the stubble at {address}, {municipality}.
Assistance requested for a fire in a harvested field at {address}.
Several residents report a column of smoke rising from the fields at {address}.
The landowner in {municipality} reports that the fire got away from him at {address}.
incident.WF_STUBBLE_FIELD.report.details: The front is moving fast through the dry stubble left by the harvester.
Straw residue is burning over several thousand square metres.
The wind is pushing the flames towards the field boundary and the vegetation along it.
Round bales stacked at the edge of the field have already been reached by the fire.
incident.WF_STUBBLE_FIELD.report.conditi: The plot can only be reached by an unmade farm track.
A belt of scrub connected to the woodland runs along the field boundary.
There is no water supply point anywhere nearby.
incident.WF_STUBBLE_FIELD.report.closing: A wildland crew with a firefighting pick-up is requested.
A water tender is requested to supply the crews on site.
The caller was advised to move the farm machinery away from the front.
messages.incident.WF_STUBBLE_FIELD.outcome.succes: The front was stopped at the field boundary, with no spread to the vegetation alongside.
messages.incident.WF_STUBBLE_FIELD.outcome.partia: The fire was contained, but it burned the whole field and licked the scrub along the boundary.
messages.incident.WF_STUBBLE_FIELD.outcome.failur: The front was not stopped in time and spread beyond the field into the surrounding vegetation.
messages.incident.WF_PRUNING_BURN.title: Prunings burn out of control
messages.incident.WF_PRUNING_BURN.summary: A bonfire of prunings has got away from the owner and is spreading into the vegetation.
messages.incident.WF_PRUNING_BURN.radio: Control to all units: prunings burn out of control at {address}, {municipality}. Fire spreading, wildland crew requested.
incident.WF_PRUNING_BURN.report.intros: A prunings burn that has got out of control is reported at {address}.
A neighbour reports that a bonfire of prunings is spreading at {address}, {municipality}.
Assistance requested for a fire lit by a private individual and now out of control at {address}.
Several callers report flames and thick smoke from private land at {address}.
The landowner in {municipality} is asking for help: the fire he lit at {address} has crossed the cleared strip.
incident.WF_PRUNING_BURN.report.details: The heap of prunings is burning and feeding a front that is widening across the dry grass.
The flames have crossed the cleared strip around the bonfire and are moving towards the hedge.
Prunings stacked together with dry vegetation residue are burning.
The wind has shifted and is pushing the fire towards the fruit trees.
incident.WF_PRUNING_BURN.report.conditio: A tool shed and several gas cylinders stand a short distance away.
The plot borders a belt of woodland.
The owner is trying to put the fire out himself with wholly inadequate means.
incident.WF_PRUNING_BURN.report.closings: A wildland crew is requested to contain the front.
An off-road vehicle is requested to reach the plot along the farm track.
A patrol is requested: the burn appears to be unauthorised and will have to be examined.
messages.incident.WF_PRUNING_BURN.outcome.success: The front was contained and damped down, and the fire never left the boundaries of the plot.
messages.incident.WF_PRUNING_BURN.outcome.partial: The fire was put out, but the flames damaged the hedge and part of the orchard.
messages.incident.WF_PRUNING_BURN.outcome.failure: The fire got away for good and reached the belt of woodland along the boundary.
messages.incident.WF_WASTE_DUMP.title: Waste-site fire
messages.incident.WF_WASTE_DUMP.summary: Heaps of waste burning at a storage site, with acrid smoke over the area.
messages.incident.WF_WASTE_DUMP.radio: Control to all units: waste fire at {address}, {municipality}. Toxic smoke over the area, wildland crews and a cordon requested.
incident.WF_WASTE_DUMP.report.intros: Fire reported in heaps of waste at {address}.
A resident reports black smoke and an acrid smell from a yard at {address}, {municipality}.
Assistance requested for a fire at a waste storage site at {address}.
Several callers report a dense column of smoke visible from far away at {address}.
The local police in {municipality} report flames among the heaps of waste at {address}.
incident.WF_WASTE_DUMP.report.details: Heaps of mixed waste, plastics and bulky refuse are burning.
The fire is smouldering deep inside the heaps and the flames keep breaking out again.
A column of black, acrid smoke is rising from the fire and settling over the area.
The front is threatening the dry vegetation that surrounds the storage yard.
incident.WF_WASTE_DUMP.report.conditions: The smoke is reaching the first houses downwind.
Deliberate ignition cannot be ruled out and the site must be preserved for examination.
The access routes into the yard are narrow and cluttered with material.
incident.WF_WASTE_DUMP.report.closings: Wildland crews and a water tender are requested for a long operation.
A police cordon and the municipal technical service are requested.
Residents downwind were advised to keep their windows shut.
messages.incident.WF_WASTE_DUMP.outcome.success: The fire was put out and the heaps damped down; the smoke plume dispersed without consequences.
messages.incident.WF_WASTE_DUMP.outcome.partial: The fire was extinguished after a long damping-down operation, with prolonged disruption for residents downwind.
messages.incident.WF_WASTE_DUMP.outcome.failure: The fire smouldered on for hours, the plume swept over the built-up area and a precautionary order had to be issued.
messages.incident.WF_CAMPSITE_THREAT.title: Fire approaching a campsite
messages.incident.WF_CAMPSITE_THREAT.summary: A fire front closing on a campsite: defending the site and evacuating the guests.
messages.incident.WF_CAMPSITE_THREAT.radio: Control to all units: fire closing on the campsite at {address}, {municipality}. Site defence, evacuation and medical cover requested.
incident.WF_CAMPSITE_THREAT.report.intro: A vegetation fire closing on a campsite is reported at {address}.
The site manager reports flames on the slope above the campsite at {address}, {municipality}.
Urgent assistance requested for a front threatening a camping area at {address}.
Several guests at the campsite report thick smoke and embers arriving at {address}.
The local police in {municipality} confirm the front is closing on the site at {address}.
incident.WF_CAMPSITE_THREAT.report.detai: The front is climbing through scrub and pinewood a few hundred metres from the pitches.
Embers carried on the wind are already falling among the tents and caravans.
Smoke is filling the camping area and making it hard for guests to find their way.
The fire is running along the belt of trees around the perimeter of the site.
incident.WF_CAMPSITE_THREAT.report.condi: There are dozens of guests on the site, among them children and elderly people.
The only access road is narrow and at risk of filling with smoke.
Gas cylinders and motorhome tanks are present on the pitches.
incident.WF_CAMPSITE_THREAT.report.closi: Wildland crews are requested to defend the perimeter, with water drops in support.
Evacuation of the guests to the assembly point and closure of the access road are requested.
An ambulance is requested on standby for guests who have breathed in smoke.
messages.incident.WF_CAMPSITE_THREAT.outcome.succ: The front was stopped short of the pitches; the guests were evacuated safely and were able to return.
messages.incident.WF_CAMPSITE_THREAT.outcome.part: The campsite was saved, but the flames damaged the perimeter and several guests were treated for smoke inhalation.
messages.incident.WF_CAMPSITE_THREAT.outcome.fail: The defence came too late: part of the pitches was lost and the guests had to be taken in elsewhere.
messages.incident.WF_POWERLINE_CORRIDOR.title: Fire under a power line
messages.incident.WF_POWERLINE_CORRIDOR.summary: Vegetation burning in the corridor of a high-voltage transmission line.
messages.incident.WF_POWERLINE_CORRIDOR.radio: Control to all units: fire under a power line at {address}, {municipality}. The line must be isolated before any direct attack.
incident.WF_POWERLINE_CORRIDOR.report.in: A vegetation fire under a power line is reported at {address}.
A network technician reports flames in the line corridor at {address}, {municipality}.
Assistance requested for a fire along the power-line easement at {address}.
Several callers report smoke and arcing under the pylons at {address}.
A patrolling crew in {municipality} reports the front under the line at {address}.
incident.WF_POWERLINE_CORRIDOR.report.de: The flames are licking the foot of a pylon and smoke is rising towards the conductors.
The front is running along the belt of shrubs that follows the line.
Heat and dense smoke can trigger arcing between the conductors.
The fire is widening towards the scrub that surrounds the corridor.
incident.WF_POWERLINE_CORRIDOR.report.co: The line is still live: a direct attack is not possible.
The corridor can only be reached by narrow, broken forest tracks.
Isolating the line would cut power to several outlying hamlets.
incident.WF_POWERLINE_CORRIDOR.report.cl: The network's emergency crew is urgently requested to isolate the line.
Wildland crews with off-road vehicles and a water tender are requested.
A cordon on the access road to the forest tracks is requested.
messages.incident.WF_POWERLINE_CORRIDOR.outcome.s: The line was isolated and the front put out under the pylons, with no damage to the installation.
messages.incident.WF_POWERLINE_CORRIDOR.outcome.p: The fire was put out, but waiting for the line to be isolated let it burn a long stretch of the corridor.
messages.incident.WF_POWERLINE_CORRIDOR.outcome.f: The fire damaged the installation and the hamlets it serves were left without power for a long time.
messages.incident.WF_NIGHT_FRONT.title: Night-time fire front
messages.incident.WF_NIGHT_FRONT.summary: A woodland fire still running at night, with no air support: everything has to be done from the ground.
messages.incident.WF_NIGHT_FRONT.radio: Control to all units: fire front active at {address}, {municipality}. Aircraft unavailable, ground work through the night.
incident.WF_NIGHT_FRONT.report.intros: An active fire front in woodland is reported at {address}.
The incident commander reports the front is still running overnight at {address}, {municipality}.
Reinforcements requested for a woodland fire that will not be stopped at {address}.
Several callers report a glow visible from far away on the slope at {address}.
A wildland crew from {municipality} is asking to be relieved after hours on the front at {address}.
incident.WF_NIGHT_FRONT.report.details: The front is moving along the slope, fed by the night breeze.
With no aircraft, the line has to be held entirely by crews and tenders on the ground.
The darkness makes it hard to read the fire and to move along the tracks.
The fire is climbing the slope in bursts, with sudden flare-ups in the scrub.
incident.WF_NIGHT_FRONT.report.condition: The forest tracks are narrow and the vehicles have to move with extreme care.
The ground crews have been working for many hours and a relief is essential.
Resupplying water means long shuttle runs from the nearest draw point.
incident.WF_NIGHT_FRONT.report.closings: Fresh wildland crews and water tenders are requested for the night's work.
Activation of the command post to coordinate the line is requested.
Logistic support for lighting, fuel and supplies is requested.
messages.incident.WF_NIGHT_FRONT.outcome.success: The line was held all night and the fire was contained before dawn.
messages.incident.WF_NIGHT_FRONT.outcome.partial: The front was slowed but not stopped: a large area of woodland burned before it was contained.
messages.incident.WF_NIGHT_FRONT.outcome.failure: The line gave way during the night and the fire spread beyond the slope, passing to higher-level coordination.
messages.incident.WF_MULTIPLE_IGNITIONS.title: Multiple ignitions
messages.incident.WF_MULTIPLE_IGNITIONS.summary: Several fires started almost simultaneously in the same area: arson is likely.
messages.incident.WF_MULTIPLE_IGNITIONS.radio: Control to all units: multiple ignitions in the area of {address}, {municipality}. Resources to be split across several seats of fire, examination requested.
incident.WF_MULTIPLE_IGNITIONS.report.in: Several separate seats of fire are reported in the same sector at {address}.
The incident commander reports at least three distinct ignitions around {address}, {municipality}.
A reinforced response is requested for simultaneous fires at {address}.
Several callers describe separate columns of smoke along the same road at {address}.
A patrol on duty in {municipality} confirms ignitions lined up along the track at {address}.
incident.WF_MULTIPLE_IGNITIONS.report.de: The seats of fire are lined up along the road, a few hundred metres apart.
Arson is highly likely and the ignition points must be preserved.
The response has to be split: no seat of fire can be left to grow unchecked.
With the wind picking up, the fronts risk joining into a single fire.
incident.WF_MULTIPLE_IGNITIONS.report.co: There are not enough crews available to cover every seat of fire at once.
The service road is unmade and passable only with off-road vehicles.
Isolated houses stand between one seat of fire and the next.
incident.WF_MULTIPLE_IGNITIONS.report.cl: Every available wildland crew and activation of the command post are requested.
Police support is requested to examine the ignition points.
Closure of the service road and air support are requested.
messages.incident.WF_MULTIPLE_IGNITIONS.outcome.s: Every seat of fire was put out before they could join, and the ignition points were preserved for examination.
messages.incident.WF_MULTIPLE_IGNITIONS.outcome.p: The fires were put out, but two fronts had already merged and burned a wide area.
messages.incident.WF_MULTIPLE_IGNITIONS.outcome.f: The response was not enough: the fronts merged into one large fire and coordination passed to a higher level.
messages.incident.WF_REIGNITION.title: Flare-up on a burn scar
messages.incident.WF_REIGNITION.summary: Hot spots alight again on already burnt ground: thorough mop-up before the front restarts.
messages.incident.WF_REIGNITION.radio: Control to all wildfire crews: flare-up on a burn scar at {address}, {municipality}. Crews requested for attack and mop-up.
incident.WF_REIGNITION.report.intros: Flames have flared up again on the burn scar at {address}, {municipality}.
The wildfire lookout reports smoke rising from the burnt area above {address}.
Response requested for hot spots relighting in the fire of the past few days at {address}, {municipality}.
A resident reports flames visible at night on the already burnt slope at {address}.
The patrol crew confirms an active flare-up of the front at {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
incident.WF_REIGNITION.report.details: The wind has relit stumps and roots that were still hot along the edge of the earlier fire.
Several isolated hot spots are burning in the litter, outside the containment line.
The flames have left the burn scar and are attacking vegetation that is still green.
Smoke is rising from the ground in several places: the fire is smouldering deep in the organic layer.
incident.WF_REIGNITION.report.conditions: The ground is covered in ash and loose material, with weakened trees that may come down.
Access is along the tracks opened during the earlier response, now partly broken up.
The wind is stronger than in recent days and shifts direction along the slope.
incident.WF_REIGNITION.report.closings: Wildfire crews are requested for direct attack and a thorough mop-up of the perimeter.
Extreme caution advised: risk of falling trees and of the burnt ground giving way.
Water resupply is requested from the drafting point already in use.
messages.incident.WF_REIGNITION.outcome.success: Hot spots extinguished and the perimeter mopped up in depth; the area has been declared safe.
messages.incident.WF_REIGNITION.outcome.partial: Flare-up contained, but hot spots remain and further checking rounds are needed.
messages.incident.WF_REIGNITION.outcome.failure: The front restarted from the burn scar and took hold in untouched woodland, calling for a new response.
messages.incident.WF_STEEP_SLOPE.title: Fire on a steep slope
messages.incident.WF_STEEP_SLOPE.summary: Forest fire on a steep hillside: ground crews are hampered and air support is decisive.
messages.incident.WF_STEEP_SLOPE.radio: Control to all wildfire crews: forest fire on a steep slope at {address}, {municipality}. Ground access difficult, air support requested.
incident.WF_STEEP_SLOPE.report.intros: Forest fire reported on a steep hillside at {address}, {municipality}.
The wildfire lookout reports a front climbing a steep slope above {address}.
Response requested for a fire in rough country near {address}, {municipality}.
Walkers report flames on the rocky ridge at {address}.
The incident commander on reconnaissance confirms a fire on a steep slope at {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
incident.WF_STEEP_SLOPE.report.details: The front is climbing the slope fast, driven by the gradient and the dry fuel.
The fire has entered a gully that acts as a chimney and accelerates the flames.
Burning material is rolling downhill and starting new spot fires below the front.
The flames have reached a stand of conifers on a sharp incline, with crown fire in places.
incident.WF_STEEP_SLOPE.report.condition: Ground crews can only work along a few lines of attack, with limited escape routes.
The forest track stops well below the front, leaving the last stretch to be covered on foot.
Erratic slope winds, reversing direction in the afternoon.
incident.WF_STEEP_SLOPE.report.closings: Helicopter drops on the head of the fire are requested.
The incident commander is requested on site to coordinate ground crews and aircraft.
Safety comes first: no direct uphill attack below the front.
messages.incident.WF_STEEP_SLOPE.outcome.success: The front was stopped by the drops and by attack from the safe lines; mop-up has begun.
messages.incident.WF_STEEP_SLOPE.outcome.partial: Fire contained, but a wide area of the slope has burned and mop-up will take a long time.
messages.incident.WF_STEEP_SLOPE.outcome.failure: The front crossed the ridge and spread to the far side, escaping the response altogether.
messages.incident.ALP_TWISTED_ANKLE.title: Twisted ankle on the trail
messages.incident.ALP_TWISTED_ANKLE.summary: Walker with a twisted ankle on a low trail, who can be helped down on foot.
messages.incident.ALP_TWISTED_ANKLE.radio: Control to Alpine Rescue: person with a twisted ankle on a trail near {address}, {municipality}. Conscious, light team requested to help them down to the valley.
incident.ALP_TWISTED_ANKLE.report.intros: Person with a twisted ankle reported on a trail near {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
Alpine Rescue requested for a walker limping badly close to {address}.
Call from the low trail above {address}, {municipality}: a hiker cannot put weight on one foot.
Request for assistance received for a person stopped on a switchback of the trail at {address}.
A farm stay owner reports a guest who came back limping from the trail near {address}, {municipality}.
incident.ALP_TWISTED_ANKLE.report.detail: The person caught a foot on a root and reports pain in the ankle.
The casualty can stand with support but cannot walk unaided.
The swelling is obvious and no other injuries are reported.
The fall happened a few hundred metres from the start of the trail.
incident.ALP_TWISTED_ANKLE.report.condit: The trail is wide and gently sloping, and the team can walk in.
The spot is a quarter of an hour on foot from the nearest car park.
The weather is settled and there is no immediate risk to the person.
incident.ALP_TWISTED_ANKLE.report.closin: Light team requested to strap the ankle and help the person down.
The person is advised not to force the joint and to wait where they are.
The caller is waiting at the trailhead to guide the team in.
messages.incident.ALP_TWISTED_ANKLE.outcome.succe: Ankle strapped on the spot and the person walked to the car park without needing a stretcher.
messages.incident.ALP_TWISTED_ANKLE.outcome.parti: Person helped down, but the long wait made the swelling and the pain worse.
messages.incident.ALP_TWISTED_ANKLE.outcome.failu: No team available in time: the person walked down alone and made the injury worse.
messages.incident.ALP_MTB_CRASH.title: Mountain-bike crash
messages.incident.ALP_MTB_CRASH.summary: Rider down on a high trail, injured and with an unrideable bike.
messages.incident.ALP_MTB_CRASH.radio: Control to Alpine Rescue: mountain-bike crash on a trail near {address}, {municipality}. Rider on the ground, team with immobilisation kit requested.
incident.ALP_MTB_CRASH.report.intros: Mountain-bike crash reported on a trail near {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
Alpine Rescue requested for a rider who left the trail close to {address}.
Call from the riding group: crash on a technical section above {address}, {municipality}.
Request for help received for a cyclist who fell over a rock step at {address}.
A hiker reports an abandoned bike and a person on the ground on the trail near {address}, {municipality}.
incident.ALP_MTB_CRASH.report.details: The rider lost the front wheel on loose ground in a bend and ended up in the trees.
The person complains of pain in one shoulder and one knee; the helmet is intact.
The cyclist is conscious but dazed and the group has moved them back onto the trail.
The bike is damaged and cannot be ridden back down.
incident.ALP_MTB_CRASH.report.conditions: The trail is narrow and can only be covered on foot or with light off-road vehicles.
The section is in the shade and the temperature is dropping fast.
Wet ground makes even the team's approach treacherous.
incident.ALP_MTB_CRASH.report.closings: Ground team with immobilisation kit and stretcher requested.
Caller advised not to remove the helmet and not to let the casualty stand up.
The rest of the group is staying put and will mark the position at the trailhead.
messages.incident.ALP_MTB_CRASH.outcome.success: Rider immobilised, carried to the vehicle and handed over to the medical crew in stable condition.
messages.incident.ALP_MTB_CRASH.outcome.partial: Rider recovered, but the carry-out along the trail stretched the response well beyond the usual times.
messages.incident.ALP_MTB_CRASH.outcome.failure: The team arrived late: the injury worsened and the recovery was handed over to other teams.
messages.incident.ALP_LOST_FORAGER.title: Missing mushroom picker
messages.incident.ALP_LOST_FORAGER.summary: Forager overdue from the woods, search in dense forest with a risk of hypothermia.
messages.incident.ALP_LOST_FORAGER.radio: Control to Alpine Rescue: mushroom picker overdue near {address}, {municipality}. Search started in wooded terrain, ground teams requested.
incident.ALP_LOST_FORAGER.report.intros: Mushroom picker reported overdue from the woods near {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
Alpine Rescue requested for a forager expected back hours ago close to {address}.
Call from the family: the car is still at the forest car park above {address}, {municipality}.
Report received of a person not answering the phone after walking into the woods at {address}.
A group of pickers reports a companion lost from sight in the undergrowth near {address}, {municipality}.
incident.ALP_LOST_FORAGER.report.details: The person set out at dawn in light clothing and with no supplies.
The phone has been switched off or out of coverage for several hours.
The missing person is elderly, with conditions known to the family.
The last useful position is the car park at the start of the forest road.
incident.ALP_LOST_FORAGER.report.conditi: The forest is dense and the undergrowth cuts visibility to a few metres.
Night temperatures at this altitude drop below freezing.
Low fog makes orientation difficult even for the rescuers.
incident.ALP_LOST_FORAGER.report.closing: Ground teams and a search-dog unit requested to sweep the wooded sector.
The family is advised to stay at the car park and not to enter the woods.
The caller is giving a description of the clothing and the usual picking spots.
messages.incident.ALP_LOST_FORAGER.outcome.succes: Missing person found inside the search sector, conscious and in good shape, and taken back to the family.
messages.incident.ALP_LOST_FORAGER.outcome.partia: Person found after many hours, chilled and disoriented, and handed to the medical crew for checks.
messages.incident.ALP_LOST_FORAGER.outcome.failur: The search produced nothing in the time available: the sector was handed to other teams with the weather closing in.
messages.incident.ALP_SKI_SLOPE_INJURY.title: Injury on the piste
messages.incident.ALP_SKI_SLOPE_INJURY.summary: Injured skier at the edge of the piste, to be immobilised and taken down by toboggan.
messages.incident.ALP_SKI_SLOPE_INJURY.radio: Control to Alpine Rescue: injured skier at the edge of the piste near {address}, {municipality}. Team with rescue toboggan requested to bring them down.
incident.ALP_SKI_SLOPE_INJURY.report.int: Injured skier reported at the edge of the piste near {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
Alpine Rescue requested for a fall on the piste running down towards {address}.
Call from the piste service: person on the ground after a collision above {address}, {municipality}.
Request for help received for a snowboarder lying motionless at the edge of the run at {address}.
A ski instructor reports a pupil down on an icy section near {address}, {municipality}.
incident.ALP_SKI_SLOPE_INJURY.report.det: The casualty reports severe knee pain after a twisting fall.
The person is conscious, has lost one ski and is sitting in the snow.
The fall happened on an icy stretch at the bottom of a steep pitch.
A second skier involved in the collision is unhurt but shaken.
incident.ALP_SKI_SLOPE_INJURY.report.con: The stretch is icy and other skiers have been diverted around it.
Visibility is cut by falling snow and wind higher up.
The temperature is low and the person has been sitting in the snow for several minutes.
incident.ALP_SKI_SLOPE_INJURY.report.clo: Team with rescue toboggan requested to bring the casualty to the valley station.
Caller advised to keep the casualty covered and to leave the ski boots on.
The piste service has already set out warning netting above the scene.
messages.incident.ALP_SKI_SLOPE_INJURY.outcome.su: Casualty immobilised and taken down by toboggan, handed to the medical crew within minutes.
messages.incident.ALP_SKI_SLOPE_INJURY.outcome.pa: Casualty recovered, but the long wait in the cold made a fuller assessment necessary.
messages.incident.ALP_SKI_SLOPE_INJURY.outcome.fa: No team on scene in time: the casualty's condition worsened and the recovery passed to other teams.
messages.incident.ALP_CANYON_RESCUE.title: Canyoning party trapped
messages.incident.ALP_CANYON_RESCUE.summary: Party trapped in a gorge by a flash flood, recovery on rope and in the water.
messages.incident.ALP_CANYON_RESCUE.radio: Control to Alpine Rescue: canyoning party trapped in a gorge near {address}, {municipality}. Flow rising, canyon teams and water-rescue support requested.
incident.ALP_CANYON_RESCUE.report.intros: Canyoning party reported trapped in a gorge near {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
Alpine Rescue requested for a canyon descent stopped by a flood close to {address}.
Call from a mid-way abseil: the party cannot continue down the gorge above {address}, {municipality}.
Request for help received for several people stuck on a rock ledge at {address}.
A mountain guide reports a party overdue from the gorge near {address}, {municipality}.
incident.ALP_CANYON_RESCUE.report.detail: A thunderstorm upstream has quickly raised the flow of the stream.
The party has taken shelter on a ledge just above the water line.
One person fell on the last abseil and reports pain in an arm.
The ropes are jammed and further progress is impossible.
incident.ALP_CANYON_RESCUE.report.condit: The gorge is narrow and the noise of the water makes communication difficult.
Access means either an abseil from above or working up the stream from the valley floor.
The party is in wetsuits but has been motionless for a long time in cold, damp conditions.
incident.ALP_CANYON_RESCUE.report.closin: Canyon teams with abseil kit and water-rescue support requested.
The party is advised to stay on the ledge and not to attempt any more abseils.
The caller is keeping in touch for as long as the phone battery lasts.
messages.incident.ALP_CANYON_RESCUE.outcome.succe: Party reached and recovered one by one along the gorge, everyone brought clear of the water safely.
messages.incident.ALP_CANYON_RESCUE.outcome.parti: Party recovered, but the long time in cold water meant medical care was needed.
messages.incident.ALP_CANYON_RESCUE.outcome.failu: The flood covered the ledge before an adequate team arrived: the recovery passed to other teams.
messages.incident.ALP_PARAGLIDER.title: Paraglider emergency landing
messages.incident.ALP_PARAGLIDER.summary: Canopy snagged in trees or on a face, pilot left hanging and needing to be lowered.
messages.incident.ALP_PARAGLIDER.radio: Control to Alpine Rescue: paraglider emergency landing near {address}, {municipality}. Pilot hanging in the harness, teams with abseil kit requested.
incident.ALP_PARAGLIDER.report.intros: Paraglider emergency landing reported near {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
Alpine Rescue requested for a canopy snagged in the trees close to {address}.
Call from the take-off: a pilot has not reached the landing field above {address}, {municipality}.
Request for help received for a pilot left hanging on a rock face at {address}.
Witnesses report a canopy going down beyond the ridge near {address}, {municipality}.
incident.ALP_PARAGLIDER.report.details: The pilot is conscious and talking on the phone but is still hanging in the harness.
The canopy is caught in a fir tree about ten metres above the ground.
A sudden gust collapsed the wing on the approach.
The pilot reports back pain and cannot get free unaided.
incident.ALP_PARAGLIDER.report.condition: The wind higher up is still strong and keeps the pilot swinging.
The spot is on steep wooded ground, far from any road.
Flying conditions may rule out the use of the helicopter.
incident.ALP_PARAGLIDER.report.closings: Teams with abseil kit requested to reach the pilot and cut them free.
The pilot is advised not to release the harness and to keep still.
The witnesses are staying at the take-off to give the flight line and the point of impact.
messages.incident.ALP_PARAGLIDER.outcome.success: Pilot reached, cut free of the harness and lowered safely to the ground, canopy recovered.
messages.incident.ALP_PARAGLIDER.outcome.partial: Pilot recovered, but the long suspension caused pain and a drawn-out medical assessment.
messages.incident.ALP_PARAGLIDER.outcome.failure: The pilot hung in the harness far too long: their condition worsened and the job passed to other teams.
messages.incident.ALP_CAVE_RESCUE.title: Caver trapped underground
messages.incident.ALP_CAVE_RESCUE.summary: Casualty beyond the entrance pitches: a very long recovery in an underground system.
messages.incident.ALP_CAVE_RESCUE.radio: Control to Cave and Alpine Rescue: injured caver underground near {address}, {municipality}. Cave rescue teams requested, long-duration operation.
incident.ALP_CAVE_RESCUE.report.intros: Injured caver reported inside a cave system near {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
Cave and Alpine Rescue requested for a team stuck beyond the entrance pitches close to {address}.
Call from a companion back on the surface: a person is injured in the active passage of the cave above {address}, {municipality}.
Request for help received for several people overdue from exploring a cave at {address}.
A caving club reports a team many hours late near {address}, {municipality}.
incident.ALP_CAVE_RESCUE.report.details: The casualty fell while climbing a pitch and cannot move further.
The team is some three hundred metres of passage in from the entrance.
Rain over the last few hours is raising the level of the active passage.
The casualty is conscious and wrapped in a survival blanket by the others.
incident.ALP_CAVE_RESCUE.report.conditio: The route inside runs through tight meanders and pitches that must be rigged for the stretcher.
There is no phone coverage underground and messages travel by runners to the surface.
The steady temperature and high humidity push the casualty towards hypothermia.
incident.ALP_CAVE_RESCUE.report.closings: Cave rescue teams requested, with a command point at the entrance and shifts for a long operation.
The companions are advised to keep the casualty warm and not to move them.
A logistics base with kit and spares is being set up at the entrance.
messages.incident.ALP_CAVE_RESCUE.outcome.success: Casualty packaged in the stretcher and brought to the surface after hours of hauling, stable on exit.
messages.incident.ALP_CAVE_RESCUE.outcome.partial: Recovery completed, but the length of the operation exhausted the teams and deepened the hypothermia.
messages.incident.ALP_CAVE_RESCUE.outcome.failure: The recovery was not completed in time: the active passage rose and the operation passed to other teams.
messages.incident.ALP_CHAIRLIFT_EVACUATION.title: Chairlift evacuation
messages.incident.ALP_CHAIRLIFT_EVACUATION.summar: Lift stopped with dozens of people hanging: rope evacuation along the whole line.
messages.incident.ALP_CHAIRLIFT_EVACUATION.radio: Control to Alpine Rescue: chairlift stopped with people suspended near {address}, {municipality}. Evacuation of the line requested, many people to lower.
incident.ALP_CHAIRLIFT_EVACUATION.report: Chairlift reported stopped with people suspended near {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
Alpine Rescue requested to evacuate a stopped lift close to {address}.
Call from the lift manager: unrecoverable failure on the line climbing from {address}, {municipality}.
Request for support received for dozens of skiers stuck on the chairs at {address}.
Lift staff report that the line cannot be driven in with the back-up motor near {address}, {municipality}.
The lift stopped after a failure in the drive and cannot be restarted.
Several dozen people remain on the line, including some children.
The highest span crosses a gully more than twenty metres above the ground.
Lift staff have already begun evacuating the lowest chairs.
Wind higher up is swinging the chairs and slowing every lowering.
The temperature is below freezing and people have been sitting still for a long time.
The line crosses a wooded stretch that can only be reached with snow groomers.
Teams requested for rope evacuation, with a command point at the valley station.
Passengers are advised to stay seated with the safety bar down.
The operator is setting up a warm point at the station for those brought down.
messages.incident.ALP_CHAIRLIFT_EVACUATION.outcom: Line evacuated chair by chair, everyone lowered and taken into the warm point.
Evacuation completed, but the last people hung for a long time and suffered from the cold.
The evacuation was not completed in time: many people were left on the line and it passed to other teams.
messages.incident.ALP_ICE_CLIMBER.title: Ice climbers on a frozen fall
messages.incident.ALP_ICE_CLIMBER.summary: Fall on an ice route, climber hanging from the belay and hypothermia setting in fast.
messages.incident.ALP_ICE_CLIMBER.radio: Control to Alpine Rescue: climbing party injured on a frozen waterfall near {address}, {municipality}. Technical team requested, high risk of hypothermia.
incident.ALP_ICE_CLIMBER.report.intros: Climbing party reported injured on a frozen waterfall near {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
Alpine Rescue requested for a climber who fell while leading close to {address}.
Call from the second on the rope: a fall on an ice pillar above {address}, {municipality}.
Request for help received for two climbers stuck halfway up a route at {address}.
A nearby party reports a sheet of ice breaking away on the route near {address}, {municipality}.
incident.ALP_ICE_CLIMBER.report.details: The leader fell and is hanging from the belay, conscious.
The fall injured one leg and one ice axe was lost.
The second is unhurt but cannot lower the leader alone.
The pair have been on the route for hours, soaked by dripping water.
incident.ALP_ICE_CLIMBER.report.conditio: The ice is shedding and the risk of falling blocks is high.
The approach takes an hour of climbing on steep snow.
Hard cold and wind cut the safe waiting time very quickly.
incident.ALP_ICE_CLIMBER.report.closings: Technical team with ice kit and stretcher requested for the recovery on the route.
The party is advised to stay tied in and to shelter from the wind.
An approach from above is being considered as faster than the access gully.
messages.incident.ALP_ICE_CLIMBER.outcome.success: Party reached, casualty lowered to the base of the fall and warmed up before transport.
messages.incident.ALP_ICE_CLIMBER.outcome.partial: Recovery successful, but the casualty's advanced hypothermia complicated the treatment on scene.
messages.incident.ALP_ICE_CLIMBER.outcome.failure: The wait on the route was far too long: the party's condition worsened and the recovery passed to other teams.
messages.incident.ALP_SNOW_EMERGENCY.title: Valley snow emergency
messages.incident.ALP_SNOW_EMERGENCY.summary: Days of exceptional snowfall: hamlets cut off, roads closed and people to reach.
messages.incident.ALP_SNOW_EMERGENCY.radio: Control to all teams: snow emergency with cut-off hamlets near {address}, {municipality}. Large-scale response requested, tracked vehicles and coordination with Civil Protection.
incident.ALP_SNOW_EMERGENCY.report.intro: Exceptional snowfall in progress with hamlets cut off near {address}, in the municipality of {municipality}.
Snow emergency response requested for settlements no longer reachable close to {address}.
Call from the mayor: roads closed and homes without power in the hamlets above {address}, {municipality}.
Numerous requests for assistance received from people trapped in their houses at {address}.
Civil Protection reports over a metre and a half of snow on the hamlets of {address}, {municipality}.
incident.ALP_SNOW_EMERGENCY.report.detai: Several hamlets have been cut off for hours and the access roads are impassable.
Some residents need life-saving medication and oxygen.
The weight of the snow has brought down canopies and cut the power lines.
Groups of drivers are stranded on the valley-floor road.
incident.ALP_SNOW_EMERGENCY.report.condi: The snowfall continues and cuts visibility to a few metres.
The avalanche risk on the access roads to the hamlets is high.
Communications are intermittent because of the damage to the power network.
incident.ALP_SNOW_EMERGENCY.report.closi: Large-scale response requested with tracked vehicles, coordination and a command point in the valley.
The public is advised to stay indoors and not to travel.
Coordination with the municipalities is setting the order in which the hamlets are reached.
messages.incident.ALP_SNOW_EMERGENCY.outcome.succ: Hamlets reached, vulnerable residents looked after and emergency access restored to every settlement.
messages.incident.ALP_SNOW_EMERGENCY.outcome.part: Most of the hamlets were reached, but some families spent another night cut off.
messages.incident.ALP_SNOW_EMERGENCY.outcome.fail: The response could not hold the emergency: the settlements stayed cut off and the operation passed to the regional mobile column.
messages.incident.MULTI_POWER_BLACKOUT.title: Widespread power cut
messages.incident.MULTI_POWER_BLACKOUT.summary: Power failure across a whole neighbourhood: people trapped in lifts, vulnerable patients without their equipment and traffic lights out.
messages.incident.MULTI_POWER_BLACKOUT.radio: Control to all units: widespread power cut in the area of {address}, {municipality}. People trapped in lifts and junctions without traffic lights; technical crews, medics and traffic control required.
incident.MULTI_POWER_BLACKOUT.report.int: Numerous callers report the whole block without electricity at {address}.
Response requested for a power cut with people trapped in lifts at {address}, {municipality}.
A resident reports being shut in a lift in the dark at {address}.
A patrol confirms traffic lights out and gridlocked traffic at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_POWER_BLACKOUT.report.det: Several lifts have stopped between floors with people inside.
Some people at home depend on electrical medical equipment that now has no power.
The main junctions are without traffic lights and traffic is at a standstill.
Emergency lighting in several public buildings is starting to run out.
incident.MULTI_POWER_BLACKOUT.report.con: The electricity company cannot give a firm time for power to be restored.
Falls and minor injuries among elderly residents are being reported in the dark.
