Improvised generators are running in enclosed spaces, with a risk of poisoning.
incident.MULTI_POWER_BLACKOUT.report.clo: Fire Brigade technical crews requested, ambulance crews for vulnerable patients and Police for traffic control.
The caller has been advised to stay still and not to force the lift doors.
Coordination with the network operator, release of the people stuck in lifts and cover at the junctions are required.
messages.incident.MULTI_POWER_BLACKOUT.outcome.su: Everyone released, vulnerable patients cared for and traffic kept moving until the network was restored.
messages.incident.MULTI_POWER_BLACKOUT.outcome.pa: Releases and assistance completed, but with long waits at some points in the area.
messages.incident.MULTI_POWER_BLACKOUT.outcome.fa: Too few resources: people were left trapped for a long time and the incident was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_SCHOOL_EVACUATION.title: School evacuation
messages.incident.MULTI_SCHOOL_EVACUATION.summary: Fire starting in a school: hundreds of pupils evacuated, triage and making the area safe.
messages.incident.MULTI_SCHOOL_EVACUATION.radio: Control to all units: fire with evacuation at a school at {address}, {municipality}. Large numbers of pupils outside; firefighting crews, medics and Police required.
Fire with an evacuation under way reported at a school at {address}, {municipality}.
The head teacher reports the building being evacuated because of smoke in the corridors at {address}.
Urgent response requested for a fire starting at a school at {address}, {municipality}.
A teacher reports thick smoke coming from the school basement at {address}.
A patrol confirms hundreds of pupils gathered in the playground at {address}, {municipality}.
The evacuation is under way, but some classes have not yet reached the assembly point.
Smoke is spreading through the stairwells and making it hard to get out from the top floors.
Several pupils are coughing and short of breath after breathing in smoke.
There are pupils with mobility impairments in the school who need help to get out.
The playground is crowded and parents are arriving in numbers at the gates.
The streets around the school are narrow and already congested with traffic.
School staff are still taking the roll call and the figures change from minute to minute.
Fire Brigade crews requested, ambulance crews for triage and Police for access and crowd control.
The caller has been advised to finish the roll call and keep the pupils at the assembly point.
A check of the premises, medical care for the pupils and control of access are required.
messages.incident.MULTI_SCHOOL_EVACUATION.outcome: School evacuated and checked, pupils cared for and returned to their families without harm.
The evacuation was completed, but checking the premises and caring for the pupils took a long time.
A late, under-resourced response: the evacuation was disorganised and the operation was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_HEATWAVE_SURGE.title: Heatwave surge
messages.incident.MULTI_HEATWAVE_SURGE.summary: Surge of heat-related collapses: several patients within a few streets, ambulance transports and a casualty care point.
messages.incident.MULTI_HEATWAVE_SURGE.radio: Control to all units: heat emergency with several people taken ill at {address}, {municipality}. Ambulance crews, logistic support and a casualty care point required.
incident.MULTI_HEATWAVE_SURGE.report.int: Several people taken ill by the heat in the same area reported at {address}, {municipality}.
Numerous callers report people feeling unwell in the street at {address}.
Multiple ambulance response requested for heatstroke cases at {address}, {municipality}.
A passer-by reports an elderly person collapsed on the pavement at {address}.
A patrol confirms several people being helped by passers-by at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_HEATWAVE_SURGE.report.det: Temperatures are above forty degrees and have not dropped for several days.
Several of the patients are elderly people living alone, dehydrated and on long-term medication.
Some people have lost consciousness and need to be assessed immediately.
Calls keep coming in from the same area with much the same symptoms.
incident.MULTI_HEATWAVE_SURGE.report.con: Emergency departments in the area report very long waits for admission.
There is no shaded, air-conditioned space where the patients can be gathered.
The ambulance crews are working in full sun and have to be rotated often.
incident.MULTI_HEATWAVE_SURGE.report.clo: More ambulance crews requested, along with a casualty care point and logistic support from the Fire Brigade.
The caller has been advised to move the person into the shade and give them water if conscious.
Triage on scene, a search for hospital beds and coordination of the ambulance transports are required.
messages.incident.MULTI_HEATWAVE_SURGE.outcome.su: All patients assessed, stabilised and transported; the surge in calls was absorbed without problems.
messages.incident.MULTI_HEATWAVE_SURGE.outcome.pa: The patients were treated, but some transports set off with a considerable delay.
messages.incident.MULTI_HEATWAVE_SURGE.outcome.fa: Too few vehicles: patients were left without care for a long time and the incident was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_BOAT_INCIDENT.title: Boat accident
messages.incident.MULTI_BOAT_INCIDENT.summary: Boat disabled or in collision with people in the water: water rescue, recovery and medical care ashore.
messages.incident.MULTI_BOAT_INCIDENT.radio: Control to all units: boat accident with people in the water at {address}, {municipality}. Boat crews, divers and medics ashore required.
incident.MULTI_BOAT_INCIDENT.report.intr: Boat accident with people in the water reported at {address}, {municipality}.
Several witnesses report a boat taking on water fast at {address}.
Water rescue requested for a collision between two vessels at {address}, {municipality}.
A boat owner reports seeing people clinging to a hull at {address}.
A patrol confirms the boat half sunk a short way from the shore at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_BOAT_INCIDENT.report.deta: There were several people on board and the exact number is not yet clear.
Some of those in the water have no life jacket.
The boat is going down and may drag those still on board under with it.
There are children on board and people who cannot swim.
incident.MULTI_BOAT_INCIDENT.report.cond: The swell and the current are carrying those in the water away from the scene.
Visibility over the water is poor and makes the search for missing people harder.
The nearest shore is difficult to reach with road vehicles.
incident.MULTI_BOAT_INCIDENT.report.clos: Fire Brigade boat crews and divers requested, ambulance crews ashore and Police to manage the area.
The caller has been advised not to dive in and to point out where the people in the water are.
A search on the water, recovery of those in the water and triage at the landing point are required.
messages.incident.MULTI_BOAT_INCIDENT.outcome.suc: Everyone recovered from the water and cared for, the boat made safe and the search closed.
messages.incident.MULTI_BOAT_INCIDENT.outcome.par: Those in the water were recovered, but for some of them the search ran well beyond the time that counts.
messages.incident.MULTI_BOAT_INCIDENT.outcome.fai: A late, under-resourced rescue: the search produced no result and the operation was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_FLOOD_EMERGENCY.title: Flood
messages.incident.MULTI_FLOOD_EMERGENCY.summary: River burst its banks with streets under water: evacuations, rescues from cars and ground floors, roads cut off.
messages.incident.MULTI_FLOOD_EMERGENCY.radio: Control to all units: flooding under way at {address}, {municipality}. People cut off on ground floors; water rescue, technical crews and traffic control required.
incident.MULTI_FLOOD_EMERGENCY.report.in: River burst its banks with widespread flooding reported at {address}, {municipality}.
Numerous callers report water more than a metre deep in the streets of {address}.
Urgent response requested for people cut off by the water at {address}, {municipality}.
A resident reports being trapped on the ground floor with the water rising at {address}.
A patrol confirms the road completely submerged and impassable at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_FLOOD_EMERGENCY.report.de: Several people are trapped in their cars in flooded underpasses.
There are elderly residents on ground floors who cannot get up to the storeys above.
The current is carrying debris and makes wading across dangerous.
Water has flooded some shops with people still inside.
incident.MULTI_FLOOD_EMERGENCY.report.co: The water level is still rising and more rain is forecast.
The approach roads to the area are cut and crews face very long detours.
Flooded electrical installations make entering the buildings risky.
incident.MULTI_FLOOD_EMERGENCY.report.cl: Fire Brigade water rescue and technical crews requested, ambulance crews and Police for the road closures.
The caller has been advised to move to an upper floor and not to try wading across.
Evacuation of the ground floors, rescues from the water and closure of the flooded streets are required.
messages.incident.MULTI_FLOOD_EMERGENCY.outcome.s: Everyone evacuated and cared for, the area held and the roads made safe.
messages.incident.MULTI_FLOOD_EMERGENCY.outcome.p: The evacuations were completed, but some rescues came very late.
messages.incident.MULTI_FLOOD_EMERGENCY.outcome.f: Too few crews: people were left cut off for a long time and coordination was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_WINTER_STORM.title: Snowstorm
messages.incident.MULTI_WINTER_STORM.summary: Exceptional snowfall with roads blocked: motorists stranded, hamlets cut off and utilities down.
messages.incident.MULTI_WINTER_STORM.radio: Control to all units: snowstorm with motorists stranded at {address}, {municipality}. Off-road vehicles, technical crews, medics and traffic control required.
incident.MULTI_WINTER_STORM.report.intro: Exceptional snowfall with roads blocked reported at {address}, {municipality}.
Numerous callers report motorists stuck in the snow for hours at {address}.
Response requested for people cut off by the storm at {address}, {municipality}.
A driver reports being stuck in the queue with no fuel left at {address}.
A patrol confirms the road impassable and heavy goods vehicles jackknifed at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_WINTER_STORM.report.detai: Dozens of vehicles are stuck in the queue and some of the occupants are elderly people or children.
Several hamlets are cut off and have been without electricity for hours.
Some people have left their cars and set off on foot through the snow, and can no longer be reached.
Roofs and canopies weighed down by snow are reported at risk of giving way.
incident.MULTI_WINTER_STORM.report.condi: The snow is still falling and the wind has cut visibility to a few metres.
Temperatures are well below freezing and the risk of hypothermia is real.
Vehicles without chains cannot reach the area and snow ploughs are needed at the head of the queues.
incident.MULTI_WINTER_STORM.report.closi: Fire Brigade off-road vehicles and crews requested, ambulance crews and Police for traffic control.
The caller has been advised to stay in the car, keep warm and run the engine only now and then.
Clearing the routes, caring for the stranded motorists and checking the cut-off hamlets are required.
messages.incident.MULTI_WINTER_STORM.outcome.succ: Roads reopened, motorists cared for and the cut-off hamlets reached without harm.
messages.incident.MULTI_WINTER_STORM.outcome.part: The assistance was completed, but some people were left in the cold for many hours.
messages.incident.MULTI_WINTER_STORM.outcome.fail: Too few resources: the queues stayed blocked for a long time and the incident was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_LANDSLIDE.title: Landslide
messages.incident.MULTI_LANDSLIDE.summary: Landslide over houses and a road: search for missing people, evacuations and checks on the stability of the slope.
messages.incident.MULTI_LANDSLIDE.radio: Control to all units: landslide with people possibly buried at {address}, {municipality}. USAR teams, dog units, medics and a cordon required.
incident.MULTI_LANDSLIDE.report.intros: Landslide over houses and a road reported at {address}, {municipality}.
Several residents report a loud roar followed by the hillside sliding away at {address}.
Urgent response requested for a landslide with people possibly missing at {address}, {municipality}.
A resident reports that the mud has reached the ground floor of their house at {address}.
A patrol confirms the carriageway covered with earth and trees at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_LANDSLIDE.report.details: The landslide has hit at least one house and some vehicles that were passing.
Some of the residents of the houses hit are not answering their phones.
The access road to the hamlet is cut and several families are isolated.
There are people with minor injuries who got out of the houses on their own.
incident.MULTI_LANDSLIDE.report.conditio: The slope is still moving and further slides are possible.
The rain has not stopped and is soaking the ground even further.
The area can only be reached with off-road vehicles and difficult manoeuvring.
incident.MULTI_LANDSLIDE.report.closings: USAR teams and dog units requested, ambulance crews and Police for the evacuation and the cordon.
The caller has been advised to move away from the landslide front and get to a safe place.
A headcount, a search for the missing and monitoring of the slope are required.
messages.incident.MULTI_LANDSLIDE.outcome.success: Missing people located, houses evacuated and the area monitored without further consequences.
messages.incident.MULTI_LANDSLIDE.outcome.partial: The search was concluded and people rescued, but it took a very long time and cover was incomplete.
messages.incident.MULTI_LANDSLIDE.outcome.failure: Too few crews arriving too late: the search was broken off and the operation was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_TRAIN_DERAILMENT.title: Train derailment
messages.incident.MULTI_TRAIN_DERAILMENT.summary: Derailed train with many injured: extrication from the carriages, field triage and making the line safe.
messages.incident.MULTI_TRAIN_DERAILMENT.radio: Control to all units: train derailment with many injured at {address}, {municipality}. Extrication crews, an advanced medical post and Police required.
incident.MULTI_TRAIN_DERAILMENT.report.i: Train derailment with injured people reported at {address}, {municipality}.
Several passengers are calling in to report carriages on their side along the line at {address}.
Urgent response requested for a rail accident with many people involved at {address}, {municipality}.
A passenger reports being trapped inside a carriage at {address}.
A patrol confirms the train off the rails and passengers walking along the trackbed at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_TRAIN_DERAILMENT.report.d: Some carriages have overturned and passengers are trapped inside.
Dozens of people got out on their own and are walking along the track.
The number of passengers on board has not yet been confirmed by the rail operator.
There are seriously injured people who need extrication and immediate stabilisation.
incident.MULTI_TRAIN_DERAILMENT.report.c: The overhead line may still be live and has to be isolated.
The scene is far from any road and getting close to it is difficult.
All other trains on the same stretch must be stopped at once.
Fire Brigade extrication crews requested, an advanced medical post and Police to manage the area.
The caller has been advised not to step down onto the track and to wait for the crews.
Isolation of the overhead line, triage of the passengers and a clear route for the ambulances are required.
Passengers extricated and cared for, the line isolated and the site handed over safely.
The injured were treated, but the extrications and transports took far too long.
An inadequate response: the injured were left in the carriages for a long time and command was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_TUNNEL_FIRE.title: Tunnel fire
messages.incident.MULTI_TUNNEL_FIRE.summary: Vehicle on fire in a tunnel with smoke and people trapped: firefighting, evacuation and closure of the route.
messages.incident.MULTI_TUNNEL_FIRE.radio: Control to all units: tunnel fire with people trapped at {address}, {municipality}. Firefighting crews, water tenders, medics and closure of the route required.
incident.MULTI_TUNNEL_FIRE.report.intros: Vehicle fire inside a tunnel reported at {address}, {municipality}.
Several drivers report thick smoke filling the bore at {address}.
Urgent response requested for a tunnel fire with people trapped at {address}, {municipality}.
A driver reports having left his car and being on foot looking for the exit at {address}.
A patrol confirms smoke pouring from the tunnel portal at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_TUNNEL_FIRE.report.detail: Smoke has filled the tunnel and visibility is down to nothing.
Large numbers of people have left their vehicles and are moving on foot inside the bore.
Some drivers are trapped beyond the seat of the fire.
Patients with smoke inhalation have already been reached by crews on scene.
incident.MULTI_TUNNEL_FIRE.report.condit: The tunnel ventilation has to be managed so the smoke is not pushed towards the people getting out.
The heat inside is very high and limits how long the crews can stay in.
Queues at the portals are getting in the way of the emergency vehicles.
incident.MULTI_TUNNEL_FIRE.report.closin: Fire Brigade crews and water tenders requested, ambulance crews at the portals and Police for the closure.
The caller has been advised to keep low and make for the nearest emergency exit.
Firefighting, evacuation of the bore and immediate closure of the route are required.
messages.incident.MULTI_TUNNEL_FIRE.outcome.succe: Fire extinguished, tunnel evacuated and everyone cared for without serious harm.
messages.incident.MULTI_TUNNEL_FIRE.outcome.parti: The fire was brought under control and the evacuation worked, but it took a long time and many suffered smoke inhalation.
messages.incident.MULTI_TUNNEL_FIRE.outcome.failu: An inadequate response: the smoke was never controlled, the evacuation was incomplete and the operation was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_STADIUM_CRUSH.title: Crowd crush at a sports ground
messages.incident.MULTI_STADIUM_CRUSH.summary: Crowd crush at an event: many crush injuries, public order and mass triage.
messages.incident.MULTI_STADIUM_CRUSH.radio: Control to all units: crowd crush with injuries at a sports ground at {address}, {municipality}. Public order reinforcements, an advanced medical post and ambulance transports required.
incident.MULTI_STADIUM_CRUSH.report.intr: Crowd crush with many injured reported at a sports ground at {address}, {municipality}.
Several spectators report people being crushed against the barriers at {address}.
Urgent response requested for a crowd crush at {address}, {municipality}.
A spectator reports people on the ground being trampled by the crowd at {address}.
A patrol confirms a critical situation at the entrance gates at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_STADIUM_CRUSH.report.deta: Large numbers of people have crush injuries and are struggling to breathe.
The crowd is still pushing towards the gates and blocking the flow out.
Some of the injured are on the ground and cannot get up on their own.
The crowd's agitation makes it hard to pick out the most serious cases.
incident.MULTI_STADIUM_CRUSH.report.cond: The ground is full and an orderly exit needs every gate to be staffed.
The approach roads for the emergency vehicles are blocked by spectators and cars.
The only way to speak to the crowd is through the organisers' public address system.
incident.MULTI_STADIUM_CRUSH.report.clos: Police reinforcements requested, an advanced medical post and more ambulance crews for the transports.
The caller has been advised not to push and to let the rescuers through.
A controlled exit, mass triage and a lane reserved for the ambulances are required.
messages.incident.MULTI_STADIUM_CRUSH.outcome.suc: The crowd got out safely, the injured were treated and transported and public order was restored.
messages.incident.MULTI_STADIUM_CRUSH.outcome.par: The injured were treated, but the exit and the transports took a very long time.
messages.incident.MULTI_STADIUM_CRUSH.outcome.fai: An inadequate response: the crush was not contained, rescue was slowed and the incident was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_INDUSTRIAL_EXPLOSION.summ: Explosion at an industrial plant: fire, hazardous substances, serious injuries and a risk of the sheds collapsing.
messages.incident.MULTI_INDUSTRIAL_EXPLOSION.radi: Control to all units: explosion at an industrial plant at {address}, {municipality}. CBRN team, firefighting crews, an advanced medical post and a cordon required.
incident.MULTI_INDUSTRIAL_EXPLOSION.repo: Explosion at an industrial plant reported at {address}, {municipality}.
Numerous callers report a heavy blast felt kilometres away from {address}.
Urgent response requested for an explosion with injuries at a works at {address}, {municipality}.
An employee reports colleagues injured and unaccounted for inside the shed at {address}.
A patrol confirms a column of black smoke above the plant at {address}, {municipality}.
Part of the shed has collapsed and there may be workers inside.
The fire involves tanks and stores of flammable substances.
Several of the injured have extensive burns and blast injuries.
The plant manager still cannot provide a list of who was on site.
The smoke plume is drifting towards nearby homes and an evacuation has to be considered.
Pressurised tanks are still exposed to the flames, with a risk of further explosions.
Access to the yards is blocked by rubble and company vehicles.
Fire Brigade CBRN team and crews requested, an advanced medical post and Police for the cordon.
The caller has been advised to move everyone on site to the upwind assembly point.
Cooling the tanks, searching for the workers and tracking the plume are required.
messages.incident.MULTI_INDUSTRIAL_EXPLOSION.outc: Fire contained, workers located and cared for, plant made safe.
The injured were treated and the fire brought under control, but it took a long time and the fire spread in places.
Too few resources: the fire spread, the missing workers were not found and the operation was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_HOSPITAL_EVACUATION.title: Hospital evacuation
messages.incident.MULTI_HOSPITAL_EVACUATION.summa: Fire in a hospital with wards evacuated: bedbound patients, continuity of care and medical transfers.
messages.incident.MULTI_HOSPITAL_EVACUATION.radio: Control to all units: fire with a hospital ward being evacuated at {address}, {municipality}. Firefighting crews, ambulances for the transfers and Police required.
incident.MULTI_HOSPITAL_EVACUATION.repor: Fire with a ward being evacuated at a hospital reported at {address}, {municipality}.
The hospital's medical director reports smoke in an inpatient ward at {address}.
Urgent response requested for a fire at a hospital at {address}, {municipality}.
A nurse reports thick smoke in the ward corridor at {address}.
A patrol confirms patients being moved outside on trolleys at {address}, {municipality}.
Many of the patients are bedbound and cannot be moved on their own.
Some patients are connected to equipment that needs an uninterrupted power supply.
Smoke is spreading along the corridors and threatening the adjoining wards.
Horizontal evacuation into the neighbouring fire compartments has already begun.
Treatment cannot be interrupted while the patients are being moved.
Beds available at nearby hospitals are limited and have to be negotiated.
The forecourt in front of the emergency department is congested with ambulances and relatives.
Fire Brigade crews requested, ambulances for the transfers and Police to control access.
The caller has been advised to close the fire doors and carry on with the horizontal evacuation.
Putting out the fire, transferring the patients and rehousing them in nearby hospitals are required.
messages.incident.MULTI_HOSPITAL_EVACUATION.outco: Ward evacuated and fire extinguished, patients transferred safely with no break in their care.
The evacuation worked, but some transfers went ahead with a serious delay.
Too few vehicles: the evacuation was incomplete, treatment was interrupted and the incident was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_AIRCRAFT_ACCIDENT.title: Aircraft crash
messages.incident.MULTI_AIRCRAFT_ACCIDENT.summary: Aircraft down with fire and spilt fuel: search for the passengers, mass triage and clearing the site.
messages.incident.MULTI_AIRCRAFT_ACCIDENT.radio: Control to all units: aircraft crash with fire at {address}, {municipality}. Firefighting crews, CBRN team, an advanced medical post and a wide cordon required.
Aircraft down with fire reported at {address}, {municipality}.
Numerous witnesses report an aircraft in trouble and a heavy bang near {address}.
Urgent response requested for an aircraft crash with many people involved at {address}, {municipality}.
A resident reports burning wreckage in the fields beside their house at {address}.
A patrol confirms the wreck and debris scattered over a wide area at {address}, {municipality}.
The wreckage is spread over hundreds of metres and some fires are still burning.
The number of passengers on board has not yet been confirmed by the airport authorities.
Spilt fuel has soaked into the ground and is feeding the fire.
Some survivors have been found some distance from the point of impact.
The area is large and has no roads; vehicles are slow to get close.
Onlookers are making their way to the crash site and have to be kept back.
The scene is subject to investigation and nothing is to be moved except for the rescue.
Fire Brigade crews and CBRN team requested, an advanced medical post and Police for the cordon.
The caller has been advised not to approach the wreckage and to point out any survivors.
Putting out the fires, searching for the passengers and triage at the assembly point are required.
messages.incident.MULTI_AIRCRAFT_ACCIDENT.outcome: Fires put out, survivors found and cared for, the site cleared and handed to the investigators.
The search and rescue were completed, but they took a long time and part of the area was never covered.
An inadequate response: the fire spread, the search was left unfinished and the operation was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_BRIDGE_COLLAPSE.title: Viaduct collapse
messages.incident.MULTI_BRIDGE_COLLAPSE.summary: A viaduct gives way with vehicles falling: search through the rubble, water rescue and closure of the route.
messages.incident.MULTI_BRIDGE_COLLAPSE.radio: Control to all units: viaduct collapse with vehicles involved at {address}, {municipality}. USAR teams, extrication, an advanced medical post and a full closure required.
incident.MULTI_BRIDGE_COLLAPSE.report.in: Collapse of a viaduct span reported at {address}, {municipality}.
Numerous callers report the deck giving way without warning at {address}.
Urgent response requested for a viaduct collapse with vehicles falling at {address}, {municipality}.
A driver reports stopping a few metres short of the drop at {address}.
A patrol confirms the span down and vehicles under the rubble at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_BRIDGE_COLLAPSE.report.de: Several vehicles have fallen and are buried under the debris of the deck.
Some people are trapped in vehicles left standing on the stumps of the viaduct.
There are homes and businesses under the viaduct that were hit by the collapse.
Some of the debris has ended up in the watercourse below, along with a number of vehicles.
incident.MULTI_BRIDGE_COLLAPSE.report.co: The spans still standing are unstable and safety distances have to be kept.
The route carries heavy traffic and must be closed in both directions well back from the scene.
Dust and shifting debris make it hard to listen out during the search.
incident.MULTI_BRIDGE_COLLAPSE.report.cl: USAR and extrication crews requested, an advanced medical post and Police to close the route.
The caller has been advised to move away from the structure and not to climb over the rubble.
A search through the debris, a check of the watercourse and a complete closure of the area are required.
messages.incident.MULTI_BRIDGE_COLLAPSE.outcome.s: People extricated and cared for, the area closed off and the search concluded successfully.
messages.incident.MULTI_BRIDGE_COLLAPSE.outcome.p: The extrications were completed, but the search through the debris took far too long.
messages.incident.MULTI_BRIDGE_COLLAPSE.outcome.f: Too few resources: people were left under the rubble for a long time and the operation was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MULTI_EARTHQUAKE.title: Earthquake
messages.incident.MULTI_EARTHQUAKE.summary: Earthquake across a whole area: widespread collapses, people missing under the rubble, utilities down and every service mobilised.
messages.incident.MULTI_EARTHQUAKE.radio: Control to all units: earthquake with widespread collapses at {address}, {municipality}. General mobilisation: USAR, dog units, advanced medical post, public order and the mobile response column.
incident.MULTI_EARTHQUAKE.report.intros: Strong earthquake with collapses reported at {address}, {municipality}.
Calls are coming in on top of each other: damaged buildings and people out in the street at {address}.
General mobilisation requested for an earthquake with casualties and people missing at {address}, {municipality}.
A resident reports that the block next to theirs has collapsed at {address}.
A patrol confirms multiple collapses and people gathered in the open at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_EARTHQUAKE.report.details: Several buildings have collapsed or are badly damaged and many people are unaccounted for.
The gas, water and electricity networks are down across the whole area.
Numerous injured people have already been carried into the street by improvised rescuers.
Several roads are blocked by rubble and cut off access to the districts that were hit.
incident.MULTI_EARTHQUAKE.report.conditi: Aftershocks are continuing and put both the rescuers and the unsafe buildings at risk.
The population is out in the open and needs reception and welfare areas.
Coordination calls for a single chain of command over every crew arriving.
incident.MULTI_EARTHQUAKE.report.closing: USAR teams and dog units requested, an advanced medical post, Police and the mobile response column.
The caller has been advised to stay in the open, away from buildings and power lines.
Searching the collapses, isolating the utilities and setting up the reception areas are required.
messages.incident.MULTI_EARTHQUAKE.outcome.succes: The search was concluded, the missing were located and the population cared for: the area was stabilised and handed over to the rebuilding phase.
messages.incident.MULTI_EARTHQUAKE.outcome.partia: The rescue work was seen through, but cover was incomplete and the search went on for days.
messages.incident.MULTI_EARTHQUAKE.outcome.failur: A wholly inadequate response: districts were unreachable, the missing were never found and command was handed to other units.
messages.incident.TECH_VESSEL_ADRIFT.title: Boat adrift
messages.incident.TECH_VESSEL_ADRIFT.summary: Boat broken down, adrift or aground with people on board: water rescue and a tow required.
messages.incident.TECH_VESSEL_ADRIFT.radio: Control to all units: boat broken down off {address}, {municipality}. Fire Brigade boat crew required, consider medical support.
incident.TECH_VESSEL_ADRIFT.report.intro: Boat broken down and adrift reported off {address}, {municipality}.
The helmsman of a small boat is asking for help with engine failure near {address}.
Response requested for a boat aground in shallow water off {address}, {municipality}.
Multiple callers report a boat stopped and signalling for help in the area of {address}.
A leisure boater reports being unable to make harbour and drifting off {address}, {municipality}.
incident.TECH_VESSEL_ADRIFT.report.detai: There are several people on board, all of them wearing life jackets.
The engine will not restart and the anchor is not holding on the bottom.
The wind is slowly pushing the boat further away from the coast.
The hull has touched the bottom and is taking on a small amount of water.
incident.TECH_VESSEL_ADRIFT.report.condi: There is a swell running and the gusts make coming alongside difficult.
The area is hard to reach from land and has to be approached from the water.
The light is going and visibility over the water is dropping fast.
incident.TECH_VESSEL_ADRIFT.report.closi: Fire Brigade boat crew requested to come alongside and take the boat under tow.
The helmsman has been advised to stay on board and not to try to swim ashore.
Consider sending an ambulance crew to the landing point to check over those brought in.
messages.incident.TECH_VESSEL_ADRIFT.outcome.succ: The boat was reached and towed in safely, with everyone on board landed in good condition.
messages.incident.TECH_VESSEL_ADRIFT.outcome.part: The boat was recovered, but the long wait left those on board exposed to the cold and the swell.
messages.incident.TECH_VESSEL_ADRIFT.outcome.fail: The job was never finished: the boat was assisted by other rescuers and the incident was handed to other units.
messages.incident.FIRE_VESSEL_BLAZE.title: Boat fire
messages.incident.FIRE_VESSEL_BLAZE.summary: Boat alight at its moorings or at anchor: attack from the water, protecting the neighbouring hulls and rescuing those on board.
messages.incident.FIRE_VESSEL_BLAZE.radio: Control to all units: boat fire at {address}, {municipality}. Boat crew, an engine on the quayside and Police for the area required.
incident.FIRE_VESSEL_BLAZE.report.intros: Fire on board a moored boat reported at {address}, {municipality}.
Staff at a berth report flames and thick smoke from a hull at {address}.
Urgent response requested for a boat alight off {address}, {municipality}.
Multiple callers report a column of black smoke rising from the moorings at {address}.
A patrol confirms a fire on board a boat at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.FIRE_VESSEL_BLAZE.report.detail: The fire is in the engine compartment and is spreading up towards the deck.
Thick smoke makes it impossible to check whether anyone is still on board.
The hulls moored alongside are exposed to the heat and need protecting.
There is fuel in the tanks on board and gas cylinders for the galley.
incident.FIRE_VESSEL_BLAZE.report.condit: The wind is pushing the flames towards the neighbouring moorings.
The quay is narrow and heavy appliances struggle to get in.
A crowd of onlookers has gathered in the area and has to be moved back.
incident.FIRE_VESSEL_BLAZE.report.closin: Fire Brigade boat crew requested to attack from the water, with an engine on the quayside.
Police are needed to move bystanders back and control access.
Consider making the fuel tanks safe and containing any product on the water.
messages.incident.FIRE_VESSEL_BLAZE.outcome.succe: The fire was put out, the hull made safe and the neighbouring moorings protected with no further damage.
messages.incident.FIRE_VESSEL_BLAZE.outcome.parti: The fire was brought under control, but the delay let the heat damage the boats alongside.
messages.incident.FIRE_VESSEL_BLAZE.outcome.failu: The flames got away: the hull was lost and the incident was handed to other units.
messages.incident.MED_SWIMMER_DISTRESS.title: Swimmer in difficulty
messages.incident.MED_SWIMMER_DISTRESS.summary: Swimmer in difficulty out from the shore: a fast recovery from the water and immediate medical care on the beach.
messages.incident.MED_SWIMMER_DISTRESS.radio: Control to all units: swimmer in difficulty off {address}, {municipality}. Water rescue and an ambulance crew required at the landing point.
incident.MED_SWIMMER_DISTRESS.report.int: Bystanders report a person unable to get back to shore off {address}.
Urgent response requested for a swimmer carried out by the current near {address}, {municipality}.
Multiple callers report a person waving their arms in the water off {address}.
A relative reports that a swimmer went out from the beach and has not come back, at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MED_SWIMMER_DISTRESS.report.det: The person is only just staying afloat and looks badly tired.
The current is steadily carrying them further from the water's edge.
Those who were in the water with them are back ashore and are pointing out the position.
The person can only be seen now and then between the waves.
incident.MED_SWIMMER_DISTRESS.report.con: The sea is rough and the current further out is strong.
Some bystanders want to go into the water to help and must be held back.
The water is cold and a long spell in it makes the person's condition worse quickly.
incident.MED_SWIMMER_DISTRESS.report.clo: Water rescue swimmers requested for the recovery, with an ambulance crew standing by at the landing point.
The caller has been advised not to enter the water and not to lose sight of the person.
Have oxygen and warming blankets ready for the moment of recovery.
messages.incident.MED_SWIMMER_DISTRESS.outcome.su: The swimmer was recovered quickly and handed to the medics in good general condition.
messages.incident.MED_SWIMMER_DISTRESS.outcome.pa: The swimmer was recovered, but the long spell in the water called for a longer stretch of medical care.
messages.incident.MED_SWIMMER_DISTRESS.outcome.fa: Help reached the spot far too late: the recovery was completed by other units.
messages.incident.MED_LAKE_RESCUE.title: Lake rescue
messages.incident.MED_LAKE_RESCUE.summary: Person in difficulty on a lake or on inland water: recovery by boat crew and medical care on the bank.
messages.incident.MED_LAKE_RESCUE.radio: Control to all units: person in difficulty in the water at {address}, {municipality}. Water rescue and an ambulance crew required on the bank.
incident.MED_LAKE_RESCUE.report.intros: Person in difficulty in the lake reported at {address}, {municipality}.
A walker reports an overturned canoe and a person in the water by {address}.
Response requested for a bather unable to get back to the bank at {address}, {municipality}.
Multiple callers report a person holding on to a boat out in the middle of the water at {address}.
The owner of a hire business reports a pedalo that has not come back, at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MED_LAKE_RESCUE.report.details: The person is a long way from the bank and cannot make any ground towards it.
The boat has gone over and is floating upside down a short way off.
Bystanders are keeping them in sight from the shore and pointing out the position.
The person answers when called but looks worn down by the cold.
incident.MED_LAKE_RESCUE.report.conditio: The lake water stays very cold even in the warm months.
The bank along that stretch is steep and vehicle access is limited.
The wind has got the water up and makes it hard to pick the person out.
incident.MED_LAKE_RESCUE.report.closings: Fire Brigade boat crew requested for the recovery, with an ambulance crew on the bank.
The caller has been advised to stay on the bank and keep the person in sight.
Have warming blankets ready and a medical assessment straight away on recovery.
messages.incident.MED_LAKE_RESCUE.outcome.success: The person was recovered from the water and handed to the medics in good general condition.
messages.incident.MED_LAKE_RESCUE.outcome.partial: The person was recovered, but the long exposure to the cold meant a longer stretch of care was needed.
messages.incident.MED_LAKE_RESCUE.outcome.failure: Too few resources: the recovery was completed by other units and the incident was handed to other rescuers.
messages.incident.MULTI_CAPSIZED_BOAT.title: Capsized boat
messages.incident.MULTI_CAPSIZED_BOAT.summary: Boat capsized with several people in the water: multiple recoveries, triage ashore and medical transports.
messages.incident.MULTI_CAPSIZED_BOAT.radio: Control to all units: boat capsized with several people in the water at {address}, {municipality}. Boat crew, several ambulance crews and Police required.
incident.MULTI_CAPSIZED_BOAT.report.intr: Boat capsized with several people in the water reported at {address}, {municipality}.
A witness reports a boat turned over and several people clinging to the hull at {address}.
Urgent response requested for a boat that has gone over off {address}, {municipality}.
Multiple callers report people in the water after a boat capsized in the area of {address}.
A patrol confirms an upturned hull and people in the water at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_CAPSIZED_BOAT.report.deta: There are more than two people in the water and not all of them are wearing life jackets.
Some are holding on to the upturned hull, others have been carried off by the current.
The exact number of people who were on board has yet to be confirmed.
Those already back ashore are chilled through and need looking after.
incident.MULTI_CAPSIZED_BOAT.report.cond: The sea is rough and the current is quickly scattering the people in the water.
Vehicle access to the shore is limited and a landing point has to be set up.
The water temperature saps the strength of those still out there very quickly.
incident.MULTI_CAPSIZED_BOAT.report.clos: Fire Brigade boat crew requested for the recovery, with several ambulance crews for triage ashore.
Police are needed to cordon the landing point and manage bystanders.
Consider air support to locate the people carried away from the hull.
messages.incident.MULTI_CAPSIZED_BOAT.outcome.suc: Everyone was recovered from the water, cared for ashore and handed to the medics in good condition.
messages.incident.MULTI_CAPSIZED_BOAT.outcome.par: The recovery was completed, but incomplete cover dragged it out and made the cold exposure worse.
messages.incident.MULTI_CAPSIZED_BOAT.outcome.fai: A wholly inadequate response: the recovery was taken over by other rescuers.
messages.incident.MULTI_PERSON_OVERBOARD.title: Person overboard
messages.incident.MULTI_PERSON_OVERBOARD.summary: Person fallen from a boat into the sea: a search over a wide stretch of water with boats and air support.
messages.incident.MULTI_PERSON_OVERBOARD.radio: Control to all units: person overboard off {address}, {municipality}. Search under way; boats, air support and a single incident commander required.
incident.MULTI_PERSON_OVERBOARD.report.i: Person fallen overboard from a boat reported off {address}, {municipality}.
The crew of a fishing boat report a person gone into the water near {address}.
Urgent search requested for a person overboard off {address}, {municipality}.
The skipper of a pleasure craft reports a person gone over the side in the area of {address}.
Multiple callers report a person in the water after a manoeuvre at {address}, {municipality}.
incident.MULTI_PERSON_OVERBOARD.report.d: The position of the last sighting is only approximate and has to be worked out.
The boat has turned back and is searching the area.
The person was wearing a life jacket when they went in.
Several minutes have passed since they were last seen.
incident.MULTI_PERSON_OVERBOARD.report.c: The swell and the waves make it very hard to pick out a person in the water.
Visibility is poor and the stretch of water to be searched is wide.
The current is moving the search area away from the last sighting.
Boats requested to search the area, with air support to spot from above.
A single incident commander is needed to coordinate the search sectors.
Have medical care and warming blankets ready at the landing point.
The person was spotted and recovered from the sea, cared for on board and landed in good general condition.
The search ended well, but the time it took made the cold exposure worse.
The search was not concluded in the time that counts: the operation was handed to other units.
